16.2.246.s: teṣāṃ prasiddhā dīkṣaṇīyeṣṭis tāyate sakṛdāśrāvite sa yatrāha bharatavat | iti tad gṛhapater evārṣeyaṃ prathamaṃ vṛṇīte 'tha hotur athātmano 'tha brahmaṇo 'thodgātur atha pratiprasthātur atha prastotur atha praśāstur atha brāhmaṇāccham̐sino 'cchāvākasya sadasyasyāgnīdhaḥ potur neṣṭur grāvastuta unnetuḥ subrahmaṇyasya pratihartur antatas |
16.2.246.d: तेषां प्रसिद्धा दीक्षणीयेष्टिस् तायते सकृदाश्राविते स यत्राह भरतवत् । इति तद् गृहपतेर् एवार्षेयं प्रथमं वृणीते ऽथ होतुर् अथात्मनो ऽथ ब्रह्मणो ऽथोद्गातुर् अथ प्रतिप्रस्थातुर् अथ प्रस्तोतुर् अथ प्रशास्तुर् अथ ब्राह्मणाच्छँसिनो ऽच्छावाकस्य सदस्यस्याग्नीधः पोतुर् नेष्टुर् ग्रावस्तुत उन्नेतुः सुब्रह्मण्यस्य प्रतिहर्तुर् अन्ततस् ।
16.2.246.m: The consecratory sacrifice of these is performed in the established manner. / When the call has been uttered once, where he says 'like Bharata', he chooses first the ancestral lineage of the householder, then of the hotṛ priest, then of himself, then of the brahman priest, then of the udgātṛ priest, then of the pratiprasthātṛ priest, then of the prastotṛ priest, then of the praśāstṛ priest, then of the brāhmaṇācchaṃsin priest, of the acchāvāka priest, of the sadasya priest, of the āgnīdhra priest, of the potṛ priest, of the neṣṭṛ priest, of the grāvastut priest, of the unnetṛ priest, of the subrahmaṇya priest, and of the pratihartṛ priest at the end.

16.2.246.s: brahmaṇvat | iti samānam | te sarva eva dīkṣāhutiṣu samanvārabhante
16.2.246.d: ब्रह्मण्वत् । इति समानम् । ते सर्व एव दीक्षाहुतिषु समन्वारभन्ते
16.2.246.m: 'Possessed of the brāhmaṇas' is common to all. / They all together touch [the sacrificer] at the consecration oblations.
The adhvaryu priest makes only the householder recite loudly on the black antelope skin.

16.2.246.s: tad evetare 'nunikrāmanti | api vānyo'nyaṃ vācayanti yady adhīyanto bhavanti
16.2.246.d: तद् एवेतरे ऽनुनिक्रामन्ति । अपि वान्योऽन्यं वाचयन्ति यद्य् अधीयन्तो भवन्ति
16.2.246.m: The others step across following that very one; / alternatively, they make one another recite, if they are knowledgeable.

16.2.246.s: te yathotsāhaṃ vratadugham upayanty ekaikāṃ vā bahvīr vā
16.2.246.d: ते यथोत्साहं व्रतदुघम् उपयन्त्य् एकैकां वा बह्वीर् वा
16.2.246.m: According to their ability, they go to the cow that gives the fast-milk, either to one each or to many.

16.2.246.s: teṣāṃ yathaiva pravarānupūrvyam evaṃ gharmocchiṣṭe 'tigrāhyabhakṣeṣu ṣoḍaśini
16.2.246.d: तेषां यथैव प्रवरानुपूर्व्यम् एवं घर्मोच्छिष्टे ऽतिग्राह्यभक्षेषु षोडशिनि
16.2.246.m: As is the order of their ancestral invocations, even so it is at the remainder of the gharma, at the consumptions of the atigrāhya cups, and at the ṣoḍaśin cup.

16.2.247.s: ṣaṣṭhyām upasady uttaravedim̐ saṃnivapanti yady anagnicityo bhavati |
16.2.247.d: षष्ठ्याम् उपसद्य् उत्तरवेदिँ संनिवपन्ति यद्य् अनग्निचित्यो भवति ।
16.2.247.m: On the sixth upasad day they pile up the high altar, if there is no fire-altar piling.

16.2.247.s: atha yadi sāgnicityaḥ prathamāyām evopasady uttaravedim̐ saṃnivapanti ||
16.2.247.d: अथ यदि साग्निचित्यः प्रथमायाम् एवोपसद्य् उत्तरवेदिँ संनिवपन्ति ॥
16.2.247.m: Now, if it involves the piling of a fire-altar, they pile up the high altar on the very first upasad day.

16.3.247.s: teṣāṃ dvādaśa dīkṣā dvādaśopasado dvādaśāhaṃ prasutās | na dvādaśāhe 'gniṃ cinvītety eka āhus |
16.3.247.d: तेषां द्वादश दीक्षा द्वादशोपसदो द्वादशाहं प्रसुतास् । न द्वादशाहे ऽग्निं चिन्वीतेत्य् एक आहुस् ।
16.3.247.m: Their [sacrifice consists of] twelve initiation days, twelve upasad days, and twelve soma-pressing days. Some say: 'One should not pile the fire-altar in a twelve-day ritual.'

16.3.247.s: cinvata u haike prasiddhena karmaṇopavasathād yanti
16.3.247.d: चिन्वत उ हैके प्रसिद्धेन कर्मणोपवसथाद् यन्ति
16.3.247.m: Some, however, pile it. By the established ritual they proceed up to the fast-day.

16.3.247.d: तेषां ज्योतिष्टोमो वैश्वानरः प्रायणीयो ऽतिरात्रस् तायते
16.3.247.m: Their opening atirātra sacrifice, dedicated to Agni Vaiśvānara, is performed as a jyotiṣṭoma.

16.3.247.s: sa yatra mādhyaṃdine savane tṛtīyasavanāya vasatīvarībhyo 'vanayati tad vasatīvarīkalaśe yāvanmātrīr atiśiṣyāgnīdhraṃ drutvā chāyāyai cātapataś ca sandhau gṛhṇāti haviṣmatīr imā āpo haviṣmān devo adhvaro haviṣmām̐ āvivāsati haviṣmām̐ astu sūryas | iti |
16.3.247.d: स यत्र माध्यंदिने सवने तृतीयसवनाय वसतीवरीभ्यो ऽवनयति तद् वसतीवरीकलशे यावन्मात्रीर् अतिशिष्याग्नीध्रं द्रुत्वा छायायै चातपतश् च सन्धौ गृह्णाति हविष्मतीर् इमा आपो हविष्मान् देवो अध्वरो हविष्माँ आविवासति हविष्माँ अस्तु सूर्यस् । इति ।
16.3.247.m: When, at the midday pressing, he pours out [water] from the vasatīvarī waters for the third pressing, then, having left over just a small amount in the vasatīvarī jar, running to the āgnīdhra shed, he draws [water] at the junction of shade and sunlight, saying: 'These waters are full of oblation; divine, full of oblation is the sacrificial rite; full of oblation, he approaches; may Sūrya be full of oblation.'

16.3.247.s: eṣāhīnasaṃtatir etām eva punaḥpunaś codayiṣyāma iti vadantaḥ
16.3.247.d: एषाहीनसंततिर् एताम् एव पुनःपुनश् चोदयिष्याम इति वदन्तः
16.3.247.m: This is the continuity of the ahīna sacrifice. Saying, 'We shall urge this very [practice] again and again,'

16.3.247.s: so 'tra vaiva yajñasya punarālambhaṃ japati yajñāyajñiyasya vā stotre śaṃyuvāke vā
16.3.247.d: सो ऽत्र वैव यज्ञस्य पुनरालम्भं जपति यज्ञायज्ञियस्य वा स्तोत्रे शंयुवाके वा
16.3.247.m: he either murmurs here the regaining of the sacrifice, or during the chant of the Yajñāyajñīya saman, or during the Śaṃyuvāka.

16.3.247.d: तेषां ज्योतिष्टोमो वैश्वानरः प्रायणीयो ऽतिरात्रः संतिष्ठते
16.3.247.m: Their opening atirātra sacrifice, dedicated to Agni Vaiśvānara, comes to a conclusion as a jyotiṣṭoma.
When it has concluded, they turn round the enclosing sticks.

16.3.248.m: They throw the grass bundle into the fire. [The ritual] ends with the patnīsaṃyājas.

16.3.248.s: atipraiṣeṇa brahmā vācaṃ yacchati parihṛtāsu vasatīvarīṣv āhūtāyām̐ subrahmaṇyāyāṃ brahmā vācaṃ visṛjate
16.3.248.d: अतिप्रैषेण ब्रह्मा वाचं यच्छति परिहृतासु वसतीवरीष्व् आहूतायाँ सुब्रह्मण्यायां ब्रह्मा वाचं विसृजते
16.3.248.m: At the surpassing call, the brahman priest restrains his speech. When the vasatīvarī waters have been carried around and the subrahmaṇyā formula has been recited, the brahman priest releases his speech.

16.3.248.s: pratipadyate divā prātaranuvākenāhnā saṃkrāman hotā chandām̐sy anvāha nimīlyādhvaryur upām̐śuṃ juhoti rātryai rūpam iti vadantas
16.3.248.d: प्रतिपद्यते दिवा प्रातरनुवाकेनाह्ना संक्रामन् होता छन्दाँस्य् अन्वाह निमील्याध्वर्युर् उपाँशुं जुहोति रात्र्यै रूपम् इति वदन्तस्
16.3.248.m: By day, [the ritual] commences with the morning recitation. Transitioning through the day, the hotṛ priest recites the meters. The adhvaryu priest offers the upāṃśu cup with closed eyes, saying: 'This is the form of night.'
A trivṛt agniṣṭoma having the rathaṃtara saman is performed.
At the chant for the Mahendra cup, a harnessed chariot drives across.

16.3.248.s: rathaśabdena māhendrasya stotram upākaroti | etāvad evaitad ahaḥ śilpaṃ kriyate |
16.3.248.d: रथशब्देन माहेन्द्रस्य स्तोत्रम् उपाकरोति । एतावद् एवैतद् अहः शिल्पं क्रियते ।
16.3.248.m: With the sound of the chariot, he introduces the chant for the Mahendra cup. Just this much ritual craft is performed on this day.

16.3.248.s: ahīnasaṃtatiṃ karoti | atha śvo bhūte tāyate pañcadaśa ukthyo bṛhatsāmā
16.3.248.d: अहीनसंततिं करोति । अथ श्वो भूते तायते पञ्चदश उक्थ्यो बृहत्सामा
16.3.248.m: He establishes the continuity of the ahīna sacrifice. Then, on the next day, a fifteen-fold ukthya having the bṛhat saman is performed.

16.3.248.s: dundubhinaitad ahar adhvaryur māhendrasya stotram upākaroti |
16.3.248.d: दुन्दुभिनैतद् अहर् अध्वर्युर् माहेन्द्रस्य स्तोत्रम् उपाकरोति ।
16.3.248.m: With a drum, on this day, the adhvaryu priest introduces the chant for the Mahendra cup.

16.3.248.s: etāvad evaitad ahaḥ śilpaṃ kriyate | ahīnasaṃtatiṃ karoti |
16.3.248.d: एतावद् एवैतद् अहः शिल्पं क्रियते । अहीनसंततिं करोति ।
16.3.248.m: Just this much ritual craft is performed on this day. He establishes the continuity of the ahīna sacrifice.

16.3.248.s: atha śvo bhūte tāyate saptadaśa ukthyo vairūpasāmā | ādhāvenaitad ahar adhvaryur māhendrasya stotram upākaroti |
16.3.248.d: अथ श्वो भूते तायते सप्तदश उक्थ्यो वैरूपसामा । आधावेनैतद् अहर् अध्वर्युर् माहेन्द्रस्य स्तोत्रम् उपाकरोति ।
16.3.248.m: Then, on the next day, a seventeen-fold ukthya having the vairūpa saman is performed. With a race, on this day, the adhvaryu priest introduces the chant for the Mahendra cup.
Just this much ritual craft is performed on this day.

16.3.248.s: ahīnasaṃtatiṃ karoti | atha śvo bhūte tāyata ekavim̐śa ukthyo vairājasāmāgneyaś ca ṣoḍaśī cātigrāhyau |
16.3.248.d: अहीनसंततिं करोति । अथ श्वो भूते तायत एकविँश उक्थ्यो वैराजसामाग्नेयश् च षोडशी चातिग्राह्यौ ।
16.3.248.m: He establishes the continuity of the ahīna sacrifice. Then, on the next day, a twenty-one-fold ukthya having the vairāja saman is performed, and an [extra cup] for Agni and the ṣoḍaśī are the two additional cups.
Some say: 'The ṣoḍaśī is not an additional cup.'

16.3.248.s: ekavim̐śam etad ahar nyūṅkhyaṃ bhavati virājāṃ vā pratipatsu nyūṅkhayanti śastre vety etad ekam
16.3.248.d: एकविँशम् एतद् अहर् न्यूङ्ख्यं भवति विराजां वा प्रतिपत्सु न्यूङ्खयन्ति शस्त्रे वेत्य् एतद् एकम्
16.3.248.m: This twenty-one-fold day requires the nyūṅkha modulation. They insert the nyūṅkha either into the opening verses of the virāj meters, or into the recitation; this is one view.

16.3.249.s: athāparaṃ prātaranuvāke nyūṅkhayanti haviṣkṛty ubhayeṣu prasthiteṣu māhendrasyāśrāvaṇe
16.3.249.d: अथापरं प्रातरनुवाके न्यूङ्खयन्ति हविष्कृत्य् उभयेषु प्रस्थितेषु माहेन्द्रस्याश्रावणे
16.3.249.m: Now another view: they insert the nyūṅkha in the morning recitation, at the call to prepare the oblation, when both [sets of cups] have been set out, and at the call for the Mahendra cup.
'Beyond this, they do not insert the nyūṅkha,' [they say].

16.3.249.s: araṇīhasta etad ahar adhvaryur māhendrasya stotram upākaroti
16.3.249.d: अरणीहस्त एतद् अहर् अध्वर्युर् माहेन्द्रस्य स्तोत्रम् उपाकरोति
16.3.249.m: Holding the churning sticks in his hand, on this day, the adhvaryu priest introduces the chant for the Mahendra cup.

16.3.249.s: tad ugātur dakṣiṇa urau manthati taṃ jātam̐ sarva evābhihiṅkurvanti ||
16.3.249.d: तद् उगातुर् दक्षिण उरौ मन्थति तं जातँ सर्व एवाभिहिङ्कुर्वन्ति ॥
16.3.249.m: He churns it on the right thigh of the udgātṛ priest. When it is born, all utter 'hiṅ' toward it.

16.4.249.m: Its discussion: he should throw it into the gārhapatya fire for those desiring firm standing;

16.4.249.s: āgnīdhre prajākāmānām | śāmitre paśukāmānām āhavanīye svargakāmānām iti |
16.4.249.d: आग्नीध्रे प्रजाकामानाम् । शामित्रे पशुकामानाम् आहवनीये स्वर्गकामानाम् इति ।
16.4.249.m: into the āgnīdhra fire for those desiring offspring; into the śāmitra fire for those desiring cattle; into the āhavanīya fire for those desiring heaven.

16.4.249.s: anādṛtya tad āhavanīya evānupraharati bhavataṃ naḥ samanasau | iti
16.4.249.d: अनादृत्य तद् आहवनीय एवानुप्रहरति भवतं नः समनसौ । इति
16.4.249.m: Disregarding that, he throws it into the āhavanīya fire only, with: 'Be of one mind with us...'

16.4.249.s: prahṛtyābhijuhoti | agnāv agniś carati praviṣṭas | iti | etāvad evaitad ahaḥ śilpaṃ kriyate |
16.4.249.d: प्रहृत्याभिजुहोति । अग्नाव् अग्निश् चरति प्रविष्टस् । इति । एतावद् एवैतद् अहः शिल्पं क्रियते ।
16.4.249.m: Having thrown it, he makes an offering over it, saying: 'Fire moves entered into fire...' Just this much ritual craft is performed on this day.

16.4.249.s: ahīnasaṃtatiṃ karoti | atha śvo bhūte tāyate triṇava ukthyaḥ śākvarasāmaindro 'tigrāhyas |
16.4.249.d: अहीनसंततिं करोति । अथ श्वो भूते तायते त्रिणव उक्थ्यः शाक्वरसामैन्द्रो ऽतिग्राह्यस् ।
16.4.249.m: He establishes the continuity of the ahīna sacrifice. Then, on the next day, a twenty-seven-fold ukthya having the śākvara saman is performed; an [extra cup] for Indra is the additional cup.

16.4.249.s: adbhir etad ahar avakāmiśrābhir adhvaryur māhendrasya stotram upākaroti
16.4.249.d: अद्भिर् एतद् अहर् अवकामिश्राभिर् अध्वर्युर् माहेन्द्रस्य स्तोत्रम् उपाकरोति
16.4.249.m: With water mixed with avakā plants, on this day, the adhvaryu priest introduces the chant for the Mahendra cup.

16.4.250.s: cātvāle 'vanayed āstāve ninayet prokṣaṇīḥ kurvīta puroḍāśīyāni piṣṭāni saṃyauyād iti |
16.4.250.d: चात्वाले ऽवनयेद् आस्तावे निनयेत् प्रोक्षणीः कुर्वीत पुरोडाशीयानि पिष्टानि संयौयाद् इति ।
16.4.250.m: 'He should pour it into the pit; he should pour it out in the chanting place; he should make it sprinkling water; he should mix the flour for the sacrificial cakes [with it],' [so they say].

16.4.250.s: anādṛtya tad udgātṛṣv adhīnā evaināḥ kuryād
16.4.250.d: अनादृत्य तद् उद्गातृष्व् अधीना एवैनाः कुर्याद्
16.4.250.m: Disregarding that, he should place it solely at the disposal of the udgātṛ priests.

16.4.250.s: udgātāro haitābhir araṇyegeyānām̐ sāmnām̐ śucam̐ śamayanto manyante
16.4.250.d: उद्गातारो हैताभिर् अरण्येगेयानाँ साम्नाँ शुचँ शमयन्तो मन्यन्ते
16.4.250.m: Indeed, the udgātṛ priests consider that with this they appease the heat of the chants to be sung in the forest.

16.4.250.s: tā u ced adhvaryave prabrūyus | apo 'bhyavaharata | ity eva brūyād iti |
16.4.250.d: ता उ चेद् अध्वर्यवे प्रब्रूयुस् । अपो ऽभ्यवहरत । इत्य् एव ब्रूयाद् इति ।
16.4.250.m: And if they should speak to the adhvaryu priest, he should simply say: 'Carry it down into the waters.'

16.4.250.s: etāvad evaitad ahaḥ śilpaṃ kriyate | ahīnasaṃtatiṃ karoti |
16.4.250.d: एतावद् एवैतद् अहः शिल्पं क्रियते । अहीनसंततिं करोति ।
16.4.250.m: Just this much ritual craft is performed on this day. He establishes the continuity of the ahīna sacrifice.

16.4.250.s: atha śvo bhūte tāyate trayastrim̐śa ukthyo raivatasāmā sauryo 'tigrāhas |
16.4.250.d: अथ श्वो भूते तायते त्रयस्त्रिँश उक्थ्यो रैवतसामा सौर्यो ऽतिग्राहस् ।
16.4.250.m: Then, on the next day, a thirty-three-fold ukthya having the raivata saman is performed; an [extra cup] for Sūrya is the additional cup.

16.4.250.s: adbhir evaitad ahar dūrvāmiśrābhir adhvaryur māhendrasya stotram upākaroti ||
16.4.250.d: अद्भिर् एवैतद् अहर् दूर्वामिश्राभिर् अध्वर्युर् माहेन्द्रस्य स्तोत्रम् उपाकरोति ॥
16.4.250.m: With water mixed with dūrvā grass, on this day, the adhvaryu priest introduces the chant for the Mahendra cup.

16.5.250.s: tāsām uktā mīmām̐sā svayamṛtuyājam evaitad ahar bhavati
16.5.250.d: तासाम् उक्ता मीमाँसा स्वयमृतुयाजम् एवैतद् अहर् भवति
16.5.250.m: The discussion about them has been stated. On this day the seasonal offering is performed by oneself.

16.5.250.s: naitad ahar anyo'nyasyartuyājaṃ yajanti sa yatrāha | adhvaryū yajatam iti tad adhvaryū jaghanena havirdhāne upaviśya svayamṛtuyājaṃ yajatas | ye3 yajāmahe aśvinādhvaryū ādhvaryavāt | ṛtunā somaṃ pibatām arvāñcam adya yayyaṃ nṛvāhaṇam | rathaṃ yuñjāthām iha vāṃ vimocanam | pṛṅktaṃ havīm̐ṣi madhunā hi kaṃ gatam athā somaṃ pibataṃ vājinīvasū ṛtunā somaṃ pibatām | vau3ṣat | iti
16.5.250.d: नैतद् अहर् अन्योऽन्यस्यर्तुयाजं यजन्ति स यत्राह । अध्वर्यू यजतम् इति तद् अध्वर्यू जघनेन हविर्धाने उपविश्य स्वयमृतुयाजं यजतस् । ये३ यजामहे अश्विनाध्वर्यू आध्वर्यवात् । ऋतुना सोमं पिबताम् अर्वाञ्चम् अद्य यय्यं नृवाहणम् । रथं युञ्जाथाम् इह वां विमोचनम् । पृङ्क्तं हवीँषि मधुना हि कं गतम् अथा सोमं पिबतं वाजिनीवसू ऋतुना सोमं पिबताम् । वौ३षत् । इति
16.5.250.m: On this day they do not offer the seasonal offering for each other. When he says, 'You two adhvaryus, offer the sacrifice,' then the two adhvaryus, sitting down behind the two havirdhāna carts, offer their own seasonal offering: 'We who sacrifice... May the two Aśvins, the two adhvaryus, from the adhvaryu’s office, drink soma according to the season. Today, hitherward, going forth, conveying men, harness the chariot; here is your unyoking; mix the oblations, for you have gone for delight; then drink soma, O you who possess prizes of victory! May they two drink soma according to the season! Vauṣat.'

16.5.250.s: sa yatrāha gṛhapate yaja | iti tad gṛhapatir jaghanena gārhapatyam upaviśya svayamṛtuyājaṃ yajati ye3 yajāmahe agniṃ gṛhapatiṃ gārhapatyāt sugṛhapatayas tvayāgna ime sunvanto yajamānāḥ syuḥ sugṛhapatis tvam ebhiḥ sunvadbhir yajamānaiḥ syās | agnir gṛhapatir gārhapatyāt | ṛtunā somaṃ pibatu joṣy agne samidhaṃ joṣy āhutim | joṣi brahma janyaṃ joṣi suṣṭutim | viśvebhir viśvām̐ ṛtunā vaso mahas | uśan devām̐ uśataḥ pāyayā havis | ṛtunā somaṃ pibatū vau3ṣat | iti
16.5.250.d: स यत्राह गृहपते यज । इति तद् गृहपतिर् जघनेन गार्हपत्यम् उपविश्य स्वयमृतुयाजं यजति ये३ यजामहे अग्निं गृहपतिं गार्हपत्यात् सुगृहपतयस् त्वयाग्न इमे सुन्वन्तो यजमानाः स्युः सुगृहपतिस् त्वम् एभिः सुन्वद्भिर् यजमानैः स्यास् । अग्निर् गृहपतिर् गार्हपत्यात् । ऋतुना सोमं पिबतु जोष्य् अग्ने समिधं जोष्य् आहुतिम् । जोषि ब्रह्म जन्यं जोषि सुष्टुतिम् । विश्वेभिर् विश्वाँ ऋतुना वसो महस् । उशन् देवाँ उशतः पायया हविस् । ऋतुना सोमं पिबतू वौ३षत् । इति
16.5.250.m: When he says, 'Householder, offer the sacrifice,' then the householder, sitting down behind the gārhapatya fire, offers his own seasonal offering: 'We who sacrifice... Agni the householder, from the householder's office. May these soma-pressing sacrificers have good householders through you, O Agni; may you be a good householder through these soma-pressing sacrificers. May Agni the householder from the householder's office drink soma according to the season. Enjoy, O Agni, the kindling stick; enjoy the oblation; enjoy the sacred chant born of the people; enjoy the hymn of praise. O Vasu, mighty with all [the gods] according to the season, willing, cause the willing gods to drink the oblation. May he drink soma according to the season! Vauṣat.'

16.5.251.m: This day is accompanied by the lowing [of cattle] together.

16.5.251.s: uttarato vatsān dhārayanti dakṣiṇato mātṝs | māhendrasya stotre 'ntareṇa sadohavirdhāne saṃvāśya vatsān mātṛbhiḥ sam̐sṛjanti
16.5.251.d: उत्तरतो वत्सान् धारयन्ति दक्षिणतो मातॄस् । माहेन्द्रस्य स्तोत्रे ऽन्तरेण सदोहविर्धाने संवाश्य वत्सान् मातृभिः सँसृजन्ति
16.5.251.m: They hold the calves to the north, the mothers to the south. At the chant for the Mahendra cup, having caused them to low together between the sadas shed and the havirdhāna shed, they unite the calves with the mothers.

16.5.251.s: badhnanti vatsān utsṛjanti mātṝs | māhendrasya stotram upākaroti athāparāhṇa ukthyaparyāyeṣu śilpāni kriyante
16.5.251.d: बध्नन्ति वत्सान् उत्सृजन्ति मातॄस् । माहेन्द्रस्य स्तोत्रम् उपाकरोति अथापराह्ण उक्थ्यपर्यायेषु शिल्पानि क्रियन्ते
16.5.251.m: They tie the calves; they release the mothers. He introduces the chant for the Mahendra cup. Then in the afternoon, during the ukthya rounds, the ritual crafts are performed.
The hotṛ priest recites the Pārucchepa hymns.

16.5.251.s: vālakhilyā maitrāvaruṇo viharati vṛṣākapiṃ brāhmaṇāccham̐sī śam̐saty evayāmarutam acchāvākaḥ
16.5.251.d: वालखिल्या मैत्रावरुणो विहरति वृषाकपिं ब्राह्मणाच्छँसी शँसत्य् एवयामरुतम् अच्छावाकः
16.5.251.m: The maitrāvaruṇa priest alternates the Vālakhilya hymns. The brāhmaṇācchaṃsin priest recites the Vṛṣākapi hymn; the acchāvāka priest recites the Evayāmarut hymn.
The pṛṣṭhya six-day rite comes to a conclusion.

16.5.252.s: ahīnasaṃtatiṃ karoti atha vasatīvarīḥ parihṛtya payām̐si viśiṣyopavasanti ||
16.5.252.d: अहीनसंततिं करोति अथ वसतीवरीः परिहृत्य पयाँसि विशिष्योपवसन्ति ॥
16.5.252.m: He establishes the continuity of the ahīna sacrifice. Then, having carried around the vasatīvarī waters and divided the milks, they observe the fast.

16.6.252.s: atha śvo bhūte caturvim̐śaṃ chandomam upayanti bṛhatsāmānam atha śvo bhūte catuścatvārim̐śaṃ chandomam upayanti rathaṃtarasāmānam
16.6.252.d: अथ श्वो भूते चतुर्विँशं छन्दोमम् उपयन्ति बृहत्सामानम् अथ श्वो भूते चतुश्चत्वारिँशं छन्दोमम् उपयन्ति रथंतरसामानम्
16.6.252.m:
Then, on the next day, they undertake the twenty-fourfold chandoma day having the bṛhat saman.
Then, on the next day, they undertake the forty-fourfold chandoma day having the rathaṃtara saman.

16.6.252.s: atha śvo bhūte 'ṣṭācatvārim̐śaṃ chandomam upayanti bṛhatsāmānam
16.6.252.d: अथ श्वो भूते ऽष्टाचत्वारिँशं छन्दोमम् उपयन्ति बृहत्सामानम्
16.6.252.m: Then, on the next day, they undertake the forty-eightfold chandoma day having the bṛhat saman.

16.6.252.s: atha śvo bhūte caturvim̐śamagniṣṭomam upayanti rathaṃtarasāmānam
16.6.252.d: अथ श्वो भूते चतुर्विँशमग्निष्टोमम् उपयन्ति रथंतरसामानम्
16.6.252.m: Then, on the next day, they undertake the twenty-fourfold agniṣṭoma having the rathaṃtara saman.

16.6.252.s: naitad ahar anyo'nyasmā upahatāya vyāhus | gāthayā vā nārāśam̐syā vā vibrūyād iti
16.6.252.d: नैतद् अहर् अन्योऽन्यस्मा उपहताय व्याहुस् । गाथया वा नाराशँस्या वा विब्रूयाद् इति
16.6.252.m: On this day, they do not speak out to one another if wronged, [thinking], "One should speak in dissent either with a song or with a praise-verse."

16.6.252.s: tad u vā āhus | na vai yajñaḥ saṃtiṣṭhate yan na vibrūyāt | iti
16.6.252.d: तद् उ वा आहुस् । न वै यज्ञः संतिष्ठते यन् न विब्रूयात् । इति
16.6.252.m: And on this they also say, "The sacrifice indeed is not established if one does not speak in dissent."

16.6.252.s: vibrūyāt | iti vai no brāhmaṇaṃ bhavati
16.6.252.d: विब्रूयात् । इति वै नो ब्राह्मणं भवति
16.6.252.m: Our brāhmaṇa passage indeed says, "He should speak in dissent."

16.6.252.s: naitad ādriyeta nādriyeteti sthitis | ananuṣṭubham etad ahar bhavati
16.6.252.d: नैतद् आद्रियेत नाद्रियेतेति स्थितिस् । अननुष्टुभम् एतद् अहर् भवति

16.6.252.s: nānuṣṭubho 'dhīyate te ced anuṣṭubha uddharerann adhvaryur anuṣṭubha uddharet |
16.6.252.d: नानुष्टुभो ऽधीयते ते चेद् अनुष्टुभ उद्धरेरन्न् अध्वर्युर् अनुष्टुभ उद्धरेत् ।
16.6.252.m:
They do not recite anuṣṭubh verses.
If they omit the anuṣṭubh verses, the adhvaryu priest should omit the anuṣṭubh verses.

16.6.252.s: amūr yā upa sūrye yābhir vā sūryaḥ saha | tā no hinvatv adhvaram ity etayā sauryā gāyatryā vasatīvarīr gṛhṇīyāt |
16.6.252.d: अमूर् या उप सूर्ये याभिर् वा सूर्यः सह । ता नो हिन्वत्व् अध्वरम् इत्य् एतया सौर्या गायत्र्या वसतीवरीर् गृह्णीयात् ।
16.6.252.m: With this solar gāyatrī verse, "Those which are yonder near the sun, or those with which the sun is, may they further our sacrifice," he should draw the vasatīvarī waters.

16.6.253.s: hṛde tvā manase tvā | ity apoddhṛtyaitām anyayā saumyā gāyatryā rājānam upāvaharet |
16.6.253.d: हृदे त्वा मनसे त्वा । इत्य् अपोद्धृत्यैताम् अन्यया सौम्या गायत्र्या राजानम् उपावहरेत् ।
16.6.253.m: Omitting "To your heart, to your mind," he should bring down the King [Soma] with another Soma-related gāyatrī verse.

16.6.253.s: viṣṇo tvaṃ no antamas | ity apoddhṛtyaitām anyayā vaiṣṇavyā gāyatryā rājānam upatiṣṭheta
16.6.253.d: विष्णो त्वं नो अन्तमस् । इत्य् अपोद्धृत्यैताम् अन्यया वैष्णव्या गायत्र्या राजानम् उपतिष्ठेत
16.6.253.m: Omitting "O Viṣṇu, you are nearest to us," he should attend upon the King [Soma] with another Vaiṣṇava gāyatrī verse.

16.6.253.s: sa u ced avidvān anuṣṭubham abhivyāharati | atyakramiṣam iti hotre prāha
16.6.253.d: स उ चेद् अविद्वान् अनुष्टुभम् अभिव्याहरति । अत्यक्रमिषम् इति होत्रे प्राह
16.6.253.m: If unawares he utters an anuṣṭubh verse, he says to the hotṛ priest, "I have transgressed."

16.6.253.s: hotāsya tad akṣarair apivayati sa u cen manyetāmitakāmo vā aham asmi yad ṛṅmayaṃ vede yajurmayam eva tat |
16.6.253.d: होतास्य तद् अक्षरैर् अपिवयति स उ चेन् मन्येतामितकामो वा अहम् अस्मि यद् ऋङ्मयं वेदे यजुर्मयम् एव तत् ।
16.6.253.m:
The hotṛ priest weaves it shut for him with syllables.
And if he should think, "I have a boundless wish: what I know consisting of ṛc verses is indeed consisting of yajus formulas;

16.6.253.s: yāv evākṣaryau vedau tau saṃpādayetām iti naitad ādriyeta
16.6.253.d: याव् एवाक्षर्यौ वेदौ तौ संपादयेताम् इति नैतद् आद्रियेत
16.6.253.m: let whichever two Vedas possess syllables accomplish that"—one should not heed this.

16.6.253.s: nādriyeteti sthitiḥ saṃtiṣṭhata eṣa caturvim̐śo 'gniṣṭomo rathaṃtarasāmā ||
16.6.253.d: नाद्रियेतेति स्थितिः संतिष्ठत एष चतुर्विँशो ऽग्निष्टोमो रथंतरसामा ॥
16.6.253.m:
"One should not heed it" is the established rule.
This twenty-fourfold agniṣṭoma having the rathaṃtara saman is completed.

16.7.253.s: tasmin sam̐sthite samiddhārā yanti | āhṛtya samidha āgnīdhrīye saṃnyasyanti
16.7.253.d: तस्मिन् सँस्थिते समिद्धारा यन्ति । आहृत्य समिध आग्नीध्रीये संन्यस्यन्ति
16.7.253.m:
When it is completed, the fuel-gatherers go;
having fetched firewood, they cast it down at the āgnīdhrīya fire.

16.7.254.s: teṣu samanvārabdheṣv āhavanīye sruvāhutiṃ juhoti prajāpataye svāhā | iti manasā |
16.7.254.d: तेषु समन्वारब्धेष्व् आहवनीये स्रुवाहुतिं जुहोति प्रजापतये स्वाहा । इति मनसा ।
16.7.254.m: While they remain in contact from behind, he offers a ladle libation in the āhavanīya fire with the mind: "To Prajāpati hail!"
Then they creep forward to the sadas shed for the silent praise.

16.7.254.s: saṃprasṛptān viditvādhvaryur manasaiva prāṅ drutvā manasemāṃ pātraṃ kṛtvā manasānyaṃ grahaṃ prajāpataye gṛhṇāti | upayāmagṛhīto 'si prajāpataye tvā juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmi | iti
16.7.254.d: संप्रसृप्तान् विदित्वाध्वर्युर् मनसैव प्राङ् द्रुत्वा मनसेमां पात्रं कृत्वा मनसान्यं ग्रहं प्रजापतये गृह्णाति । उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि प्रजापतये त्वा जुष्टं गृह्णामि । इति
16.7.254.m: Knowing that they have crept forward, the adhvaryu priest, running eastward mentally, making this [earth] his vessel mentally, draws another soma-cup for Prajāpati mentally: "You are taken with a support; I take you agreeable to Prajāpati."

16.7.254.s: yad idaṃ kiṃ ca tat | iti manasā parimṛjya sādayati | eṣa te yoniḥ prajāpataye tvā | iti |
16.7.254.d: यद् इदं किं च तत् । इति मनसा परिमृज्य सादयति । एष ते योनिः प्रजापतये त्वा । इति ।
16.7.254.m: Mentally wiping it around with "Whatever this is," he deposits it with "This is your womb; to Prajāpati you."

16.7.254.s: athāpa upaspṛśya barhiṣī ādāya vācaṃyamaḥ pratyaṅ drutvā manasaiva stotram upākaroti
16.7.254.d: अथाप उपस्पृश्य बर्हिषी आदाय वाचंयमः प्रत्यङ् द्रुत्वा मनसैव स्तोत्रम् उपाकरोति
16.7.254.m: Then, touching water, taking two blades of sacrificial grass, keeping silence, and running westward, he introduces the chant with the mind alone.

Mentally he authorizes;
mentally he preludes;

16.7.254.s: manasodgāyati manasā pratiharati manasā hotre | eṣottamā | iti prāhus |
16.7.254.d: मनसोद्गायति मनसा प्रतिहरति मनसा होत्रे । एषोत्तमा । इति प्राहुस् ।

16.7.254.s: manasā hotāhvayate manasādhvaryuḥ pratyāhvayate manasā śam̐sati
16.7.254.d: मनसा होताह्वयते मनसाध्वर्युः प्रत्याह्वयते मनसा शँसति

16.7.254.s: manasā pratigṛṇāti yadaitasya mānasasya śastrasya pāram ety atha hotoccaiś caturhotṝn vyācaṣṭe
16.7.254.d: मनसा प्रतिगृणाति यदैतस्य मानसस्य शस्त्रस्य पारम् एत्य् अथ होतोच्चैश् चतुर्होतॄन् व्याचष्टे
16.7.254.m:
mentally he utters the response.
When he reaches the end of this mental recitation, then the hotṛ priest pronounces the Caturhotṛ formulas aloud.
To him the adhvaryu priest utters the response:

16.8.254.s: om̐ hotas tathā hotaḥ satyam̐ hotar arātsma hotar iti
16.8.254.d: ओँ होतस् तथा होतः सत्यँ होतर् अरात्स्म होतर् इति
16.8.254.m: "Om, hotṛ priest! So, hotṛ priest! True, hotṛ priest! We have succeeded, hotṛ priest!"

16.8.255.s: yady u vai hotā nādhyety anya u hotrāśam̐sī śam̐sati tasmā u pratiprasthātā pratigṛṇāti
16.8.255.d: यद्य् उ वै होता नाध्येत्य् अन्य उ होत्राशँसी शँसति तस्मा उ प्रतिप्रस्थाता प्रतिगृणाति
16.8.255.m:
And if the hotṛ priest does not recite and another recitation-assistant recites,
then the pratiprasthātṛ priest utters the response to him.

16.8.255.s: yadaiteṣāṃ pāraṃ yanty athādhvaryur manasaiva prāṅ drutvā manasaiva taṃ graham upodyacchate
16.8.255.d: यदैतेषां पारं यन्त्य् अथाध्वर्युर् मनसैव प्राङ् द्रुत्वा मनसैव तं ग्रहम् उपोद्यच्छते
16.8.255.m: When they reach the end of these, then the adhvaryu priest, running eastward mentally, raises up that soma-cup mentally.

16.8.255.s: manasā pratyāśrāvayati manasā vaṣaṭkṛtānuvaṣaṭkṛte hutvā harati bhakṣam |
16.8.255.d: मनसा प्रत्याश्रावयति मनसा वषट्कृतानुवषट्कृते हुत्वा हरति भक्षम् ।
16.8.255.m:
mentally he makes the counter-call;
mentally, having offered at the vaṣaṭ call and the second vaṣaṭ call, he carries the portion for consumption.

16.8.255.s: manasā samupahūya bhakṣayanti manasā nirṇijya pātraṃ prayacchati
16.8.255.d: मनसा समुपहूय भक्षयन्ति मनसा निर्णिज्य पात्रं प्रयच्छति
16.8.255.m:
Mentally, having invited each other, they consume [it];
mentally, having cleansed the vessel, he hands it over.

16.8.255.s: saṃtiṣṭhata eṣa tūṣṇīm̐stomas | athartvijo vipṛcchati | adhivṛkṣasūrye vācaṃ visrakṣyadhvā3i nakṣatreṣū3 iti |
16.8.255.d: संतिष्ठत एष तूष्णीँस्तोमस् । अथर्त्विजो विपृच्छति । अधिवृक्षसूर्ये वाचं विस्रक्ष्यध्वा३इ नक्षत्रेषू३ इति ।
16.8.255.m:
This silent praise is completed.
Then he asks the officiating priests: "Will you release speech when the sun is above the trees, or at the stars?"

16.8.255.s: adhivṛkṣasūrye | iti vai no brāhmaṇaṃ bhavati
16.8.255.d: अधिवृक्षसूर्ये । इति वै नो ब्राह्मणं भवति
16.8.255.m: Our brāhmaṇa passage indeed says, "When the sun is above the trees."
They release speech only when the sun is above the trees.

16.8.255.s: tān atraivāsīnān pariśrayanti patnīśāle patnīḥ pariśrayanti |
16.8.255.d: तान् अत्रैवासीनान् परिश्रयन्ति पत्नीशाले पत्नीः परिश्रयन्ति ।
16.8.255.m:
They screen them off as they sit right there;
they screen off the wives in the wife's hall.

16.8.255.s: athānatisarpantāv adhvaryū dhiṣṇiyān barhirbhyām audumbarīm̐ samanvārabhete iha dhṛtis | iha vidhṛtis | iha rantis | iha ramatis | iti
16.8.255.d: अथानतिसर्पन्ताव् अध्वर्यू धिष्णियान् बर्हिर्भ्याम् औदुम्बरीँ समन्वारभेते इह धृतिस् । इह विधृतिस् । इह रन्तिस् । इह रमतिस् । इति
16.8.255.m: Then, not creeping past the side-hearths, the two adhvaryus grasp the audumbarī pillar with two blades of sacrificial grass, [reciting,] "Here is support; here is wide support; here is delight; here is revelry."
They release speech according to what was agreed upon.

16.9.255.s: athātaḥ sarpaṇasyaiva mīmām̐sā dakṣiṇasya havirdhānasyādho'dho 'kṣam̐ sarpeyus |
16.9.255.d: अथातः सर्पणस्यैव मीमाँसा दक्षिणस्य हविर्धानस्याधोऽधो ऽक्षँ सर्पेयुस् ।
16.9.255.m:
Now follows the inquiry into the creeping itself:
They should creep right under the axle of the southern havirdhāna cart.

16.9.256.s: etena ha vai sarpāḥ sasṛpus tato vai te jīrṇās tanūr apāghnata | iti
16.9.256.d: एतेन ह वै सर्पाः ससृपुस् ततो वै ते जीर्णास् तनूर् अपाघ्नत । इति
16.9.256.m:
By this [way] the serpents crept;
"thereby indeed they struck off their worn-out skins."

16.9.256.s: tad u vā āhus | yo vā apathena pratipadyate sthāṇuṃ vā hanti gartaṃ vā patati bhreṣam̐ sa nyeti
16.9.256.d: तद् उ वा आहुस् । यो वा अपथेन प्रतिपद्यते स्थाणुं वा हन्ति गर्तं वा पतति भ्रेषँ स न्येति
16.9.256.m: And regarding that they also say: "Whoever sets out on a non-path strikes against a post or falls into a pit; he incurs failure."
"They should creep only by the path of the vaṣaṭ call;

16.9.256.s: eṣa vāva svargyaḥ panthā yad vaṣaṭkārapathas | iti
16.9.256.d: एष वाव स्वर्ग्यः पन्था यद् वषट्कारपथस् । इति
16.9.256.m: for this is the heavenly path, namely the path of the vaṣaṭ call."

16.9.256.s: tad u vā āhuḥ parāṅ iva vā eṣo 'śāntaḥ panthā yad vaṣaṭkārapathas |
16.9.256.d: तद् उ वा आहुः पराङ् इव वा एषो ऽशान्तः पन्था यद् वषट्कारपथस् ।
16.9.256.m: And regarding that they also say: "This path of the vaṣaṭ call is as if turned away, unappeased.

16.9.256.s: adhvaryupathenaiva sarpeyur eṣa vā arvācaḥ parācaḥ svargyaḥ panthā yad adhvaryupathas | iti
16.9.256.d: अध्वर्युपथेनैव सर्पेयुर् एष वा अर्वाचः पराचः स्वर्ग्यः पन्था यद् अध्वर्युपथस् । इति
16.9.256.m: They should creep only by the adhvaryu priest's path, for this path of the adhvaryu priest is the heavenly path leading hither and thither."

16.9.256.s: te 'dhvaryupathenaiva sarpanti teṣu samanvārabdheṣv āhavanīye sruvāhutiṃ juhoti | upasṛjan mātre vatsaṃ dhārayan dharuṇo dhayan | rāyaspoṣam iṣam ūrjam asmāsu dīdharat svāhā | iti
16.9.256.d: ते ऽध्वर्युपथेनैव सर्पन्ति तेषु समन्वारब्धेष्व् आहवनीये स्रुवाहुतिं जुहोति । उपसृजन् मात्रे वत्सं धारयन् धरुणो धयन् । रायस्पोषम् इषम् ऊर्जम् अस्मासु दीधरत् स्वाहा । इति
16.9.256.m:
They creep only by the adhvaryu priest's path.
While they remain in contact from behind, he offers a ladle libation in the āhavanīya fire: "Letting loose the calf to the mother, suckling, the supporter suckling, may he maintain abundant wealth, food, and sap among us, hail!"

16.9.256.s: samutkramya cātvāladeśe japanti vāg aitu vāg upaitu vāṅ mopaitu vāg yad akarma yan nākarma yad atyagāma yan nātyagāma yad atyarīricāma yan nātyarīricāma prajāpatau prajāpatiṃ tat pitaram apyetu | iti
16.9.256.d: समुत्क्रम्य चात्वालदेशे जपन्ति वाग् ऐतु वाग् उपैतु वाङ् मोपैतु वाग् यद् अकर्म यन् नाकर्म यद् अत्यगाम यन् नात्यगाम यद् अत्यरीरिचाम यन् नात्यरीरिचाम प्रजापतौ प्रजापतिं तत् पितरम् अप्येतु । इति
16.9.256.m: Having stepped out, they mutter at the place of the pit: "May speech come; may speech approach; may speech not desert me. What we did and what we did not do, what we transgressed and what we did not transgress, what we left over and what we did not leave over, may that go to Father Prajāpati in Prajāpati."

16.9.256.s: tad vācy antataḥ pratitiṣṭhanti teṣāṃ ya eva prāyaṇīyo 'tirātraḥ sa udayanīyaḥ
16.9.256.d: तद् वाच्य् अन्ततः प्रतितिष्ठन्ति तेषां य एव प्रायणीयो ऽतिरात्रः स उदयनीयः
16.9.256.m:
In that speech they finally become established.
For them, that which is the opening atirātra is the concluding [atirātra].

16.9.256.s: sattrād udavasāya jyotiṣṭomenāgniṣṭomena catuṣṭomena pṛṣṭhaśamanīyena sahasradakṣiṇenaikaiko yajeta ||
16.9.256.d: सत्त्राद् उदवसाय ज्योतिष्टोमेनाग्निष्टोमेन चतुष्टोमेन पृष्ठशमनीयेन सहस्रदक्षिणेनैकैको यजेत ॥
16.9.256.m: Having moved away from the sacrificial session, each one should sacrifice with a jyotiṣṭoma agniṣṭoma having four stomaphases, pacifying the pṛṣṭha stotras, with a thousand cows as dakṣiṇā.

16.10.257.s: athāto grahakḷpter eva mīmām̐sā | aindravāyavāgraṃ prathamam ahaḥ
16.10.257.d: अथातो ग्रहकॢप्तेर् एव मीमाँसा । ऐन्द्रवायवाग्रं प्रथमम् अहः
16.10.257.m:
Now follows the inquiry into the arrangement of soma-cups:
The first day begins with the cup for Indra and Vāyu.

16.10.257.s: śukrāgraṃ dvitīyam āgrayaṇāgraṃ tṛtīyaṃ ca caturthaṃ ca | aindravāyavāgraṃ pañcamam ahaḥ
16.10.257.d: शुक्राग्रं द्वितीयम् आग्रयणाग्रं तृतीयं च चतुर्थं च । ऐन्द्रवायवाग्रं पञ्चमम् अहः

16.10.257.s: śukrāgram̐ ṣaṣṭhaṃ ca saptamaṃ ca | āgrayaṇāgramaṣṭamam ahar aindravāyavāgre navamadaśame
16.10.257.d: शुक्राग्रँ षष्ठं च सप्तमं च । आग्रयणाग्रमष्टमम् अहर् ऐन्द्रवायवाग्रे नवमदशमे

16.10.257.m:
Thus far according to the adhvaryu priest;
now according to the chanter and the ṛgvedic priest:
The first three-day period has the gāyatrī for the morning pressing, the triṣṭubh for the midday, and the jagatī for the third pressing.
The second three-day period has the jagatī for the morning pressing, the gāyatrī for the midday, and the triṣṭubh for the third pressing.

16.10.257.s: triṣṭupprātaḥsavanas tṛtīyas trirātro jaganmādhyaṃdino gāyatrītṛtīyasavana iti
16.10.257.d: त्रिष्टुप्प्रातःसवनस् तृतीयस् त्रिरात्रो जगन्माध्यंदिनो गायत्रीतृतीयसवन इति
16.10.257.m: The third three-day period has the triṣṭubh for the morning pressing, the jagatī for the midday, and the gāyatrī for the third pressing.
Therefore, they proceed possessing harmonious metres.

16.11.258.s: athātaḥ paśukḷpter eva mīmām̐sā | aindrāgnāḥ paśavaḥ syur ity eka āhur
16.11.258.d: अथातः पशुकॢप्तेर् एव मीमाँसा । ऐन्द्राग्नाः पशवः स्युर् इत्य् एक आहुर्
16.11.258.m: Now then, indeed, follows the inquiry concerning the arrangement of the victims: Some say: "The victims should be dedicated to Indra-and-Agni.

16.11.258.s: agner ayaṃ loko vāyor antarikṣam asāv indrasya yad aindrāgnaḥ paśur bhavati vāyavyo vasāhoma imān eva tal lokān prīṇanta eṣu lokeṣu pratitiṣṭhanto yanti |
16.11.258.d: अग्नेर् अयं लोको वायोर् अन्तरिक्षम् असाव् इन्द्रस्य यद् ऐन्द्राग्नः पशुर् भवति वायव्यो वसाहोम इमान् एव तल् लोकान् प्रीणन्त एषु लोकेषु प्रतितिष्ठन्तो यन्ति ।
16.11.258.m: This world belongs to Agni, the intermediate space to Vāyu, that [sky] to Indra. In that there is a victim dedicated to Indra-and-Agni, and the offering of fat belongs to Vāyu, thus pleasing these worlds, they proceed establishing themselves firmly in these worlds.

16.11.258.s: atha ye 'naindrāgnān pratipadyante yathā śreyase 'nāhṛtya pāpīyasa āharanti tādṛk tat
16.11.258.d: अथ ये ऽनैन्द्राग्नान् प्रतिपद्यन्ते यथा श्रेयसे ऽनाहृत्य पापीयस आहरन्ति तादृक् तत्
16.11.258.m: Now, those who adopt [victims] not dedicated to Indra-and-Agni, that is just as if they fetch [food] for the worse without fetching [it] for the better.

16.11.258.s: tasmād aindrāgnāḥ paśavaḥ syur ity etad ekam
16.11.258.d: तस्माद् ऐन्द्राग्नाः पशवः स्युर् इत्य् एतद् एकम्
16.11.258.m: Therefore, the victims should be dedicated to Indra-and-Agni: this is one [view].
[Others say:] There should be the atirātra victims on both outer sides, and those dedicated to Indra-and-Agni in the middle.

16.11.258.s: ekādaśinā abhito madhya aindrāgnāḥ sarvāgneyā eva syur ity etad ekam |
16.11.258.d: एकादशिना अभितो मध्य ऐन्द्राग्नाः सर्वाग्नेया एव स्युर् इत्य् एतद् एकम् ।
16.11.258.m: [Others say:] There should be sets of eleven on both outer sides, and those dedicated to Indra-and-Agni in the middle. "They should all be dedicated to Agni only": this is one [view].

16.11.258.s: sarvaindrā eva syur ity etad ekam | sarvaprājāpatyā eva syur ity etad ekam |
16.11.258.d: सर्वैन्द्रा एव स्युर् इत्य् एतद् एकम् । सर्वप्राजापत्या एव स्युर् इत्य् एतद् एकम् ।
16.11.258.m: "They should all be dedicated to Indra only": this is one [view]. "They should all be dedicated to Prajāpati only": this is one [view].

16.11.258.s: sarvaikādaśinā eva syur ity etad aparam |
16.11.258.d: सर्वैकादशिना एव स्युर् इत्य् एतद् अपरम् ।
16.11.258.m: "They should all consist only of sets of eleven": this is another [view].

16.11.258.s: teṣām̐ sarvaikādaśinair yatāṃ prasiddham eva prathame 'hani prathamām ekādaśinīm ālabhanta āgneyasya vāruṇam upālambhyaṃ kurvanti
16.11.258.d: तेषाँ सर्वैकादशिनैर् यतां प्रसिद्धम् एव प्रथमे ऽहनि प्रथमाम् एकादशिनीम् आलभन्त आग्नेयस्य वारुणम् उपालम्भ्यं कुर्वन्ति
16.11.258.m: For those proceeding with all sets of eleven, according to the established manner they seize the first set of eleven on the first day; they make an additional victim dedicated to Varuṇa for the victim dedicated to Agni.

16.11.259.s: tathā syaitāni daśa madhyamāny ahāny anatiricyamānāḥ paśavo 'nubhavanti
16.11.259.d: तथा स्यैतानि दश मध्यमान्य् अहान्य् अनतिरिच्यमानाः पशवो ऽनुभवन्ति
16.11.259.m: Thus, the victims, without being superfluous, suffice for these ten middle days.

16.11.259.s: prasiddham evottame 'hany uttamām ekādaśinīm ālabhante | āgneyasya vā vāruṇasya vā vaiśvadevam upālambhyaṃ kurvanti ||
16.11.259.d: प्रसिद्धम् एवोत्तमे ऽहन्य् उत्तमाम् एकादशिनीम् आलभन्ते । आग्नेयस्य वा वारुणस्य वा वैश्वदेवम् उपालम्भ्यं कुर्वन्ति ॥
16.11.259.m: According to the established manner, on the last day they seize the last set of eleven; they make an additional victim dedicated to the All-gods for the one dedicated to Agni, or for the one dedicated to Varuṇa.

16.12.259.s: tad u vā āhus | yad dvādaśa dīkṣā dvādaśopasado dvādaśāhaṃ prasutāḥ katham asyaitāny ahānīṣṭāny āprītāni paśumanti bhavanti | iti
16.12.259.d: तद् उ वा आहुस् । यद् द्वादश दीक्षा द्वादशोपसदो द्वादशाहं प्रसुताः कथम् अस्यैतान्य् अहानीष्टान्य् आप्रीतानि पशुमन्ति भवन्ति । इति
16.12.259.m: Concerning this they indeed say: "When there are twelve consecrations, twelve upasads, and they perform soma pressings for twelve days, how do these days of his become sacrificed, propitiated, and endowed with victims?"
There are three sets of eleven, the victim dedicated to Agni-and-Soma, the one dedicated to the All-gods, and the anūbandhyā cow.

16.12.259.s: ṣaṭtrim̐śatam ete paśavaḥ ṣaṭtrim̐śatam etāny ahāni | evam asyaitāny ahānīṣṭāny āprītāni paśumanti bhavanti | iti
16.12.259.d: षट्त्रिँशतम् एते पशवः षट्त्रिँशतम् एतान्य् अहानि । एवम् अस्यैतान्य् अहानीष्टान्य् आप्रीतानि पशुमन्ति भवन्ति । इति
16.12.259.m: These victims are thirty-six; these days are thirty-six. "Thus do these days of his become sacrificed, propitiated, and endowed with victims."

16.12.259.s: tad u vā āhus | yad dvādaśa dīkṣā dvādaśopasado dvādaśāhaṃ prasutāḥ kathaṃ dvādaśāhena saṃvatsara āpyate | iti
16.12.259.d: तद् उ वा आहुस् । यद् द्वादश दीक्षा द्वादशोपसदो द्वादशाहं प्रसुताः कथं द्वादशाहेन संवत्सर आप्यते । इति
16.12.259.m: Concerning this they indeed say: "When there are twelve consecrations, twelve upasads, and they perform soma pressings for twelve days, how is the year obtained by the twelve-day rite?"
There are twelve full moons, twelve aṣṭakā days, and twelve new moons.

16.12.259.s: etāni ha vai saṃvatsarasya varṣiṣṭhāny ahāni | etāny anu saṃvatsara āpyate
16.12.259.d: एतानि ह वै संवत्सरस्य वर्षिष्ठान्य् अहानि । एतान्य् अनु संवत्सर आप्यते
16.12.259.m: These, truly, are the greatest days of the year; through these the year is obtained.

16.12.260.m: The twelve-day rite is concluded; the desire for the year is concluded.
In this way the year is obtained by the twelve-day rite.

16.13.260.s: saṃvatsarāya dīkṣiṣyamāṇāḥ samavasyanti tad dha smaitat pūrve saṃvatsaram̐ samavasāyāsate 'nyo'nyasyānūktaṃ ca mānuṣaṃ ca vijijñāsamānās |
16.13.260.d: संवत्सराय दीक्षिष्यमाणाः समवस्यन्ति तद् ध स्मैतत् पूर्वे संवत्सरँ समवसायासते ऽन्योऽन्यस्यानूक्तं च मानुषं च विजिज्ञासमानास् ।
16.13.260.m: Those about to be consecrated for a year settle together. In ancient times, indeed, they used to dwell settled together for a year, wishing to learn each other's recited knowledge and human customs.

16.13.260.s: uto hy ekaḥ śamarathasya kartā bhavati te caturahe purastān māghyai paurṇamāsyai dīkṣante
16.13.260.d: उतो ह्य् एकः शमरथस्य कर्ता भवति ते चतुरहे पुरस्तान् माघ्यै पौर्णमास्यै दीक्षन्ते
16.13.260.m: Moreover, one becomes the maker of peaceful progress. They undergo consecration four days before the Māghī full moon.
For them, the purchase [of soma] takes place on the ekāṣṭakā day.

16.13.260.s: iti nu yadi samāmavijñāya dīkṣante yady u vā etasyām evaikāṣṭakāyām̐ samāṃ vijijñāsante caturaha eva purastāt phālgunyai vā caitryai vā paurṇamāsyai dīkṣante
16.13.260.d: इति नु यदि समामविज्ञाय दीक्षन्ते यद्य् उ वा एतस्याम् एवैकाष्टकायाँ समां विजिज्ञासन्ते चतुरह एव पुरस्तात् फाल्गुन्यै वा चैत्र्यै वा पौर्णमास्यै दीक्षन्ते
16.13.260.m: This is so if they undergo consecration without determining the season. But if they wish to determine the season on this very ekāṣṭakā day, they undergo consecration four days before either the Phālgunī or the Caitrī full moon.
For them, the purchase [of soma] takes place on the eighth day of the dark fortnight.

16.13.260.s: tenaikāṣṭakāṃ na chambakurvanti teṣāṃ pūrvapakṣe sutyā saṃpadyate
16.13.260.d: तेनैकाष्टकां न छम्बकुर्वन्ति तेषां पूर्वपक्षे सुत्या संपद्यते
16.13.260.m: Thereby they do not mutilate the ekāṣṭakā. For them, the soma pressing takes place in the bright fortnight.

16.13.260.s: pūrvapakṣaṃ māsā abhi saṃpadyante pūrvapakṣe prasavaḥ pūrvapakṣe vaiṣuvataṃ pūrvapakṣa utthānam |
16.13.260.d: पूर्वपक्षं मासा अभि संपद्यन्ते पूर्वपक्षे प्रसवः पूर्वपक्षे वैषुवतं पूर्वपक्ष उत्थानम् ।
16.13.260.m: The months correspond to the bright fortnight; the soma pressing is in the bright fortnight, the solstice day in the bright fortnight, the concluding rising in the bright fortnight.
The ritual is identical to that of the twelve-day rite.

16.13.260.s: tathaiva ṣaṣṭhyām upasady uttaravedim̐ saṃnivapanti yady anagnicityaṃ bhavati |
16.13.260.d: तथैव षष्ठ्याम् उपसद्य् उत्तरवेदिँ संनिवपन्ति यद्य् अनग्निचित्यं भवति ।
16.13.260.m: In the same manner, they pour out the high altar on the sixth upasad if it is without a fire altar piling.

16.13.260.s: atha yadi sāgnicityaṃ prathamāyām evopasady uttaravedim̐ saṃnivapanti ||
16.13.260.d: अथ यदि साग्निचित्यं प्रथमायाम् एवोपसद्य् उत्तरवेदिँ संनिवपन्ति ॥
16.13.260.m: Then, if it is with a fire altar piling, they pour out the high altar on the very first upasad.

16.14.261.s: teṣāṃ dvādaśa dīkṣā dvādaśopasadaḥ saṃvatsaraṃ prasutās | na saṃvatsare 'gniṃ cinvītety eka āhus |
16.14.261.d: तेषां द्वादश दीक्षा द्वादशोपसदः संवत्सरं प्रसुतास् । न संवत्सरे ऽग्निं चिन्वीतेत्य् एक आहुस् ।
16.14.261.m: For them, there are twelve consecrations, twelve upasads, and they press soma for a year. Some say: "One should not pile the fire altar in a year-long rite."

16.14.261.s: cinvata u haike prasiddhena karmaṇopavasathād yanti
16.14.261.d: चिन्वत उ हैके प्रसिद्धेन कर्मणोपवसथाद् यन्ति
16.14.261.m: Others indeed pile it. They proceed from the fast-day according to the established procedure.

16.14.261.s: teṣāṃ prasiddhaṃ jyotiṣṭomo vaiśvānaraḥ prāyaṇīyo 'tirātraḥ saṃtiṣṭhate
16.14.261.d: तेषां प्रसिद्धं ज्योतिष्टोमो वैश्वानरः प्रायणीयो ऽतिरात्रः संतिष्ठते
16.14.261.m: For them, the introductory atirātra, the jyotiṣṭoma dedicated to Vaiśvānara, is concluded in the established manner.

16.14.261.s: tasmin sam̐sthite caturvim̐śam ukthyam ārambhaṇīyam ubhayasāmānam upayanti |
16.14.261.d: तस्मिन् सँस्थिते चतुर्विँशम् उक्थ्यम् आरम्भणीयम् उभयसामानम् उपयन्ति ।
16.14.261.m: When that is concluded, they undertake the twenty-four-stoma ukthya, the introductory day, having both samans.
Then they undertake the abhiplava six-day period.

16.14.261.s: jyotir agniṣṭomo gaur ukthya āyur ukthyo gaur ukthya āyur ukthyo jyotir agniṣṭomas
16.14.261.d: ज्योतिर् अग्निष्टोमो गौर् उक्थ्य आयुर् उक्थ्यो गौर् उक्थ्य आयुर् उक्थ्यो ज्योतिर् अग्निष्टोमस्
16.14.261.m: It is: jyotis-agniṣṭoma, go-ukthya, āyus-ukthya, go-ukthya, āyus-ukthya, jyotis-agniṣṭoma.

16.14.261.s: taṃ catur upayanti rathaṃtaraṃbṛhadrathaṃtaraṃbṛhad iti viparyāsaṃ pṛṣṭhe bhavataḥ
16.14.261.d: तं चतुर् उपयन्ति रथंतरंबृहद्रथंतरंबृहद् इति विपर्यासं पृष्ठे भवतः
16.14.261.m: They perform that four times. Alternating as 'rathaṃtara, bṛhat, rathaṃtara, bṛhat', the two pṛṣṭha stotras take place.
Then follows the pṛṣṭhya six-day period; that constitutes a month.

16.14.261.s: tenaivam̐ saṃpannena pañca māsān yanti | athaitam̐ ṣaṣṭhaṃ māsam̐ saṃbhāryam̐ saṃbharanti
16.14.261.d: तेनैवँ संपन्नेन पञ्च मासान् यन्ति । अथैतँ षष्ठं मासँ संभार्यँ संभरन्ति
16.14.261.m: Arranged in this manner, they proceed for five months; then they collect this sixth month, which consists of collected rites.

16.14.261.d: त्रयो ऽभिप्लवाः षडहास् तान्य् अष्टादशाहानि प्रायणीयारम्भणीयौ
16.14.261.m: There are three abhiplava six-day periods, which make eighteen days, and the introductory and opening days.

16.14.261.s: tāni vim̐śatir ahāni pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍaho 'bhijittrayaḥ paraḥsāmānaḥ
16.14.261.d: तानि विँशतिर् अहानि पृष्ठ्यः षडहो ऽभिजित्त्रयः परःसामानः
16.14.261.m: Those are twenty days. The pṛṣṭhya six-day period, the abhijit day, [and] the three paraḥsāman days;

16.14.261.s: sa māsas | atha vaiṣuvatam athaitaṃ vaiṣuvate 'hany ekavim̐śam agniṣṭomam upayanti bṛhatsāmānam |
16.14.261.d: स मासस् । अथ वैषुवतम् अथैतं वैषुवते ऽहन्य् एकविँशम् अग्निष्टोमम् उपयन्ति बृहत्सामानम् ।
16.14.261.m: that is the month. Now the vaiṣuvata day. Now on the vaiṣuvata day they perform the twenty-one-fold agniṣṭoma having the bṛhat as its saman;

16.14.261.d: तस्य सौर्यो ऽतिग्राह्यः सौर्यः पशुर् उपालम्भ्यस्
16.14.261.m: for it, an additional cup for Sūrya is to be drawn, an animal for Sūrya is to be immolated.

16.14.261.s: tad dhaitad eke divaivaitenāhnā pratipadyanta udita āditye divākīrtyam ahar iti vadantas |
16.14.261.d: तद् धैतद् एके दिवैवैतेनाह्ना प्रतिपद्यन्त उदित आदित्ये दिवाकीर्त्यम् अहर् इति वदन्तस् ।
16.14.261.m: Regarding this, some begin [the ritual] with this day only by day, when the sun has risen, saying, "It is a day praised by day."

16.14.261.s: yathaivānyeṣām ahnām evam upākuryād iti maudgalyas
16.14.261.d: यथैवान्येषाम् अह्नाम् एवम् उपाकुर्याद् इति मौद्गल्यस्
16.14.261.m: Maudgalya says: 'One should begin it just like the other days.'

16.14.261.s: tasya mahādivākīrtyam̐ hotuḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ vikarṇaṃ brahmasāmaṃ bhāso 'gniṣṭomas |
16.14.261.d: तस्य महादिवाकीर्त्यँ होतुः पृष्ठं विकर्णं ब्रह्मसामं भासो ऽग्निष्टोमस् ।
16.14.261.m: Of this, the mahādivākīrtya saman is the pṛṣṭha chant of the hotṛ priest, the vikarṇa saman is the saman of the brahman priest, and the bhāsa saman is the agniṣṭoma chant.
Then, after the vaiṣuvata day, they perform the three reversed svara days.

16.14.261.s: atha viśvajitam upayanti | athāvṛttaṃ pṛṣṭhyam̐ ṣaḍaham upayanti
16.14.261.d: अथ विश्वजितम् उपयन्ति । अथावृत्तं पृष्ठ्यँ षडहम् उपयन्ति
16.14.261.m: Then they perform the viśvajit day. Then they perform the reversed pṛṣṭhya six-day period.

16.14.262.s: trayastrim̐śaprabhṛtyāgrayaṇāgram etad ahar bhavati | athāvṛttam evābhiplavam̐ ṣaḍaham upayanti ||
16.14.262.d: त्रयस्त्रिँशप्रभृत्याग्रयणाग्रम् एतद् अहर् भवति । अथावृत्तम् एवाभिप्लवँ षडहम् उपयन्ति ॥
16.14.262.m: This day begins with the thirty-three-fold stoma and has the āgrayaṇa cup as the first. Then they perform the reversed abhiplava six-day period.

16.15.262.s: jyotir agniṣṭoma āyur ukthyo gaur ukthya āyur ukthyo gaur ukthyo jyotir evāgniṣṭomas
16.15.262.d: ज्योतिर् अग्निष्टोम आयुर् उक्थ्यो गौर् उक्थ्य आयुर् उक्थ्यो गौर् उक्थ्यो ज्योतिर् एवाग्निष्टोमस्
16.15.262.m: A jyotiṣ-agniṣṭoma, an āyus-ukthya, a go-ukthya, an āyus-ukthya, a go-ukthya, [and] a jyotiṣ-agniṣṭoma;

16.15.262.s: taṃ tathaiva catur upayanti bṛhadrathaṃtaraṃbṛhadrathaṃtaram iti viparyāsaṃ pṛṣṭhe bhavataḥ
16.15.262.d: तं तथैव चतुर् उपयन्ति बृहद्रथंतरंबृहद्रथंतरम् इति विपर्यासं पृष्ठे भवतः
16.15.262.m: they perform it four times just like that. The two pṛṣṭha chants are alternating: bṛhat, rathaṃtara, bṛhat, rathaṃtara.
The pṛṣṭhya six-day period is in the beginning. That is a month.

16.15.262.s: tenaivam̐ saṃpannena pañca māsān yanti | athaitmam̐ ṣaṣṭhaṃ māsam̐ saṃbhāryam̐ saṃbharanti
16.15.262.d: तेनैवँ संपन्नेन पञ्च मासान् यन्ति । अथैत्मँ षष्ठं मासँ संभार्यँ संभरन्ति
16.15.262.m: Completed in this way, they proceed for five months. Then they assemble this sixth assembled month.
Two abhiplava six-day periods: those are twelve days.

16.15.262.s: goāyuṣī tāni caturdaśa catvāry ūrdhvaṃ vaiṣuvatāt tāny aṣṭādaśa
16.15.262.d: गोआयुषी तानि चतुर्दश चत्वार्य् ऊर्ध्वं वैषुवतात् तान्य् अष्टादश
16.15.262.m: The go and āyus days: those are fourteen. Four [days] after the vaiṣuvata day: those are eighteen.

16.15.262.s: daśarātro mahāvrataṃ cātirātraś ca sa māsas tad etan māsipṛṣṭhaṃ gavāmayanam ||
16.15.262.d: दशरात्रो महाव्रतं चातिरात्रश् च स मासस् तद् एतन् मासिपृष्ठं गवामयनम् ॥
16.15.262.m: The ten-day period, the mahāvrata day, and the atirātra day: that is the month. This is the Gavāmayana with monthly pṛṣṭha rites.

16.16.262.s: anutsargaṃ bṛhadrathaṃtarābhyām itvottame māsi sakṛtpṛṣṭhāny upeyus
16.16.262.d: अनुत्सर्गं बृहद्रथंतराभ्याम् इत्वोत्तमे मासि सकृत्पृष्ठान्य् उपेयुस्
16.16.262.m: Having gone without omission with the bṛhat and the rathaṃtara samans, they should perform the pṛṣṭha rites once in the last month;

16.16.262.s: tad dvitīyaṃ gavāmayanam | daśamāsyaṃ tṛtīyam abhiplavāś cākṣīyanti ca tad aṅgirasāmayanam |
16.16.262.d: तद् द्वितीयं गवामयनम् । दशमास्यं तृतीयम् अभिप्लवाश् चाक्षीयन्ति च तद् अङ्गिरसामयनम् ।
16.16.262.m: that is the second Gavāmayana. The third has ten months. If they consist of abhiplava periods and do not decline, that is the Aṅgirasāmayana.
If they consist of pṛṣṭhya periods and do not decline, that is the Ādityānāmayana.

16.16.262.s: agniṣṭomāś cākṣīyanti ca tat prajāpaterayanam | prāyaṇīyodayanīyāv abhito madhye 'gniṣṭomās tad dvitīyaṃ prajāpaterayanam |
16.16.262.d: अग्निष्टोमाश् चाक्षीयन्ति च तत् प्रजापतेरयनम् । प्रायणीयोदयनीयाव् अभितो मध्ये ऽग्निष्टोमास् तद् द्वितीयं प्रजापतेरयनम् ।
16.16.262.m: If they consist of agniṣṭomas and do not decline, that is the Prajāpaterayana. If the introductory and concluding days are on both sides and agniṣṭomas in the middle, that is the second Prajāpaterayana.

16.16.262.s: sarvāgniṣṭomā eva syur iti tat tṛtīyaṃ prajāpaterayanam athāto grahakḷpter eva mīmām̐sā
16.16.262.d: सर्वाग्निष्टोमा एव स्युर् इति तत् तृतीयं प्रजापतेरयनम् अथातो ग्रहकॢप्तेर् एव मीमाँसा
16.16.262.m: They should be all agniṣṭomas only: that is the third Prajāpaterayana. Now then begins the inquiry into the arrangement of soma-cups.

16.16.263.s: tad dhaitad eke sārasvatavaiṣṇavau grahau gṛhṇanti prāyaṇīyād evāgre 'trirātrādodayanīyādvāgvai sarasvatī yajño viṣṇus te vācaṃ caiva yajñaṃ ca madhyataḥ parigṛhyānārtā udṛcaṃ gamiṣyāma iti vadantas
16.16.263.d: तद् धैतद् एके सारस्वतवैष्णवौ ग्रहौ गृह्णन्ति प्रायणीयाद् एवाग्रे ऽत्रिरात्रादोदयनीयाद्वाग्वै सरस्वती यज्ञो विष्णुस् ते वाचं चैव यज्ञं च मध्यतः परिगृह्यानार्ता उदृचं गमिष्याम इति वदन्तस्
16.16.263.m: Regarding this, some draw the two cups for Sarasvatī and Viṣṇu right from the introductory atirātra up to the concluding day, saying: 'Speech is Sarasvatī, sacrifice is Viṣṇu; grasping both speech and the sacrifice from the middle, we shall attain the completion unharmed.'

16.16.263.s: tad u vā āhus | yad vācā yajñas tāyate tena sarasvatyāptā yad u yajñas tena viṣṇus |
16.16.263.d: तद् उ वा आहुस् । यद् वाचा यज्ञस् तायते तेन सरस्वत्याप्ता यद् उ यज्ञस् तेन विष्णुस् ।
16.16.263.m: Regarding that, however, they say: 'In that the sacrifice is extended by speech, thereby Sarasvatī is attained; in that it is the sacrifice, thereby Viṣṇu is attained.'
Indeed, we have no brāhmaṇa passage:

16.16.263.s: sārasvatavaiṣṇavau grahau gṛhṇīyāt | iti naitad ādriyeta
16.16.263.d: सारस्वतवैष्णवौ ग्रहौ गृह्णीयात् । इति नैतद् आद्रियेत
16.16.263.m: 'One should draw two cups for Sarasvatī and Viṣṇu'—one should not respect this [practice].

16.17.263.s: athāto 'm̐śvadābhyayor eva grahaṇam | prāyaṇīye 'dābhyaṃ gṛhṇīyād am̐śuṃ vaiṣuvate 'dābhyaṃ mahāvrata ubhau prāyaṇīya ubhau vaiṣuvata ubhau mahāvrate
16.17.263.d: अथातो ऽँश्वदाभ्ययोर् एव ग्रहणम् । प्रायणीये ऽदाभ्यं गृह्णीयाद् अँशुं वैषुवते ऽदाभ्यं महाव्रत उभौ प्रायणीय उभौ वैषुवत उभौ महाव्रते
16.17.263.m: Now then begins the drawing of the aṃśu and adābhya cups. One should draw the adābhya cup on the introductory day, the aṃśu cup on the vaiṣuvata day, [and] the adābhya cup on the mahāvrata day; or both on the introductory day, both on the vaiṣuvata day, [and] both on the mahāvrata day;

16.17.263.s: yatra kva caivainau gṛhṇīyād ity etad aparam
16.17.263.d: यत्र क्व चैवैनौ गृह्णीयाद् इत्य् एतद् अपरम्
16.17.263.m: or one may draw them wherever: this is another [view].

16.17.263.s: athātaḥ paraḥsāmnām eva grahaṇam | te vā ete paraḥsāmānaḥ purastād vaiṣuvatāt tryaham anvaham itaḥ parāñco gṛhyante | upayāmagṛhīto 'sy adbhyas tvauṣadhībhyo juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmi | upayāmagṛhīto 'sy oṣadhībhyas tvā prajābhyo juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmi | upayāmagṛhīto 'si prajābhyas tvā prajāpataye juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmi | iti |
16.17.263.d: अथातः परःसाम्नाम् एव ग्रहणम् । ते वा एते परःसामानः पुरस्ताद् वैषुवतात् त्र्यहम् अन्वहम् इतः पराञ्चो गृह्यन्ते । उपयामगृहीतो ऽस्य् अद्भ्यस् त्वौषधीभ्यो जुष्टं गृह्णामि । उपयामगृहीतो ऽस्य् ओषधीभ्यस् त्वा प्रजाभ्यो जुष्टं गृह्णामि । उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि प्रजाभ्यस् त्वा प्रजापतये जुष्टं गृह्णामि । इति ।
16.17.263.m: Now then begins the drawing of the cups of the paraḥsāman days. These paraḥsāman cups are drawn before the vaiṣuvata day for three days, day after day, in forward order from here: 'You are taken with a support; for the waters, for the plants, I take you, acceptable'; 'You are taken with a support; for the plants, for offspring, I take you, acceptable'; 'You are taken with a support; for offspring, for Prajāpati, I take you, acceptable.'

16.17.264.d: अथ वैषुवते ऽह्नि शुक्राग्रा ग्रहा गृह्यन्ते
16.17.264.m: Then on the vaiṣuvata day, the soma-cups are drawn beginning with the śukra cup.

16.17.264.s: samānaṃ karmāgrayaṇād grahāt | āgrayaṇaṃ gṛhītvā trīn paraḥsāmno gṛhṇāti | upayāmagṛhīto 'sy adbhyas tvauṣadhībhyo juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmi | upayāmagṛhīto 'sy oṣadhībhyas tvā prajābhyo juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmi | upayāmagṛhīto 'si prajābhyas tvā prajāpataye juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmi | iti |
16.17.264.d: समानं कर्माग्रयणाद् ग्रहात् । आग्रयणं गृहीत्वा त्रीन् परःसाम्नो गृह्णाति । उपयामगृहीतो ऽस्य् अद्भ्यस् त्वौषधीभ्यो जुष्टं गृह्णामि । उपयामगृहीतो ऽस्य् ओषधीभ्यस् त्वा प्रजाभ्यो जुष्टं गृह्णामि । उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि प्रजाभ्यस् त्वा प्रजापतये जुष्टं गृह्णामि । इति ।
16.17.264.m: The ritual procedure is the same up to the āgrayaṇa cup. Having drawn the āgrayaṇa cup, he draws three paraḥsāman cups: 'You are taken with a support; for the waters, for the plants, I take you, acceptable'; 'You are taken with a support; for the plants, for offspring, I take you, acceptable'; 'You are taken with a support; for offspring, for Prajāpati, I take you, acceptable.'
Then with a verse addressed to Sūrya, he draws an additional cup for Sūrya.

16.18.264.s: taraṇir viśvadarśatas | ity anudrutya | upayāmagṛhīto 'si sūryāya tvā bhrājasvate juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmi | iti
16.18.264.d: तरणिर् विश्वदर्शतस् । इत्य् अनुद्रुत्य । उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि सूर्याय त्वा भ्राजस्वते जुष्टं गृह्णामि । इति
16.18.264.m: Having recited along: 'The swift, visible to all...', [he draws it with]: 'You are taken with a support; for the radiant Sūrya I take you, acceptable.'

16.18.264.s: parimṛjya sādayati | eṣa te yoniḥ sūryāya tvā bhrājasvate | iti |
16.18.264.d: परिमृज्य सादयति । एष ते योनिः सूर्याय त्वा भ्राजस्वते । इति ।
16.18.264.m: Having wiped it around, he sets it down with: 'This is your womb; for the radiant Sūrya [I set] you.'

16.18.264.s: athāvṛttān gṛhṇāti | upayāmagṛhīto 'si prajābhyas tvā prajāpataye juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmi | upayāmagṛhito 'sy oṣadhībhyas tvā prajābhyo juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmi | upayāmagṛhīto 'sy adbhyas tvauṣadhībhyo juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmi | iti
16.18.264.d: अथावृत्तान् गृह्णाति । उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि प्रजाभ्यस् त्वा प्रजापतये जुष्टं गृह्णामि । उपयामगृहितो ऽस्य् ओषधीभ्यस् त्वा प्रजाभ्यो जुष्टं गृह्णामि । उपयामगृहीतो ऽस्य् अद्भ्यस् त्वौषधीभ्यो जुष्टं गृह्णामि । इति
16.18.264.m: Then he draws them reversed: 'You are taken with a support; for offspring, for Prajāpati, I take you, acceptable'; 'You are taken with a support; for the plants, for offspring, I take you, acceptable'; 'You are taken with a support; for the waters, for the plants, I take you, acceptable.'

16.18.264.s: saptaitad ahar atigrāhyā gṛhyante | iti brāhmaṇam
16.18.264.d: सप्तैतद् अहर् अतिग्राह्या गृह्यन्ते । इति ब्राह्मणम्
16.18.264.m: 'Seven additional cups are drawn on this day,' says the brāhmaṇa passage.

16.18.264.s: athordhvaṃ vaiṣuvatāt tryaham anvaham āvṛttān eva gṛhṇāti vaiśvakarmaṇādityābhyāṃ viparyāsam
16.18.264.d: अथोर्ध्वं वैषुवतात् त्र्यहम् अन्वहम् आवृत्तान् एव गृह्णाति वैश्वकर्मणादित्याभ्यां विपर्यासम्
16.18.264.m: Then, after the vaiṣuvata day, for three days, day after day, he draws them precisely reversed, alternating with [the cups for] Viśvakarman and Aditi:

16.18.264.s: upayāmagṛhīto 'si prajābhyas tvā prajāpataye juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmi | iti |
16.18.264.d: उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि प्रजाभ्यस् त्वा प्रजापतये जुष्टं गृह्णामि । इति ।
16.18.264.m: 'You are taken with a support; for offspring, for Prajāpati, I take you, acceptable.'

16.18.264.s: atha vaiśvakarmaṇam | viśvakarman haviṣā vāvṛdhānas | ity anudrutya | upayāmagṛhīto 'sy oṣadhībhyas tvā prajābhyo juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmi | iti |
16.18.264.d: अथ वैश्वकर्मणम् । विश्वकर्मन् हविषा वावृधानस् । इत्य् अनुद्रुत्य । उपयामगृहीतो ऽस्य् ओषधीभ्यस् त्वा प्रजाभ्यो जुष्टं गृह्णामि । इति ।
16.18.264.m: Then the cup for Viśvakarman: having recited along: 'O Viśvakarman, grown strong through oblation...', [he draws it with]: 'You are taken with a support; for the plants, for offspring, I take you, acceptable.'

16.18.264.s: athādityam aditir na uruṣyatu | ity anudrutya | upayāmagṛhito 'sy adbhyas tvauṣadhībhyo juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmi | iti |
16.18.264.d: अथादित्यम् अदितिर् न उरुष्यतु । इत्य् अनुद्रुत्य । उपयामगृहितो ऽस्य् अद्भ्यस् त्वौषधीभ्यो जुष्टं गृह्णामि । इति ।
16.18.264.m: Then the cup for Aditi: having recited along: 'May Aditi protect us...', [he draws it with]: 'You are taken with a support; for the waters, for the plants, I take you, acceptable.'

16.18.264.s: athādityam athordhvaṃ tryahād vaiśvakarmaṇādityābhyām eva viparyāsam ety ā mahāvratāt
16.18.264.d: अथादित्यम् अथोर्ध्वं त्र्यहाद् वैश्वकर्मणादित्याभ्याम् एव विपर्यासम् एत्य् आ महाव्रतात्
16.18.264.m: then the cup for Aditi. Then, after the three days, proceeding with alternation only with [the cups for] Viśvakarman and Aditi up to the mahāvrata day;

16.18.265.s: tāv ubhau saha mahāvrate gṛhyete athaitaṃ mahāvratīye 'hni prājāpatyam atigrāhyaṃ gṛhṇāti
16.18.265.d: ताव् उभौ सह महाव्रते गृह्येते अथैतं महाव्रतीये ऽह्नि प्राजापत्यम् अतिग्राह्यं गृह्णाति
16.18.265.m: both of them are drawn together on the mahāvrata day. Then, on this mahāvrata day, he draws an additional cup for Prajāpati.

16.18.265.s: tve kratum apivṛñjanti viśve | ity anudrutya | upayāmagṛhīto 'si prajāpataye tvā juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmi | iti
16.18.265.d: त्वे क्रतुम् अपिवृञ्जन्ति विश्वे । इत्य् अनुद्रुत्य । उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि प्रजापतये त्वा जुष्टं गृह्णामि । इति
16.18.265.m: Having recited along: 'In you all allocate wisdom...', [he draws it with]: 'You are taken with a support; for Prajāpati I take you, acceptable.'

16.18.265.s: parimṛjya sādayati | eṣa te yoniḥ prajāpataye tvā | iti ||
16.18.265.d: परिमृज्य सादयति । एष ते योनिः प्रजापतये त्वा । इति ॥
16.18.265.m: Having wiped it around, he sets it down with: 'This is your womb; for Prajāpati [I set] you.'

16.19.265.s: athātaḥ paśukḷpter eva mīmām̐sā | uktaindrāgnānāṃ praśām̐sā | atirātrapaśavo 'bhito madhya aindrāgnās |
16.19.265.d: अथातः पशुकॢप्तेर् एव मीमाँसा । उक्तैन्द्राग्नानां प्रशाँसा । अतिरात्रपशवो ऽभितो मध्य ऐन्द्राग्नास् ।
16.19.265.m: Now then begins the inquiry into the arrangement of victim animals. The commendation of the animals for Indra-Agni has been stated. The atirātra animals are on both sides, [and] the animals for Indra-Agni in the middle;
or the sets of eleven animals are on both sides, [and] the animals for Indra-Agni in the middle.

16.19.265.s: sarvāgneyā eva syur ity etad ekam | sarvaindrāgnā eva syur ity etad ekam |
16.19.265.d: सर्वाग्नेया एव स्युर् इत्य् एतद् एकम् । सर्वैन्द्राग्ना एव स्युर् इत्य् एतद् एकम् ।
16.19.265.m: They should be all for Agni only: this is one [view]. They should be all for Indra-Agni only: this is one [view].

16.19.265.s: sarvaprājāpatyā eva syur ity etad ekam |
16.19.265.d: सर्वप्राजापत्या एव स्युर् इत्य् एतद् एकम् ।
16.19.265.m: They should be all for Prajāpati only: this is one [view].

16.19.265.s: sarvaikādaśinā eva syur ity etad aparam | teṣām̐ sarvaikādaśinair yatāṃ prasiddham evottamasya daśarātrasya tṛtīye 'han sapatadaśa ukthya ekādaśiny āpyate
16.19.265.d: सर्वैकादशिना एव स्युर् इत्य् एतद् अपरम् । तेषाँ सर्वैकादशिनैर् यतां प्रसिद्धम् एवोत्तमस्य दशरात्रस्य तृतीये ऽहन् सपतदश उक्थ्य एकादशिन्य् आप्यते
16.19.265.m: They should be all sets of eleven only: this is another [view]. For those proceeding with all sets of eleven, as is well known, on the third day of the final ten-day period, the seventeen-fold ukthya day, the set of eleven animals is completed.

16.19.265.s: tasya navāhāny apaśūny atiricyante teṣv etān nava brāhmaṇavataḥ paśūn ālabhante vaiṣṇavaṃ vāmanam ity etān |
16.19.265.d: तस्य नवाहान्य् अपशून्य् अतिरिच्यन्ते तेष्व् एतान् नव ब्राह्मणवतः पशून् आलभन्ते वैष्णवं वामनम् इत्य् एतान् ।
16.19.265.m: Of that [period], nine days remain without animals. On these they immolate these nine animals prescribed by the brāhmaṇa passage, [namely] the dwarf animal for Viṣṇu and the rest.

16.19.265.s: teṣām evaṃ yatāṃ bārhaspatyo vaiṣuvate savanīyaḥ saṃpadyate
16.19.265.d: तेषाम् एवं यतां बार्हस्पत्यो वैषुवते सवनीयः संपद्यते
16.19.265.m: For them proceeding thus, the victim to be offered at the pressing on the solstice day is one dedicated to Bṛhaspati.
For it they make an additional victim dedicated to Sūrya.

16.19.265.s: yady u vā etān nava brāhmaṇavataḥ paśūn na vindanti navaitāni madhyamāni saṃvatsarikāṇy ahāny aindrāgnapaśūni kurvanti
16.19.265.d: यद्य् उ वा एतान् नव ब्राह्मणवतः पशून् न विन्दन्ति नवैतानि मध्यमानि संवत्सरिकाण्य् अहान्य् ऐन्द्राग्नपशूनि कुर्वन्ति
16.19.265.m: And if they do not obtain these nine victims prescribed by the brāhmaṇa, they make these nine middle days of the year have victims dedicated to Indra-and-Agni.

16.19.266.s: teṣām evaṃ yatām aindrāgno vaiṣuvate savanīyaḥ saṃpadyate
16.19.266.d: तेषाम् एवं यताम् ऐन्द्राग्नो वैषुवते सवनीयः संपद्यते
16.19.266.m: For them proceeding thus, the victim to be offered at the pressing on the solstice day is dedicated to Indra-and-Agni.

16.19.266.s: tasya sauryam upālambhyaṃ kurvanti sāvitro mahāvrate tasya prājāpatyas tūpara aindraś carṣabha upālambhyau bhavataḥ ||
16.19.266.d: तस्य सौर्यम् उपालम्भ्यं कुर्वन्ति सावित्रो महाव्रते तस्य प्राजापत्यस् तूपर ऐन्द्रश् चर्षभ उपालम्भ्यौ भवतः ॥
16.19.266.m: For it they make an additional victim dedicated to Sūrya. On the mahāvrata day there is one dedicated to Savitar; for it a hornless goat dedicated to Prajāpati and a bull dedicated to Indra are the two additional victims.

16.20.266.s: śvo mahāvratam ity upakalpayate 'parimitān rathān aparimitān dundubhīm̐s tāvata u vevājisṛtaś carma ceḍasaṃvartaṃ ca bhūmidundubhim ārṣabhaṃ carma salāṅgūlaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ ca śūdraṃ cārdraṃ ca carmakartam |
16.20.266.d: श्वो महाव्रतम् इत्य् उपकल्पयते ऽपरिमितान् रथान् अपरिमितान् दुन्दुभीँस् तावत उ वेवाजिसृतश् चर्म चेडसंवर्तं च भूमिदुन्दुभिम् आर्षभं चर्म सलाङ्गूलं ब्राह्मणं च शूद्रं चार्द्रं च चर्मकर्तम् ।
16.20.266.m: Saying, "Tomorrow is the mahāvrata," he procures an unlimited number of chariots, an unlimited number of drums, just as many chariot-racers, a skin, a rolled mat, an earth-drum, an ox-hide with its tail, a brahmin, a śūdra, and a wet strip of hide.

16.20.266.s: pleṅkham̐ hotā kūrcāv adhvaryur bṛsīrhotrakā audumbarīm udgātāsandīm upakalpayate
16.20.266.d: प्लेङ्खँ होता कूर्चाव् अध्वर्युर् बृसीर्होत्रका औदुम्बरीम् उद्गातासन्दीम् उपकल्पयते
16.20.266.m: The hotṛ priest procures a swing; the adhvaryu priest two grass cushions; the assistants of the hotṛ priest the seat-cushions; the udgātṛ priest an audumbarī chair.

16.20.266.s: vāṇaṃ ca śatatantum āghāṭīḥ piñcholāḥ karkarīkā iti tad u patnayaḥ
16.20.266.d: वाणं च शततन्तुम् आघाटीः पिञ्छोलाः कर्करीका इति तद् उ पत्नयः
16.20.266.m: And a hundred-stringed lute, cymbals, pipes, and harps—these the wives [procure].

16.20.266.s: kaṭaparivāraṃ ca mithunau cāparimitāś ca dāsyas tāvata u vevodakumbhān
16.20.266.d: कटपरिवारं च मिथुनौ चापरिमिताश् च दास्यस् तावत उ वेवोदकुम्भान्
16.20.266.m: Also a straw screen, a copulating pair, an unlimited number of female slaves, and just as many water jars.

16.20.266.s: athaitaṃ mahāvratīye 'hni pañcavim̐śam agniṣṭomam upayanti rathaṃtarasāmānam |
16.20.266.d: अथैतं महाव्रतीये ऽह्नि पञ्चविँशम् अग्निष्टोमम् उपयन्ति रथंतरसामानम् ।
16.20.266.m: Then, on the mahāvrata day, they undertake this twenty-five-stoma agniṣṭoma having the rathaṃtara saman.
The ritual is the same up to the māhendra cup.
Having drawn the māhendra cup, he then brings these collected items.
Having had a pit dug behind the āgnīdhra fire, they cover it with an unworked ox-hide with the hairy side upward.

16.20.267.s: tasya lāṅgūlam utkhidya hantānūpatiṣṭhate | atraitān dundubhīn anudiśam āsañjayati
16.20.267.d: तस्य लाङ्गूलम् उत्खिद्य हन्तानूपतिष्ठते । अत्रैतान् दुन्दुभीन् अनुदिशम् आसञ्जयति
16.20.267.m: Pulling up its tail, a striker stands near. Then he hangs these drums in all directions.

16.20.267.d: तान् आहननैर् अनाघ्नन्त एते हन्तारो ऽनूपतिष्ठन्ते ।
16.20.267.m: Not beating them with drumsticks, these beaters stand near.

16.20.267.s: athaite rathāḥ samantaṃ devayajanaṃ parītyottaratas tiṣṭhanti
16.20.267.d: अथैते रथाः समन्तं देवयजनं परीत्योत्तरतस् तिष्ठन्ति
16.20.267.m: Then these chariots, having driven completely around the sacrificial enclosure, stand to the north.
Among them, a prince armed with three arrows is foremost.

16.21.267.s: tasmā agreṇāgnīdhram iḍasaṃvarte carmakartaṃ vyavāsyati taṃ kāla eva śastryātṛṇatti |
16.21.267.d: तस्मा अग्रेणाग्नीध्रम् इडसंवर्ते चर्मकर्तं व्यवास्यति तं काल एव शस्त्र्यातृणत्ति ।
16.21.267.m: In front of the āgnīdhra fire, he throws down the hide-cutter on a rolled mat; at the proper time, he pierces it with a knife.

16.21.267.s: athaitau brāhmaṇaś ca śūdraś cāntareṇa sadohavirdhāne tiṣṭhata ārdraṃ carmakartam ādāya
16.21.267.d: अथैतौ ब्राह्मणश् च शूद्रश् चान्तरेण सदोहविर्धाने तिष्ठत आर्द्रं चर्मकर्तम् आदाय
16.21.267.m: Then this brahmin and śūdra stand between the sadas and havirdhāna sheds, holding the wet strip of hide.

16.21.267.s: pleṅkham̐ hotāsajate kūrcāv adhvaryur upastṛṇīte bṛsīrhotrakās |
16.21.267.d: प्लेङ्खँ होतासजते कूर्चाव् अध्वर्युर् उपस्तृणीते बृसीर्होत्रकास् ।
16.21.267.m: The hotṛ priest sits on the swing; the adhvaryu priest spreads out two grass seats; the assistants of the hotṛ priest [spread out] grass cushions.
The udgātṛ priest climbs up onto an udumbara chair.

16.21.267.s: ādatte vāṇam̐ śatatantum āghāṭībhiḥ piñcholābhiḥ karkarīkābhir ity udgātāraṃ patnayaḥ paryupaviśanti |
16.21.267.d: आदत्ते वाणँ शततन्तुम् आघाटीभिः पिञ्छोलाभिः कर्करीकाभिर् इत्य् उद्गातारं पत्नयः पर्युपविशन्ति ।
16.21.267.m: He takes a hundred-stringed lute. The wives sit around the udgātṛ priest with cymbals, lutes, and bagpipes.

16.21.267.s: atha dakṣiṇe vedyanta kaṭaparivāre mithunau saṃpravādayatas |
16.21.267.d: अथ दक्षिणे वेद्यन्त कटपरिवारे मिथुनौ संप्रवादयतस् ।
16.21.267.m: Then, on the southern border of the altar behind an enclosure of mats, a copulating pair copulate verbally.

16.21.267.s: athaitā dāsya udakumbhān adhinidhāya mārjālīyaṃ paryupaviśanti |
16.21.267.d: अथैता दास्य उदकुम्भान् अधिनिधाय मार्जालीयं पर्युपविशन्ति ।
16.21.267.m: Then these servant girls, having set down water pitchers, sit around the mārjālīya hearth.

16.21.267.s: athādhvaryuḥ kūrcayor āsīno māhendrasya stotram upākaroti
16.21.267.d: अथाध्वर्युः कूर्चयोर् आसीनो माहेन्द्रस्य स्तोत्रम् उपाकरोति
16.21.267.m: Then the adhvaryu priest, seated on the two grass seats, introduces the chant for Mahendra.

16.21.267.s: stuvate māhendrāya prastute sāmni saṃpraiṣam āha | ājisṛta ājiṃ dhāvata dundubhīn samāghnata | abhiṣotāro 'bhiṣuṇuta | agnīd āśiraṃ vinayolūkhalam udvādaya pratiprasthātaḥ saumyasya viddhi | iti
16.21.267.d: स्तुवते माहेन्द्राय प्रस्तुते साम्नि संप्रैषम् आह । आजिसृत आजिं धावत दुन्दुभीन् समाघ्नत । अभिषोतारो ऽभिषुणुत । अग्नीद् आशिरं विनयोलूखलम् उद्वादय प्रतिप्रस्थातः सौम्यस्य विद्धि । इति
16.21.267.m: They chant for Mahendra. When the sāman is begun, he utters the direction: "O chariot-runners, run the race! Beat the drums! / O pressers, press [the soma]! / O āgnīdhra priest, mix the milk, make the mortar resound! O pratiprasthātṛ priest, attend to the soma cup!"

16.21.268.m: They act according to the direction. The chariot-runners run.

16.21.268.s: āghnanti dundubhīn saṃpravadanti vācas | āghāṭībhiḥ piñcholābhiḥ karkarīkābhir ity udgātāraṃ patnaya upagāyanti ||
16.21.268.d: आघ्नन्ति दुन्दुभीन् संप्रवदन्ति वाचस् । आघाटीभिः पिञ्छोलाभिः कर्करीकाभिर् इत्य् उद्गातारं पत्नय उपगायन्ति ॥
16.21.268.m: They beat the drums. Voices resound. The wives sing along with the udgātṛ priest with cymbals, lutes, and bagpipes.

16.22.268.s: bhadram u nāma sāmāsti tad u vācopagīyate | athaiṣa tisṛdhanvī rājaputraś carmāv abhinatti
16.22.268.d: भद्रम् उ नाम सामास्ति तद् उ वाचोपगीयते । अथैष तिसृधन्वी राजपुत्रश् चर्माव् अभिनत्ति
16.22.268.m: There is a sāman named Bhadra; that indeed is accompanied by voices. Then this prince with three arrows pierces two hides.

16.22.268.d: तं ब्राह्मणो ऽनूपतिष्ठते मापरात्सीर् मातिव्यात्सीस् । इति
16.22.268.m: A brāhmaṇa stands by him, [saying]: "Do not miss! Do not shoot beyond!"
In that very way, he pierces through [the target] hidden by three [objects].

16.22.268.s: athaitau brāhmaṇaś ca śūdraś cārdre carmakarte vyāyacchete ime 'rātsur ime subhūtam akran | iti brāhmaṇas |
16.22.268.d: अथैतौ ब्राह्मणश् च शूद्रश् चार्द्रे चर्मकर्ते व्यायच्छेते इमे ऽरात्सुर् इमे सुभूतम् अक्रन् । इति ब्राह्मणस् ।
16.22.268.m: Then these two, a brāhmaṇa and a śūdra, struggle over a moist hide. "These have prospered; these have made good fortune," says the brāhmaṇa.

16.22.268.s: ima udvāsīkāriṇa ime durbhūtam akran | iti vṛṣalas |
16.22.268.d: इम उद्वासीकारिण इमे दुर्भूतम् अक्रन् । इति वृषलस् ।
16.22.268.m: "These are expellers; these have made ill fortune," says the śūdra.
The brāhmaṇa wins; the śūdra is defeated.

16.22.268.s: saṃvartete mithunau | athaitā dāsya udakumbhān adhinidhāya mārjālīyaṃ parinṛtyanty upasthān upahatya dakṣiṇān pado nighnantīr idaṃmadhuṃ gāyantas
16.22.268.d: संवर्तेते मिथुनौ । अथैता दास्य उदकुम्भान् अधिनिधाय मार्जालीयं परिनृत्यन्त्य् उपस्थान् उपहत्य दक्षिणान् पदो निघ्नन्तीर् इदंमधुं गायन्तस्
16.22.268.m: The copulating pair finish [their act]. Then these servant girls, placing water-pitchers [on their heads], dance around the mārjālīya hearth, striking their laps and beating their right feet, singing the 'Idaṃ madhu' chant.
When they have gone around once, he causes the first [of them] to recite:

16.23.268.s: gāva eva surabhayo gāvo guggulugandhayaḥ | gāvo ghṛtasya mātaras tā iha santu bhūyasīs | haimahām̐ idaṃ madhu | iti |
16.23.268.d: गाव एव सुरभयो गावो गुग्गुलुगन्धयः । गावो घृतस्य मातरस् ता इह सन्तु भूयसीस् । हैमहाँ इदं मधु । इति ।
16.23.268.m: "Cows are fragrant, cows have the scent of bdellium; / cows are the mothers of clarified butter—may they be more abundant here! / Haimahām, this is honey!"

16.23.268.s: upasthān upahatya dakṣiṇān eva pado nighnanti
16.23.268.d: उपस्थान् उपहत्य दक्षिणान् एव पदो निघ्नन्ति
16.23.268.m: Striking their laps, they beat only their right feet.

16.23.268.s: dvitīyaṃ parītānāṃ prathamām eva vācayati nanu gāvo maṅkīrasya gaṅgāyā udakaṃ papuḥ | papuḥ sarasvatyai nadyai tāḥ prācīr ujjagāhire haimahām̐ idaṃ madhu | iti |
16.23.268.d: द्वितीयं परीतानां प्रथमाम् एव वाचयति ननु गावो मङ्कीरस्य गङ्गाया उदकं पपुः । पपुः सरस्वत्यै नद्यै ताः प्राचीर् उज्जगाहिरे हैमहाँ इदं मधु । इति ।
16.23.268.m: When they have gone around a second time, he causes the first of them to recite: "Have not the cows drunk the water of the Maṅkīra and the Gaṅgā? / They have drunk from the river Sarasvatī; eastward they stepped into [the waters]. / Haimahām, this is honey!"
Striking their laps, they beat only their right feet.

16.23.269.s: tṛtīyaṃ parītānāṃ prathamām eva vācayati yadā rākhandyau vadato grāmyaṃ maṅkīradāśakau | kṣemādhyavasyato grāme nānaḍvām̐s tapyate vahan haimahām̐ idaṃ madhu | iti |
16.23.269.d: तृतीयं परीतानां प्रथमाम् एव वाचयति यदा राखन्द्यौ वदतो ग्राम्यं मङ्कीरदाशकौ । क्षेमाध्यवस्यतो ग्रामे नानड्वाँस् तप्यते वहन् हैमहाँ इदं मधु । इति ।
16.23.269.m: When they have gone around a third time, he causes the first of them to recite: "When the two men of the Maṅkīra and the Dāśa tell worldly things on their beds, / settling down in security in the village, the ox does not suffer while bearing [the yoke]. / Haimahām, this is honey!"

16.23.269.s: athainā uttareṇa mārjālīyaṃ tiṣṭhantyo vācayati | idam eva madhu sāraghamayam̐ somaḥ suto bṛhat | tam indra paritātṛpīr haimahām̐ idaṃ madhu | iti
16.23.269.d: अथैना उत्तरेण मार्जालीयं तिष्ठन्त्यो वाचयति । इदम् एव मधु सारघमयँ सोमः सुतो बृहत् । तम् इन्द्र परितातृपीर् हैमहाँ इदं मधु । इति
16.23.269.m: Then he causes them, standing to the north of the mārjālīya hearth, to recite: "This is indeed bee-honey, this pressed great soma. / O Indra, take your fill around it! Haimahām, this is honey!"

16.23.269.s: tā ata ūrdhvam idaṃ madhv idaṃ madhv idaṃ madhu | ity eva pariyanti
16.23.269.d: ता अत ऊर्ध्वम् इदं मध्व् इदं मध्व् इदं मधु । इत्य् एव परियन्ति
16.23.269.m: Thereafter they go around [chanting] only: "This is honey! This is honey! This is honey!"

16.23.269.s: teṣāṃ ya eva prāyaṇīyo 'tirātraḥ sa udayanīyaḥ
16.23.269.d: तेषां य एव प्रायणीयो ऽतिरात्रः स उदयनीयः
16.23.269.m: Of their [days], that which is the opening atirātra is [also] the concluding [day].

16.23.269.s: sattrād udavasāya jyotiṣṭomenāgniṣṭomena catuṣṭomena pṛṣṭhaśamanīyena sahasradakṣiṇenaikaiko yajeta ||
16.23.269.d: सत्त्राद् उदवसाय ज्योतिष्टोमेनाग्निष्टोमेन चतुष्टोमेन पृष्ठशमनीयेन सहस्रदक्षिणेनैकैको यजेत ॥
16.23.269.m: Having concluded the sacrificial session, each one should sacrifice with the jyotiṣṭoma, an agniṣṭoma, a catuṣṭoma, a pṛṣṭhaśamanīya, with a thousand [cows as] sacrificial fee.

16.24.269.s: svargakāmo dvirātrāya dīkṣate tasyāparimitā dīkṣā dvādaśopasadaḥ
16.24.269.d: स्वर्गकामो द्विरात्राय दीक्षते तस्यापरिमिता दीक्षा द्वादशोपसदः
16.24.269.m: One who desires heaven is consecrated for the two-day ritual. His consecration is indefinite; there are twelve upasads.

16.24.269.s: sa tathā rājānaṃ krīṇāti yathā manyate dvirātrasya me sato 'māvāsyāyā upavasathīye 'han pūrvam ahaḥ saṃpatsyata uttarasminn uttaram iti
16.24.269.d: स तथा राजानं क्रीणाति यथा मन्यते द्विरात्रस्य मे सतो ऽमावास्याया उपवसथीये ऽहन् पूर्वम् अहः संपत्स्यत उत्तरस्मिन्न् उत्तरम् इति
16.24.269.m: He buys King [Soma] in such a way that he thinks: "Of my two-day ritual, the former day will fall on the fast-day of the new moon; the latter [day] on the next day."

16.24.269.s: tasya tathā saṃpadyate | abhiplavaḥ pūrvam ahar bhavati gatir uttaram |
16.24.269.d: तस्य तथा संपद्यते । अभिप्लवः पूर्वम् अहर् भवति गतिर् उत्तरम् ।
16.24.269.m: It turns out for him accordingly. The former day is an abhiplava; the latter day is a gati.
The former day is a jyotiṣṭoma agniṣṭoma.

16.24.269.s: tejas tenāvarunddhe sarvastomo 'tirātra uttaram | sarvasyāptyai sarvasyāvaruddhyai
16.24.269.d: तेजस् तेनावरुन्द्धे सर्वस्तोमो ऽतिरात्र उत्तरम् । सर्वस्याप्त्यै सर्वस्यावरुद्ध्यै
16.24.269.m: By it he wins splendor. The latter is an atirātra with all stomata, for obtaining everything, for winning everything.

16.24.269.s: gāyatraṃ pūrve 'han sāma bhavati traiṣṭubham uttare
16.24.269.d: गायत्रं पूर्वे ऽहन् साम भवति त्रैष्टुभम् उत्तरे
16.24.269.m: On the former day, the chant is in the gāyatrī metre; on the latter, in the triṣṭubh metre.

16.24.270.s: rathaṃtaraṃ pūrve 'han sāma bhavati bṛhad uttare vaikhānasaṃ pūrve 'han sāma bhavati
16.24.270.d: रथंतरं पूर्वे ऽहन् साम भवति बृहद् उत्तरे वैखानसं पूर्वे ऽहन् साम भवति
16.24.270.m: On the former day, the chant is the rathaṃtara saman; on the latter, the bṛhat saman. On the former day, the chant is the vaikhānasa saman;

16.24.270.s: ṣoḍaśy uttare haviṣmannidhanaṃ pūrvam ahar bhavati
16.24.270.d: षोडश्य् उत्तरे हविष्मन्निधनं पूर्वम् अहर् भवति
16.24.270.m: on the latter, the ṣoḍaśin. The former day has a haviṣmat finale;

16.24.270.s: haviṣkṛnnidhanam uttaram | nānaivārdhamāsayor bhavato nānāvīrye bhavatas | iti brāhmaṇam |
16.24.270.d: हविष्कृन्निधनम् उत्तरम् । नानैवार्धमासयोर् भवतो नानावीर्ये भवतस् । इति ब्राह्मणम् ।
16.24.270.m: the latter has a haviṣkṛt finale. "The two half-months are indeed different, they have different potencies," so says the brāhmaṇa passage.
The two-day ritual concludes. He intends to sacrifice with a three-day ritual.

16.24.270.s: sa upakalpayate sahasram | tasminn unnato vehad vāmana iti bhavanti | athāsyaiṣā sahasratamy anyataenī kaṇḍūkṛtopakḷptā bhavati
16.24.270.d: स उपकल्पयते सहस्रम् । तस्मिन्न् उन्नतो वेहद् वामन इति भवन्ति । अथास्यैषा सहस्रतम्य् अन्यतएनी कण्डूकृतोपकॢप्ता भवति
16.24.270.m: He prepares a thousand [cows]; among them are a tall [bull], a barren cow, and a dwarf. Then his thousandth [cow] is prepared, white-spotted on one side and scratched [with a comb].
He buys soma with a reddish-brown, tawny one-year-old cow. There are twelve upasads.

16.25.270.s: tāyate prathame 'hann agniṣṭomas tasya trivṛt prātaḥsavanaṃ pañcadaśaṃ mādhyaṃdinam̐ savanam̐ saptadaśaṃ tṛtīyasavanam |
16.25.270.d: तायते प्रथमे ऽहन्न् अग्निष्टोमस् तस्य त्रिवृत् प्रातःसवनं पञ्चदशं माध्यंदिनँ सवनँ सप्तदशं तृतीयसवनम् ।
16.25.270.m: On the first day, the agniṣṭoma is performed: its morning pressing has the nine-versed stoma, the midday pressing has the fifteen-versed stoma, the third pressing has the seventeen-versed stoma.

16.25.270.s: sa dākṣiṇāni hutvāgnīdhre sruvāhutiṃ juhoti tvam̐ sahasram ānaya | unnata ud valasyābhinas tvacam | sā mā sahasra ābhaja prajayā paśubhiḥ saha punar māviśatād rayis | iti |
16.25.270.d: स दाक्षिणानि हुत्वाग्नीध्रे स्रुवाहुतिं जुहोति त्वँ सहस्रम् आनय । उन्नत उद् वलस्याभिनस् त्वचम् । सा मा सहस्र आभज प्रजया पशुभिः सह पुनर् माविशताद् रयिस् । इति ।
16.25.270.m: Having offered the gifts for the sacrificial priests, he offers a ladle libation in the āgnīdhra fire: "Bring you the thousand! / High up, tear open the hide of Vala! / Share me in the thousand, together with offspring and cattle! May wealth enter me again!"
