upasīdaty upayaṣṭā gudatṛtīyais \
atraitāni gudatṛtīyāny ekādaśadhā kṛtvopayaṣṭāpayajati

17.11.292.s: ekādaśinīṃ kariṣyan yūpāhutim̐ hutvātha tāṃ diśam eti yatra trayodaśa yupān vetsyan manyate
17.11.292.d: एकादशिनीं करिष्यन् यूपाहुतिँ हुत्वाथ तां दिशम् एति यत्र त्रयोदश युपान् वेत्स्यन् मन्यते
17.11.292.m: ekādaśinīṃ kariṣyan yūpāhutim̐ hutvātha tāṃ diśam eti yatra trayodaśa yupān vetsyan manyate

17.11.292.s: tān upaśayadvādaśān pātnīvatatrayodaśāñ chittvāvāhayatyā vā hārayati |
17.11.292.d: तान् उपशयद्वादशान् पात्नीवतत्रयोदशाञ् छित्त्वावाहयत्या वा हारयति ।
17.11.292.m: tān upaśayadvādaśān pātnīvatatrayodaśāñ chittvāvāhayatyā vā hārayati \

17.11.292.s: ohya nistiṣṭhati | avatakṣaṇānām eva svarūn kurute |
17.11.292.d: ओह्य निस्तिष्ठति । अवतक्षणानाम् एव स्वरून् कुरुते ।
17.11.292.m:
ohya nistiṣṭhati \
avatakṣaṇānām eva svarūn kurute \

17.11.292.s: athāsyaiṣā pūrvedyur eva rathākṣeṇaikādaśadhā vedir vimitā bhavati
17.11.292.d: अथास्यैषा पूर्वेद्युर् एव रथाक्षेणैकादशधा वेदिर् विमिता भवति
17.11.292.m: athāsyaiṣā pūrvedyur eva rathākṣeṇaikādaśadhā vedir vimitā bhavati

17.11.292.s: sa yatrāgniṣṭhasya yūpāvaṭaṃ parilikhati tad etam̐ rathākṣaṃ yācati
17.11.292.d: स यत्राग्निष्ठस्य यूपावटं परिलिखति तद् एतँ रथाक्षं याचति
17.11.292.m: sa yatrāgniṣṭhasya yūpāvaṭaṃ parilikhati tad etam̐ rathākṣaṃ yācati

17.11.292.s: tena dakṣiṇato mimīta uparasaṃmitaṃ yūpāvaṭaṃ parilikhati |
17.11.292.d: तेन दक्षिणतो मिमीत उपरसंमितं यूपावटं परिलिखति ।
17.11.292.m: tena dakṣiṇato mimīta uparasaṃmitaṃ yūpāvaṭaṃ parilikhati \

17.11.292.s: athodaṅ mimīta uparasaṃmitam eva yūpāvaṭaṃ parilikhati
17.11.292.d: अथोदङ् मिमीत उपरसंमितम् एव यूपावटं परिलिखति
17.11.292.m: athodaṅ mimīta uparasaṃmitam eva yūpāvaṭaṃ parilikhati

17.11.292.s: sa evam eva dakṣiṇam uttaram ity aṣṭau yūpāvaṭān parilikhati
17.11.292.d: स एवम् एव दक्षिणम् उत्तरम् इत्य् अष्टौ यूपावटान् परिलिखति
17.11.292.m: sa evam eva dakṣiṇam uttaram ity aṣṭau yūpāvaṭān parilikhati

17.11.292.s: tad dhaitad eka upavasathīya evāhany etān yūpān ucchrayanti yajamāno vā agniṣṭho 'ṅgānām itare rūpam iti vadantaḥ
17.11.292.d: तद् धैतद् एक उपवसथीय एवाहन्य् एतान् यूपान् उच्छ्रयन्ति यजमानो वा अग्निष्ठो ऽङ्गानाम् इतरे रूपम् इति वदन्तः
17.11.292.m: tad dhaitad eka upavasathīya evāhany etān yūpān ucchrayanti yajamāno vā agniṣṭho 'ṅgānām itare rūpam iti vadantaḥ

17.11.292.s: sa yad enaṃ tatrānucchrayantaṃ brūyād vyaṅgo nvā ayaṃ yajamāno bhaviṣyatīti tathā haiva syāt
17.11.292.d: स यद् एनं तत्रानुच्छ्रयन्तं ब्रूयाद् व्यङ्गो न्वा अयं यजमानो भविष्यतीति तथा हैव स्यात्
17.11.292.m: sa yad enaṃ tatrānucchrayantaṃ brūyād vyaṅgo nvā ayaṃ yajamāno bhaviṣyatīti tathā haiva syāt

17.11.293.s: tad u vā āhus | yad ime yūpā apaśavaḥ śūlībhūtās tiṣṭheyur yajñavāsturūpam iva syād yajñaveśasam iva
17.11.293.d: तद् उ वा आहुस् । यद् इमे यूपा अपशवः शूलीभूतास् तिष्ठेयुर् यज्ञवास्तुरूपम् इव स्याद् यज्ञवेशसम् इव
17.11.293.m: tad u vā āhus \ <yad ime yūpā apaśavaḥ śūlībhūtās tiṣṭheyur yajñavāsturūpam iva syād yajñaveśasam iva>

17.11.293.s: śvo bhūta evāhany etān yūpān ucchrayet | iti
17.11.293.d: श्वो भूत एवाहन्य् एतान् यूपान् उच्छ्रयेत् । इति
17.11.293.m: <śvo bhūta evāhany etān yūpān ucchrayet> \ iti

17.11.293.s: tāñ chvo bhūta evocchrayanti | agniṣṭha ekādaśinīr aśanāḥ parivīya vāsayanti ||
17.11.293.d: ताञ् छ्वो भूत एवोच्छ्रयन्ति । अग्निष्ठ एकादशिनीर् अशनाः परिवीय वासयन्ति ॥
17.11.293.m:
tāñ chvo bhūta evocchrayanti \
agniṣṭha ekādaśinīr aśanāḥ parivīya vāsayanti

17.12.293.s: samānaṃ karmāśvinād grahāt | āśvinaṃ grahaṃ gṛhītvaikādaśa raśanā ādāya yūpam abhyaiti
17.12.293.d: समानं कर्माश्विनाद् ग्रहात् । आश्विनं ग्रहं गृहीत्वैकादश रशना आदाय यूपम् अभ्यैति
17.12.293.m:
samānaṃ karmāśvinād grahāt \
āśvinaṃ grahaṃ gṛhītvaikādaśa raśanā ādāya yūpam abhyaiti

17.12.293.s: tad ete yūpāḥ prakṣālitāḥ prapannāḥ saṃpannacaṣālāḥ prāgavaṭebhya upaśerate
17.12.293.d: तद् एते यूपाः प्रक्षालिताः प्रपन्नाः संपन्नचषालाः प्रागवटेभ्य उपशेरते
17.12.293.m: tad ete yūpāḥ prakṣālitāḥ prapannāḥ saṃpannacaṣālāḥ prāgavaṭebhya upaśerate

17.12.293.s: svarvantam agniṣṭham utsṛjya tasmād dakṣiṇam eva pūrvam upasthāvānam ucchrayaty athottaram |
17.12.293.d: स्वर्वन्तम् अग्निष्ठम् उत्सृज्य तस्माद् दक्षिणम् एव पूर्वम् उपस्थावानम् उच्छ्रयत्य् अथोत्तरम् ।
17.12.293.m: svarvantam agniṣṭham utsṛjya tasmād dakṣiṇam eva pūrvam upasthāvānam ucchrayaty athottaram \

17.12.293.s: sa evam eva dakṣiṇam uttaram ity aṣṭau yūpān ucchrayati |
17.12.293.d: स एवम् एव दक्षिणम् उत्तरम् इत्य् अष्टौ यूपान् उच्छ्रयति ।
17.12.293.m: sa evam eva dakṣiṇam uttaram ity aṣṭau yūpān ucchrayati \

17.12.293.s: atha vai bhavati | uparasaṃmitāṃ minuyāt pitṛlokakāmasya | iti samā upareṣu bhavanti
17.12.293.d: अथ वै भवति । उपरसंमितां मिनुयात् पितृलोककामस्य । इति समा उपरेषु भवन्ति
17.12.293.m:
atha vai bhavati \
<uparasaṃmitāṃ minuyāt pitṛlokakāmasya> \ iti samā upareṣu bhavanti

17.12.293.s: raśanasaṃmitāṃ manuṣyalokakāmasya | iti samā raśanāsu bhavanti
17.12.293.d: रशनसंमितां मनुष्यलोककामस्य । इति समा रशनासु भवन्ति

17.12.293.s: caṣālasaṃmitām indriyakāmasya | iti samāś caṣāleṣu bhavanti
17.12.293.d: चषालसंमिताम् इन्द्रियकामस्य । इति समाश् चषालेषु भवन्ति

17.12.293.s: sarvān samān pratiṣṭhākāmasya | iti sarvān samān pratiṣṭhākāmasya karoti
17.12.293.d: सर्वान् समान् प्रतिष्ठाकामस्य । इति सर्वान् समान् प्रतिष्ठाकामस्य करोति
17.12.293.m: <sarvān samān pratiṣṭhākāmasya> \ iti sarvān samān pratiṣṭhākāmasya karoti

17.12.293.s: ye trayo madhyamās tān samān paśukāmasya | iti tān samān paśukāmasya karoti
17.12.293.d: ये त्रयो मध्यमास् तान् समान् पशुकामस्य । इति तान् समान् पशुकामस्य करोति
17.12.293.m: <ye trayo madhyamās tān samān paśukāmasya> \ iti tān samān paśukāmasya karoti

17.12.294.s: vyatiṣajed itarān iti vyatiṣajati sa evam eva dakṣiṇam uttaram ity aṣṭau yūpān vyatiṣajati ||
17.12.294.d: व्यतिषजेद् इतरान् इति व्यतिषजति स एवम् एव दक्षिणम् उत्तरम् इत्य् अष्टौ यूपान् व्यतिषजति ॥
17.12.294.m:
<vyatiṣajed itarān> iti vyatiṣajati
sa evam eva dakṣiṇam uttaram ity aṣṭau yūpān vyatiṣajati

17.13.294.s: atha vai bhavati yaṃ kāmayeta pramāyukaḥ syād iti gartamitaṃ tasya minuyād uttarārdhyaṃ varṣiṣṭhamatha hrasīyām̐sam iti |
17.13.294.d: अथ वै भवति यं कामयेत प्रमायुकः स्याद् इति गर्तमितं तस्य मिनुयाद् उत्तरार्ध्यं वर्षिष्ठमथ ह्रसीयाँसम् इति ।
17.13.294.m:
atha vai bhavati
<yaṃ kāmayeta pramāyukaḥ syād iti gartamitaṃ tasya minuyād uttarārdhyaṃ varṣiṣṭhamatha hrasīyām̐sam> iti \

17.13.294.s: uttarārdhyam atra varṣiṣṭhaṃ minoti dakṣiṇārdhyam̐ hrasīyām̐sam
17.13.294.d: उत्तरार्ध्यम् अत्र वर्षिष्ठं मिनोति दक्षिणार्ध्यँ ह्रसीयाँसम्
17.13.294.m: uttarārdhyam atra varṣiṣṭhaṃ minoti dakṣiṇārdhyam̐ hrasīyām̐sam

17.13.294.s: eṣā vai gartamid yasyaivaṃ minoti tājak pramīyate | iti brāhmaṇam |
17.13.294.d: एषा वै गर्तमिद् यस्यैवं मिनोति ताजक् प्रमीयते । इति ब्राह्मणम् ।
17.13.294.m: <eṣā vai gartamid yasyaivaṃ minoti tājak pramīyate> \ iti brāhmaṇam \

17.13.294.s: dakṣiṇārdhyaṃ varṣiṣṭhaṃ minuyāt suvargakāmasyātha hrasīyām̐sam iti
17.13.294.d: दक्षिणार्ध्यं वर्षिष्ठं मिनुयात् सुवर्गकामस्याथ ह्रसीयाँसम् इति

17.13.294.s: dakṣiṇārdhyam atra varṣiṣṭhaṃ minoty uttarārdhyam̐ hrasīyām̐sam
17.13.294.d: दक्षिणार्ध्यम् अत्र वर्षिष्ठं मिनोत्य् उत्तरार्ध्यँ ह्रसीयाँसम्
17.13.294.m: dakṣiṇārdhyam atra varṣiṣṭhaṃ minoty uttarārdhyam̐ hrasīyām̐sam

17.13.294.s: ākramaṇam eva tat setuṃ yajamānaḥ kurute suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai | iti brāhmaṇam
17.13.294.d: आक्रमणम् एव तत् सेतुं यजमानः कुरुते सुवर्गस्य लोकस्य समष्ट्यै । इति ब्राह्मणम्
17.13.294.m: <ākramaṇam eva tat setuṃ yajamānaḥ kurute suvargasya lokasya samaṣṭyai> \ iti brāhmaṇam

17.13.294.s: yad ekasmin yūpe dve raśane parivyayati tasmād eko dve jāye vindate
17.13.294.d: यद् एकस्मिन् यूपे द्वे रशने परिव्ययति तस्माद् एको द्वे जाये विन्दते
17.13.294.m: <yad ekasmin yūpe dve raśane parivyayati tasmād eko dve jāye vindate>

17.13.294.s: yan naikām̐ raśanāṃ dvayor yūpayoḥ parivyayati tasmān naikā dvau patī vindate | iti brāhmaṇam
17.13.294.d: यन् नैकाँ रशनां द्वयोर् यूपयोः परिव्ययति तस्मान् नैका द्वौ पती विन्दते । इति ब्राह्मणम्
17.13.294.m: 'Since one does not wind one cord around two sacrificial posts, therefore one [woman] does not obtain two husbands'—so runs the brāhmaṇa passage.

17.13.294.s: atha vai bhavati yaṃ kāmayeta stry asya jāyetety upānte tasya vyatiṣajet | iti |
17.13.294.d: अथ वै भवति यं कामयेत स्त्र्य् अस्य जायेतेत्य् उपान्ते तस्य व्यतिषजेत् । इति ।
17.13.294.m:
Now indeed it says: 'If he should desire that a female be born to him, he should interlock near the end of it.'

He interlocks near the end of it. 'A female indeed is born to him'—so runs the brāhmaṇa passage.

17.13.294.s: upānte tasya vyatiṣajati stry evāsya jāyate | iti brāhmaṇam
17.13.294.d: उपान्ते तस्य व्यतिषजति स्त्र्य् एवास्य जायते । इति ब्राह्मणम्

17.13.294.s: atha vai bhavati yaṃ kāmayeta pumān asya jāyetety āntaṃ tasya praveṣṭayet | iti |
17.13.294.d: अथ वै भवति यं कामयेत पुमान् अस्य जायेतेत्य् आन्तं तस्य प्रवेष्टयेत् । इति ।
17.13.294.m:
Now indeed it says: 'If he should desire that a male be born to him, he should wind [it] right to the end of it.'

He winds [it] right to the end of it. 'A male indeed is born to him'—so runs the brāhmaṇa passage.

17.13.294.s: āntaṃ tasya praveṣṭayati pumān evāsya jāyate | iti brāhmaṇam
17.13.294.d: आन्तं तस्य प्रवेष्टयति पुमान् एवास्य जायते । इति ब्राह्मणम्

17.13.294.m: Here, he throws out this supplementary post silently to the south.
Having released the sacrificial posts ending with the wooden top-rings, he brings near the [victim] dedicated to Agni at the post facing the fire.

17.14.294.s: sārasvatīm uttare saumyaṃ dakṣiṇe pauṣṇam uttare bārhaspatyaṃ dakṣiṇe vaiśvadevam uttara aindraṃ dakṣiṇe mārutam uttara aindrāgnaṃ dakṣiṇe sāvitram uttare vāruṇaṃ dakṣiṇe |
17.14.294.d: सारस्वतीम् उत्तरे सौम्यं दक्षिणे पौष्णम् उत्तरे बार्हस्पत्यं दक्षिणे वैश्वदेवम् उत्तर ऐन्द्रं दक्षिणे मारुतम् उत्तर ऐन्द्राग्नं दक्षिणे सावित्रम् उत्तरे वारुणं दक्षिणे ।
17.14.294.m: [He brings near the victim] dedicated to Sarasvatī at the northern [post], the one dedicated to Soma at the southern, the one dedicated to Pūṣan at the northern, the one dedicated to Bṛhaspati at the southern, the one dedicated to the Viśve Devas at the northern, the one dedicated to Indra at the southern, the one dedicated to the Maruts at the northern, the one dedicated to Indrāgnī at the southern, the one dedicated to Savitar at the northern, the one dedicated to Varuṇa at the southern.

17.14.294.s: atha vai bhavati yadi kāmayeta yo 'vagataḥ so 'parudhyatāṃ yo 'paruddhaḥ so 'vagacchatv ity aindrasya loke vāruṇam ālabheta vāruṇasya loka aindraṃ
17.14.294.d: अथ वै भवति यदि कामयेत यो ऽवगतः सो ऽपरुध्यतां यो ऽपरुद्धः सो ऽवगच्छत्व् इत्य् ऐन्द्रस्य लोके वारुणम् आलभेत वारुणस्य लोक ऐन्द्रं
17.14.294.m: Now indeed it says: 'If he should desire: "May he who is established be banished, and may he who is banished be established", he should seize the [victim] dedicated to Varuṇa in the place of the one dedicated to Indra, and the one dedicated to Indra in the place of the one dedicated to Varuṇa.'

17.14.295.s: ya evāvagataḥ so 'parudhyate yo 'paruddhaḥ so 'vagacchati | iti brāhmaṇam
17.14.295.d: य एवावगतः सो ऽपरुध्यते यो ऽपरुद्धः सो ऽवगच्छति । इति ब्राह्मणम्
17.14.295.m: 'He who is established is banished, and he who is banished is established'—so runs the brāhmaṇa passage.

17.14.295.s: atha vai bhavati yadi kāmayeta prajā muhyeyur iti paśūn vyatiṣajet | iti
17.14.295.d: अथ वै भवति यदि कामयेत प्रजा मुह्येयुर् इति पशून् व्यतिषजेत् । इति
17.14.295.m: Now indeed it says: 'If he should desire: "May the subjects be bewildered", he should interweave the animal victims.'

17.14.295.s: paśūn evātra vyatiṣajati prajā eva mohayati | iti brāhmaṇam
17.14.295.d: पशून् एवात्र व्यतिषजति प्रजा एव मोहयति । इति ब्राह्मणम्
17.14.295.m: Here he interweaves the animal victims. 'He bewilders the subjects'—so runs the brāhmaṇa passage.

17.14.295.s: atha vai bhavati yad abhivāhato 'pāṃ vāruṇam ālabheta prajā varuṇo gṛhṇīyāt |
17.14.295.d: अथ वै भवति यद् अभिवाहतो ऽपां वारुणम् आलभेत प्रजा वरुणो गृह्णीयात् ।
17.14.295.m: Now indeed it says: 'If he should seize the [victim] dedicated to Varuṇa facing the flow of the waters, Varuṇa would seize the subjects.'

17.14.295.s: dakṣiṇata udañcam ālabhate 'pavāhato 'pāṃ prajānām avaruṇagrahāya | iti brāhmaṇam
17.14.295.d: दक्षिणत उदञ्चम् आलभते ऽपवाहतो ऽपां प्रजानाम् अवरुणग्रहाय । इति ब्राह्मणम्
17.14.295.m: 'He seizes [it] from south to north, flowing away from the waters, so that the subjects are not seized by Varuṇa'—so runs the brāhmaṇa passage.

17.14.295.s: athaitasminn upaśaye manasaiva yaṃ dveṣṭi tam upākaroti
17.14.295.d: अथैतस्मिन्न् उपशये मनसैव यं द्वेष्टि तम् उपाकरोति
17.14.295.m: Now, at this supplementary post, he brings near merely in his mind the one whom he hates.

17.14.295.s: yady u vai na dveṣṭi | ākhus te paśus | ity anudiśati
17.14.295.d: यद्य् उ वै न द्वेष्टि । आखुस् ते पशुस् । इत्य् अनुदिशति
17.14.295.m: And if he does not hate [anyone], he designates: 'A mole is your victim.'
The ritual action is the same up to the carrying of fire around [the victims].

17.14.295.s: paryagnikṛtānām eteṣāṃ paśūnāṃ pañca dakṣiṇārdhyān paśūn upakramyaiva sthāpayitvā dvāv upātinīyāthetarair vyatiṣajati |
17.14.295.d: पर्यग्निकृतानाम् एतेषां पशूनां पञ्च दक्षिणार्ध्यान् पशून् उपक्रम्यैव स्थापयित्वा द्वाव् उपातिनीयाथेतरैर् व्यतिषजति ।
17.14.295.m: When fire has been carried around these animal victims, having begun with and set in place the five animals on the southern side, and having led past two, he then interweaves them with the others.

17.14.295.s: atha paryagnikṛtaiḥ paśubhir udañcaḥ pratipadyante teṣāṃ vāruṇa uttarārdhyo bhavati |
17.14.295.d: अथ पर्यग्निकृतैः पशुभिर् उदञ्चः प्रतिपद्यन्ते तेषां वारुण उत्तरार्ध्यो भवति ।
17.14.295.m: Then, with the animal victims around which fire has been carried, they proceed northwards; of them, the one dedicated to Varuṇa is on the northern side.

17.14.295.s: āgneya upacāratas | āgneyam evādhvaryur vapāśrapaṇībhyām anvārabhate pṛthag itarān parikarmiṇa udañco nayanty anupūrvam avyatiṣajantas
17.14.295.d: आग्नेय उपचारतस् । आग्नेयम् एवाध्वर्युर् वपाश्रपणीभ्याम् अन्वारभते पृथग् इतरान् परिकर्मिण उदञ्चो नयन्त्य् अनुपूर्वम् अव्यतिषजन्तस्
17.14.295.m: [The animal] dedicated to Agni is next according to the order of performance. The adhvaryu priest takes hold of the one dedicated to Agni with the two omentum-roasting spits; the assistants lead the other [animals] northward separately, one after another without intertwining.

17.14.295.s: teṣāṃ prasiddhaṃ vapābhiś caritvā prasarpanti prātaḥsavanāya
17.14.295.d: तेषां प्रसिद्धं वपाभिश् चरित्वा प्रसर्पन्ति प्रातःसवनाय
17.14.295.m: Having proceeded with their omenta in the prescribed manner, they move forward for the morning pressing.

17.15.295.s: atha vai bhavati | iṣṭaṃ vapayā bhavaty aniṣṭaṃ vaśayātha pātnīvatena pracarati | iti
17.15.295.d: अथ वै भवति । इष्टं वपया भवत्य् अनिष्टं वशयाथ पात्नीवतेन प्रचरति । इति
17.15.295.m: Now indeed it is said: "The offering has been made with the omentum, not yet made with the barren cow; then he proceeds with the [ritual] relating to the wives of the gods."

17.15.295.s: sa yatraikādaśinyā anubandhyasyeṣṭaṃ vapayā bhavaty aniṣṭaṃ vaśayā tajjaghanena gārhapatyam aupasadāyāṃ vedyām̐ stambayajur harati |
17.15.295.d: स यत्रैकादशिन्या अनुबन्ध्यस्येष्टं वपया भवत्य् अनिष्टं वशया तज्जघनेन गार्हपत्यम् औपसदायां वेद्याँ स्तम्बयजुर् हरति ।
17.15.295.m: When the offering has been made with the omentum of the set of eleven [animals] or of the subsequent animal, but not yet made with the barren cow, he takes the earth-lump oblation behind the gārhapatya fire on the altar of the upasads.

17.15.296.s: idam eva prasiddhaṃ pauroḍāśikam | trir yajuṣā tūṣṇīṃ caturtham |
17.15.296.d: इदम् एव प्रसिद्धं पौरोडाशिकम् । त्रिर् यजुषा तूष्णीं चतुर्थम् ।
17.15.296.m: This is just the standard procedure for cake-offerings: thrice with a formula, silently the fourth time.

17.15.296.s: pūrvaṃ parigrāhaṃ parigṛhṇāti karaṇaṃ japati | uddhanti | uddhatād āgnīdhras trir harati
17.15.296.d: पूर्वं परिग्राहं परिगृह्णाति करणं जपति । उद्धन्ति । उद्धताद् आग्नीध्रस् त्रिर् हरति
17.15.296.m: He marks out the first boundary; he recites the ritual formula; he digs up [the ground]; from what has been dug up, the āgnīdhra priest carries away [earth] three times.

17.15.296.s: yad āgnīdhras trir haraty athāgreṇa gārhapatyaṃ pātnīvatasya yūpāvaṭaṃ parilikhati
17.15.296.d: यद् आग्नीध्रस् त्रिर् हरत्य् अथाग्रेण गार्हपत्यं पात्नीवतस्य यूपावटं परिलिखति
17.15.296.m: When the āgnīdhra priest has carried away [earth] three times, then in front of the gārhapatya fire he outlines the post-hole for the post relating to the wives of the gods.
The rite is identical up to the placing of the ladles.

17.15.296.s: sādayitvā sruco 'greṇa gārhapatyaṃ pātnīvatam ucchritya tasmim̐s tvāṣṭram̐ sāṇḍam ajaṃ paśum upākaroti
17.15.296.d: सादयित्वा स्रुचो ऽग्रेण गार्हपत्यं पात्नीवतम् उच्छ्रित्य तस्मिँस् त्वाष्ट्रँ साण्डम् अजं पशुम् उपाकरोति
17.15.296.m: Having placed the ladles and raised the post relating to the wives of the gods in front of the gārhapatya fire, he dedicates at it an uncastrated he-goat as the sacrificial victim for Tvaṣṭṛ.
Having led fire around it and then released it, he completes [the sacrifice] with clarified butter.

17.15.296.s: atha catura ājyasya gṛhṇāna āha "tvaṣṭre" | ity upām̐śu | "anubrūhi" | ity uccais |
17.15.296.d: अथ चतुर आज्यस्य गृह्णान आह "त्वष्ट्रे" । इत्य् उपाँशु । "अनुब्रूहि" । इत्य् उच्चैस् ।
17.15.296.m: Then, drawing four ladlef promovings of clarified butter, he says, "To Tvaṣṭṛ," in a whisper, and "recite!" aloud.
Having stepped across and made the call, he says, "For Tvaṣṭṛ," in a whisper, and "recite the offering-verse!" aloud.

17.15.296.s: vaṣaṭkṛte juhoti | iti nu vapāyāḥ praticarati catura evājyasya gṛhṇāna āha "tvaṣṭre" | ity upām̐śu | "anubrūhi" | ity uccaiḥ ||
17.15.296.d: वषट्कृते जुहोति । इति नु वपायाः प्रतिचरति चतुर एवाज्यस्य गृह्णान आह "त्वष्ट्रे" । इत्य् उपाँशु । "अनुब्रूहि" । इत्य् उच्चैः ॥
17.15.296.m: When the vaṣaṭ call is uttered, he offers. Thus indeed he performs [in place of] the omentum. Drawing four portionings of clarified butter, he says, "To Tvaṣṭṛ," in a whisper, and "recite!" aloud.

17.16.296.s: atyākramyāśrāvyāha "tvaṣṭāram" ity upām̐śu "yaja" | ity uccais | vaṣaṭkṛte juhoti |
17.16.296.d: अत्याक्रम्याश्राव्याह "त्वष्टारम्" इत्य् उपाँशु "यज" । इत्य् उच्चैस् । वषट्कृते जुहोति ।
17.16.296.m: Having stepped across and made the call, he says, "For Tvaṣṭṛ," in a whisper, and "recite the offering-verse!" aloud. When the vaṣaṭ call is uttered, he offers.

17.16.296.s: iti nu paśupuroḍāśasya praticarati catura evājyasya gṛhṇāna āha | "agnaye" | ity upām̐śu | "anubrūhi" | ity uccais |
17.16.296.d: इति नु पशुपुरोडाशस्य प्रतिचरति चतुर एवाज्यस्य गृह्णान आह । "अग्नये" । इत्य् उपाँशु । "अनुब्रूहि" । इत्य् उच्चैस् ।
17.16.296.m: Thus indeed he performs [in place of] the animal cake. Drawing four portionings of clarified butter, he says, "To Agni," in a whisper, and "recite!" aloud.
Having stepped across and made the call, he says, "For Agni," in a whisper, and "recite the offering-verse!" aloud.

17.16.296.d: वषट्कृत उत्तरार्धपूर्वार्धे ऽतिहाय पूवा आहुतीर् जुहोति ।
17.16.296.m: When the vaṣaṭ call is uttered, having bypassed the earlier offerings, he offers in the north-eastern part [of the fire].
Thus indeed he performs [the offering] to [Agni] Sviṣṭakṛt of the animal cake.

17.16.296.s: catura evājyasya gṛhṇāna āha "tvaṣṭre" | ity upām̐śu | "anubrūhi" | ity uccais |
17.16.296.d: चतुर एवाज्यस्य गृह्णान आह "त्वष्ट्रे" । इत्य् उपाँशु । "अनुब्रूहि" । इत्य् उच्चैस् ।
17.16.296.m: Drawing four portionings of clarified butter, he says, "To Tvaṣṭṛ," in a whisper, and "recite!" aloud.

17.16.296.s: atyākramyāśrāvyāha "tvaṣṭāram" ity upām̐śu "yaja" | ity uccais | vaṣaṭkṛte juhoti |
17.16.296.d: अत्याक्रम्याश्राव्याह "त्वष्टारम्" इत्य् उपाँशु "यज" । इत्य् उच्चैस् । वषट्कृते जुहोति ।
17.16.296.m: Having stepped across and made the call, he says, "For Tvaṣṭṛ," in a whisper, and "recite the offering-verse!" aloud. When the vaṣaṭ call is uttered, he offers.

17.16.296.s: iti nu haviṣaḥ praticarati | ājyena diśo juhoti pṛṣadājyena vanaspatim
17.16.296.d: इति नु हविषः प्रतिचरति । आज्येन दिशो जुहोति पृषदाज्येन वनस्पतिम्
17.16.296.m: Thus indeed he performs [the offering] of the main oblation. With clarified butter he offers to the quarters; with clotted butter to the Lord of the Forest.

17.16.296.s: ājyasya sviṣṭakṛtam ājyasyeḍām avadyati pṛṣadājyenānūyājān yajati
17.16.296.d: आज्यस्य स्विष्टकृतम् आज्यस्येडाम् अवद्यति पृषदाज्येनानूयाजान् यजति
17.16.296.m: He offers [to Agni] Sviṣṭakṛt with clarified butter; he cuts off the iḍā portion from the clarified butter; he performs the after-offerings with clotted butter.

17.16.297.d: सो ऽत्रैव पत्नीः संयाज्यात्रैव समिष्टयजूँषि जुहोति
17.16.297.m: Right here he performs the wife-accompanying offerings; right here he offers the concluding oblations.
The ritual relating to the wives of the gods comes to a conclusion.

17.17.297.s: atha vai bhavati yo 'gnyādheyena nardhnoti sa punarādheyamādhatte yo 'gniṃ citvā nardhnoti sa punaścitiṃ cinute | iti |
17.17.297.d: अथ वै भवति यो ऽग्न्याधेयेन नर्ध्नोति स पुनराधेयमाधत्ते यो ऽग्निं चित्वा नर्ध्नोति स पुनश्चितिं चिनुते । इति ।
17.17.297.m: Now indeed it is said: "He who does not prosper through the setting up of the sacred fires sets them up anew; he who does not prosper after piling the fire altar piles the altar anew."

17.17.297.s: agniṃ citvā jyānāno dvādaśeṣṭakā upakalpayate 'ṣṭau yājuṣīś catasro lokaṃpṛṇāḥ
17.17.297.d: अग्निं चित्वा ज्यानानो द्वादशेष्टका उपकल्पयते ऽष्टौ याजुषीश् चतस्रो लोकंपृणाः
17.17.297.m: Suffering loss after having piled the fire altar, he procures twelve bricks: eight with sacrificial formulas and four space-filling bricks.

17.17.297.s: sa yatra hottaravedir vyāghāritopanyuptasaṃbhārā bhavati tad dvābhyām ātmany agniṃ gṛhṇīte mayi gṛhṇāmy agre agnim | yo no agnis | iti
17.17.297.d: स यत्र होत्तरवेदिर् व्याघारितोपन्युप्तसंभारा भवति तद् द्वाभ्याम् आत्मन्य् अग्निं गृह्णीते मयि गृह्णाम्य् अग्रे अग्निम् । यो नो अग्निस् । इति
17.17.297.m: When the high altar has been sprinkled with clarified butter and the materials scattered upon it, he then takes the fire into himself with two [formulas]: "In me I first take Agni..." and "The fire that is ours..."

17.17.297.s: svayaṃcitiṃ japati yās te agne samidho yāni dhāma | iti
17.17.297.d: स्वयंचितिं जपति यास् ते अग्ने समिधो यानि धाम । इति
17.17.297.m: He mutters the formula of the self-piling: "Agni, whatever kinds of kindling wood and whatever dwellings are thine..."

17.17.297.s: śvetam aśvam abhimṛśyāṣṭau yājuṣīr upadadhāti yenarṣayas tapasā sattram āsata | iti
17.17.297.d: श्वेतम् अश्वम् अभिमृश्याष्टौ याजुषीर् उपदधाति येनर्षयस् तपसा सत्त्रम् आसत । इति
17.17.297.m: Having touched a white horse, he places eight bricks with formulas, [reciting]: "Whereby the seers through ascetic heat sat down at the sacrificial session..."

17.17.297.s: catasro lokaṃpṛṇās | lokaṃ pṛṇa chidraṃ pṛṇa | iti |
17.17.297.d: चतस्रो लोकंपृणास् । लोकं पृण छिद्रं पृण । इति ।
17.17.297.m: He places four space-filling bricks, [reciting]: "Fill the space, fill the gap..."

17.17.297.s: atha citikḷptyābhimṛśati cittim acittiṃ cinavad vi vidvān iti |
17.17.297.d: अथ चितिकॢप्त्याभिमृशति चित्तिम् अचित्तिं चिनवद् वि विद्वान् इति ।
17.17.297.m: Then he touches it with the formula for the arrangement of the layer: "May the wise one distinguish between intention and non-intention..."

17.17.297.s: āgneyyā gāyatriyaitāṃ citim abhimṛśya dvābhyām avadravati vāṅ ma āsan prāṇadās | iti
17.17.297.d: आग्नेय्या गायत्रियैतां चितिम् अभिमृश्य द्वाभ्याम् अवद्रवति वाङ् म आसन् प्राणदास् । इति
17.17.297.m: Having touched this layer with an Āgneya verse in the gāyatrī metre, he steps down with two [formulas]: "Speech is in my mouth..." and "Bestower of breath..."

17.17.297.s: tāyate paśubandho vāgniṣṭomo vā sa prajñātaḥ saṃtiṣṭhate ||
17.17.297.d: तायते पशुबन्धो वाग्निष्टोमो वा स प्रज्ञातः संतिष्ठते ॥
17.17.297.m: Either an animal sacrifice or an agniṣṭoma is performed; it is brought to conclusion according to the known procedure.

17.18.297.s: jarvaro gṛhapatir dhṛtarāṣṭra airāvato brahmā dattas tāpaso hotā pṛthuśravā dūreśravā udgātā glāvaś cājagāvaś ca prastotṛpratihartārau śitipṛṣṭho maitrāvaruṇas takṣako vaiśāleyo brāhmaṇāccham̐sy uparītis tarkṣyaḥ sadasyaḥ śikhātiśikhau neṣṭāpotārāvaruṇo 'hyo 'cchāvākaś cakrapiśaṅgāvāgnīdhrāvajiro māheyaḥ subrahmaṇyo 'rbudo grāvastut sāṇḍa unnetā paśukro dhruvagopaḥ kautustāv adhvaryū arimejayaś ca janamejayaś ca |
17.18.297.d: जर्वरो गृहपतिर् धृतराष्ट्र ऐरावतो ब्रह्मा दत्तस् तापसो होता पृथुश्रवा दूरेश्रवा उद्गाता ग्लावश् चाजगावश् च प्रस्तोतृप्रतिहर्तारौ शितिपृष्ठो मैत्रावरुणस् तक्षको वैशालेयो ब्राह्मणाच्छँस्य् उपरीतिस् तर्क्ष्यः सदस्यः शिखातिशिखौ नेष्टापोतारावरुणो ऽह्यो ऽच्छावाकश् चक्रपिशङ्गावाग्नीध्रावजिरो माहेयः सुब्रह्मण्यो ऽर्बुदो ग्रावस्तुत् साण्ड उन्नेता पशुक्रो ध्रुवगोपः कौतुस्ताव् अध्वर्यू अरिमेजयश् च जनमेजयश् च ।
17.18.297.m: "Jarvara was the householder; Dhṛtarāṣṭra Airāvata was the brahman priest; Datta Tāpasa was the hotṛ priest; Pṛthuśravas Dūreśravas was the udgātṛ priest; Glāva and Ajagāva were the prastotṛ and pratihartṛ priests; Śitipṛṣṭha was the maitrāvaruṇa priest; Takṣaka Vaiśāleya was the brāhmaṇācchaṃsin priest; Uparīti Tārkṣya was the sadasya priest; Śikha and Atiśikha were the neṣṭṛ and potṛ priests; Aruṇa and Ahya were the acchāvāka priest; Cakra and Piśaṅga were the two āgnīdhra priests; Avajira Māheya was the subrahmaṇya priest; Arbuda was the grāvastut priest; Sāṇḍa was the unnetṛ priest; Paśukra was the dhruvagopa priest; the two Kautustas, Arimejaya and Janamejaya, were the two adhvaryu priests."

17.18.298.s: ete vai sarpāṇām̐ rājānaś ca rājaputrāś ca khāṇḍave prasthe sattram āsata puruṣarūpeṇa viṣakāmās
17.18.298.d: एते वै सर्पाणाँ राजानश् च राजपुत्राश् च खाण्डवे प्रस्थे सत्त्रम् आसत पुरुषरूपेण विषकामास्
17.18.298.m: "These were kings and princes of the serpents who performed a sacrificial session in the Khāṇḍava plain in human form, desiring poison."

17.18.298.s: teṣāṃ daśastomāny anyāny ahāny āsan dvādaśastomāny anyāny ākṣīyanti ca
17.18.298.d: तेषां दशस्तोमान्य् अन्यान्य् अहान्य् आसन् द्वादशस्तोमान्य् अन्यान्य् आक्षीयन्ति च
17.18.298.m: "Some of their days had ten stomas, others twelve stomas, and they grew rich."

17.18.298.s: sa yad daśadaśeti tasmāt sarpā dam̐śukā dam̐śavīryās tad etal laukyaṃ pautrīyaṃ paśavyam̐ sattraṃ
17.18.298.d: स यद् दशदशेति तस्मात् सर्पा दँशुका दँशवीर्यास् तद् एतल् लौक्यं पौत्रीयं पशव्यँ सत्त्रं
17.18.298.m: "Because it was 'ten by ten', therefore serpents bite and possess biting power. That is this sacrificial session yielding world, offspring, and cattle."

17.18.298.s: ya etad upayanti naitān sarpā him̐santi ||
17.18.298.d: य एतद् उपयन्ति नैतान् सर्पा हिँसन्ति ॥
17.18.298.m: "Serpents do not harm those who undertake this [session]."

17.19.298.s: tapo gṛhapatir irā patnī brahmaiva brahmā satyam̐ hotāmṛtam udgātā bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyac ca prastotṛpratihartārāvṛtaṃ maitrāvaruṇa ṛtavaḥ sadasyā ārtavā upagātāras tejo brāhmaṇāccham̐sī yaśo 'cchāvākas tviṣiś cāpacitiś ca neṣṭāpotārāvagnir evāgnīdhro vāk subrahmaṇyo bhago grāvastud ūrg unnetā balaṃ dhruvagopo mano 'dhvaryuś cakṣuḥ pratiprasthātā sediścāśanayā cedhmavāhau diṣṭir viśās tā mṛtyuḥ śamitā |
17.19.298.d: तपो गृहपतिर् इरा पत्नी ब्रह्मैव ब्रह्मा सत्यँ होतामृतम् उद्गाता भूतं भविष्यच् च प्रस्तोतृप्रतिहर्तारावृतं मैत्रावरुण ऋतवः सदस्या आर्तवा उपगातारस् तेजो ब्राह्मणाच्छँसी यशो ऽच्छावाकस् त्विषिश् चापचितिश् च नेष्टापोतारावग्निर् एवाग्नीध्रो वाक् सुब्रह्मण्यो भगो ग्रावस्तुद् ऊर्ग् उन्नेता बलं ध्रुवगोपो मनो ऽध्वर्युश् चक्षुः प्रतिप्रस्थाता सेदिश्चाशनया चेध्मवाहौ दिष्टिर् विशास् ता मृत्युः शमिता ।
17.19.298.m: "Austerity was the householder; Irā was the wife; the Brahman itself was the brahman priest; Truth was the hotṛ priest; Immortality was the udgātṛ priest; Past and Future were the prastotṛ and pratihartṛ priests; Order was the maitrāvaruṇa priest; the seasons were the sadasya priests; the seasonal divisions were the assisting singers; Brilliance was the brāhmaṇācchaṃsin priest; Fame was the acchāvāka priest; Splendour and Reverence were the neṣṭṛ and potṛ priests; Fire itself was the āgnīdhra priest; Speech was the subrahmaṇya priest; Bhaga was the grāvastut priest; Vigour was the unnetṛ priest; Strength was the dhruvagopa priest; Mind was the adhvaryu priest; Sight was the pratiprasthātṛ priest; Exhaustion and Hunger were the two fuel-carriers; Destiny was the carver of the victim; Death was the slaughterer."

17.19.299.s: ete vai viśvasṛjaḥ prathamāḥ sattram āsāṃ cikrire
17.19.299.d: एते वै विश्वसृजः प्रथमाः सत्त्रम् आसां चिक्रिरे
17.19.299.m: "These All-creators indeed first performed a sacrificial session."

17.19.299.s: teṣām̐ śatam̐ samā dīkṣā āsañ chatam upasadaḥ sahasraṃ prasutās
17.19.299.d: तेषाँ शतँ समा दीक्षा आसञ् छतम् उपसदः सहस्रं प्रसुतास्
17.19.299.m: "Their consecrations lasted a hundred years; the upasad days a hundred; a thousand were the days of pressing."

17.19.299.s: tad eṣābhivadati viśvasṛjaḥ prathamāḥ sattram āsata sahasrasamaṃ prasutena yantaḥ | tato miṣad amiṣat saṃbabhūva tato ha jajñe bhuvanasya gopās | iti |
17.19.299.d: तद् एषाभिवदति विश्वसृजः प्रथमाः सत्त्रम् आसत सहस्रसमं प्रसुतेन यन्तः । ततो मिषद् अमिषत् संबभूव ततो ह जज्ञे भुवनस्य गोपास् । इति ।
17.19.299.m: "Regarding this, the verse says: 'The All-creators first performed a sacrificial session, proceeding with pressing for a thousand years. Thence what blinks and what blinks not came into being; thence indeed was born the guardian of the world.'"

17.19.299.s: agniṣṭomair vāva te tadīyus tad etad ṛddham ayanaṃ prajananaṃ yad agniṣṭomāḥ ||
17.19.299.d: अग्निष्टोमैर् वाव ते तदीयुस् तद् एतद् ऋद्धम् अयनं प्रजननं यद् अग्निष्टोमाः ॥
17.19.299.m: "They proceeded indeed with agniṣṭomas. This is that prosperous course, generating [offspring], which is the agniṣṭomas."

17.20.299.s: kuṇḍapāyinām ayanenaiṣyanto dīkṣante pañca sarvato dhurās
17.20.299.d: कुण्डपायिनाम् अयनेनैष्यन्तो दीक्षन्ते पञ्च सर्वतो धुरास्
17.20.299.m: Those who intend to proceed by the course of the Kuṇḍapāyins undergo consecration, five with axle-pins on all sides.

17.20.299.s: teṣām iyam eva prajñātā saṃvatsaradīkṣā samānaṃ karmārambhaṇīyāt |
17.20.299.d: तेषाम् इयम् एव प्रज्ञाता संवत्सरदीक्षा समानं कर्मारम्भणीयात् ।
17.20.299.m: Their year-long consecration is this very known one. The ritual procedure is the same up to the introductory offering.

17.20.299.s: ārambhaṇīyeneṣṭvaindraṃ payo dohayati saṃnāyyasya vāvṛtā tūṣṇīṃ vā |
17.20.299.d: आरम्भणीयेनेष्ट्वैन्द्रं पयो दोहयति संनाय्यस्य वावृता तूष्णीं वा ।
17.20.299.m: Having offered with the introductory offering, he causes the milk for Indra to be milked, either according to the ritual procedure of the curd-and-milk oblation or silently.

17.20.299.s: atha vasatīvarīḥ parihṛtyāviśiṣya payām̐sy upavasanti | atha śvo bhūta āmāvāsyena haviṣā yajante
17.20.299.d: अथ वसतीवरीः परिहृत्याविशिष्य पयाँस्य् उपवसन्ति । अथ श्वो भूत आमावास्येन हविषा यजन्ते
17.20.299.m: Then, having carried round the vasatīvarī waters, without leaving any remainder of the milk, they fast. Then, on the next day, they sacrifice with the new-moon oblation.
With that they proceed for twenty-eight days.

17.20.300.s: prāyaṇīyārambhaṇīyau sa māsaḥ paurṇamāsahavirbhir yanti māsam |
17.20.300.d: प्रायणीयारम्भणीयौ स मासः पौर्णमासहविर्भिर् यन्ति मासम् ।
17.20.300.m: The introductory and opening [rites make two days]; that is a month. They proceed for a month with the oblations of the full-moon sacrifice.

17.20.300.s: vaiśvadevahavirbhir yanti māsam | varuṇapraghāsahavirbhir yanti māsam |
17.20.300.d: वैश्वदेवहविर्भिर् यन्ति मासम् । वरुणप्रघासहविर्भिर् यन्ति मासम् ।
17.20.300.m: They proceed for a month with the oblations of the Vaiśvadeva rite. They proceed for a month with the oblations of the Varuṇapraghāsa rite.
They proceed for a month with the oblations of the Sākamedha rite.

17.20.300.s: śunāsīrīyahavirbhir yanti ṣaḍvim̐śatir ahāni | abhijittrayaḥ parasāmānaḥ
17.20.300.d: शुनासीरीयहविर्भिर् यन्ति षड्विँशतिर् अहानि । अभिजित्त्रयः परसामानः
17.20.300.m: They proceed for twenty-six days with the oblations of the Śunāsīrīya rite. [Then follow] the Abhijit and the three Parasāman days.

17.20.300.s: sa māsas | vaiṣuvatam | trayo 'rvāksāmānas | atha viśvajit
17.20.300.d: स मासस् । वैषुवतम् । त्रयो ऽर्वाक्सामानस् । अथ विश्वजित्
17.20.300.m: That is a month. The central day; the three Arvāksāman days; then the Viśvajit.

17.20.300.s: trayastrim̐śena yanti māsam | triṇavena yanti māsam ekavim̐śena yanti māsam |
17.20.300.d: त्रयस्त्रिँशेन यन्ति मासम् । त्रिणवेन यन्ति मासम् एकविँशेन यन्ति मासम् ।
17.20.300.m: They proceed for a month with the thirty-three-fold [stoma]. They proceed for a month with the twenty-seven-fold [stoma]. They proceed for a month with the twenty-one-fold [stoma].

17.20.300.s: saptadaśena yanti māsam | pañcadaśena yanti māsam |
17.20.300.d: सप्तदशेन यन्ति मासम् । पञ्चदशेन यन्ति मासम् ।
17.20.300.m: They proceed for a month with the seventeen-fold [stoma]. They proceed for a month with the fifteen-fold [stoma].
They proceed for twelve days with the ninefold [stoma]; [then] the Go and Āyus days.

17.20.300.s: tāni caturdaśa catvāry ūrdhvaṃ vaiṣuvatāt tāny aṣṭādaśa daśarātro mahāvrataṃ cātirātraś ca
17.20.300.d: तानि चतुर्दश चत्वार्य् ऊर्ध्वं वैषुवतात् तान्य् अष्टादश दशरात्रो महाव्रतं चातिरात्रश् च
17.20.300.m: Those are fourteen. There are four above the central day; those are eighteen. [Then] the ten-night period, the Mahāvrata, and the Atirātra.

17.21.300.s: athaiṣāṃ kuṇḍāni te yat sarva eva trivedaso bhavanti tad eṣāṃ kuṇḍam
17.21.300.d: अथैषां कुण्डानि ते यत् सर्व एव त्रिवेदसो भवन्ति तद् एषां कुण्डम्
17.21.300.m: Now, their bowls: that they are all possessing threefold wealth, that is their bowl.

17.21.300.s: atha yad anyo'nyam anuparisarpaṃ yājayanti tad eṣāṃ kuṇḍam
17.21.300.d: अथ यद् अन्योऽन्यम् अनुपरिसर्पं याजयन्ति तद् एषां कुण्डम्
17.21.300.m: Then, that they cause each other to sacrifice creeping around after one another, that is their bowl.

17.21.300.s: atha yadatsarukaiś camasair bhakṣayanti tad eṣāṃ kuṇḍam | teṣāṃ ya eva brahmā sa eva brāhmaṇāccham̐sī sa potā |
17.21.300.d: अथ यदत्सरुकैश् चमसैर् भक्षयन्ति तद् एषां कुण्डम् । तेषां य एव ब्रह्मा स एव ब्राह्मणाच्छँसी स पोता ।
17.21.300.m: Then, that they consume with handleless cups, that is their bowl. Among them, he who is the brahman priest is himself the brāhmaṇācchaṃsin, he the potṛ.

17.21.300.s: atha yo hotā sa eva maitrāvaruṇaḥ so 'cchāvākas |
17.21.300.d: अथ यो होता स एव मैत्रावरुणः सो ऽच्छावाकस् ।
17.21.300.m: Then, he who is the hotṛ priest is himself the maitrāvaruṇa, he the acchāvāka.

17.21.300.s: atha ya udgātā sa eva prastotā sa pratihartā |
17.21.300.d: अथ य उद्गाता स एव प्रस्तोता स प्रतिहर्ता ।
17.21.300.m: Then, he who is the udgātṛ priest is himself the prastotṛ, he the pratihartṛ.

17.21.301.s: atha yo 'dhvaryuḥ sa eva pratiprasthātā sa neṣṭā | atha ya āgnīdhraḥ sa eva grāvastut sa subrahmaṇyaḥ sa unnetā |
17.21.301.d: अथ यो ऽध्वर्युः स एव प्रतिप्रस्थाता स नेष्टा । अथ य आग्नीध्रः स एव ग्रावस्तुत् स सुब्रह्मण्यः स उन्नेता ।
17.21.301.m: Then, he who is the adhvaryu priest is himself the pratiprasthātṛ, he the neṣṭṛ. Then, he who is the āgnīdhra priest is himself the grāvastut, he the subrahmaṇya, he the unnetṛ.

17.21.301.s: agniś caturhotā vāyuḥ pañcahotā candramāḥ ṣaḍḍhotā prajāpatiḥ saptahotāsāv ādityo navahotā |
17.21.301.d: अग्निश् चतुर्होता वायुः पञ्चहोता चन्द्रमाः षड्ढोता प्रजापतिः सप्तहोतासाव् आदित्यो नवहोता ।
17.21.301.m: "Agni is the four-hotṛ; Vāyu is the five-hotṛ; the Moon is the six-hotṛ; Prajāpati is the seven-hotṛ; yonder Sun is the nine-hotṛ."

17.21.301.s: etā vai devatā etenāyanenāyan | tato vai tā ārdhnuvan
17.21.301.d: एता वै देवता एतेनायनेनायन् । ततो वै ता आर्ध्नुवन्
17.21.301.m: "These deities indeed went by this course. Then they prospered."

17.21.301.s: suvargaṃ lokam āyan ya evaṃ vidvām̐sa etenāyanena yanty ṛdhnuvanty eva suvargaṃ lokaṃ yanti ||
17.21.301.d: सुवर्गं लोकम् आयन् य एवं विद्वाँस एतेनायनेन यन्त्य् ऋध्नुवन्त्य् एव सुवर्गं लोकं यन्ति ॥
17.21.301.m: "They went to the heavenly world. Knowing thus, those who proceed by this course prosper indeed and go to the heavenly world."

17.22.301.s: utsargiṇām ayanenaiṣyanto dīkṣante teṣām iyam eva prajñātā saṃvatsaradīkṣā
17.22.301.d: उत्सर्गिणाम् अयनेनैष्यन्तो दीक्षन्ते तेषाम् इयम् एव प्रज्ञाता संवत्सरदीक्षा
17.22.301.m: Those who intend to proceed by the course of the Utsargins undergo consecration. Their year-long consecration is this very known one.

17.22.301.s: samānaṃ karmā pṛṣṭhyāt ṣaḍahāt pṛṣṭhyena ṣaḍaheneṣṭvaindraṃ payo dohayati sāṃnāyyasya vāvṛtā tūṣṇīṃ vā |
17.22.301.d: समानं कर्मा पृष्ठ्यात् षडहात् पृष्ठ्येन षडहेनेष्ट्वैन्द्रं पयो दोहयति सांनाय्यस्य वावृता तूष्णीं वा ।
17.22.301.m: The ritual procedure is the same up to the six-day pṛṣṭhya period. Having sacrificed with the six-day pṛṣṭhya period, he causes the milk for Indra to be milked, either according to the ritual procedure of the curd-and-milk oblation or silently.
Then, having carried round the vasatīvarī waters, without leaving any remainder of the milk, they fast.

17.22.301.s: atha prātarahar utsṛjya jyotiṣa āyatane prājāpatyaṃ paśum ālabhante
17.22.301.d: अथ प्रातरहर् उत्सृज्य ज्योतिष आयतने प्राजापत्यं पशुम् आलभन्ते
17.22.301.m: Then, in the morning, having omitted the day, they seize an animal victim for Prajāpati in the place of the Jyotis day.

17.22.301.d: तस्य पशुपुरोडाशम् अनुवर्तते ऽग्नये वसुमते पुरोडाशो ऽष्टाकपालस् ।
17.22.301.m: An eight-pot-sherd cake for Agni Vasumat follows its animal cake.

17.22.301.s: mādhyaṃdina indrāya marutvate puroḍāśam ekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapanty aindram̐ sāṃnāyyam |
17.22.301.d: माध्यंदिन इन्द्राय मरुत्वते पुरोडाशम् एकादशकपालं निर्वपन्त्य् ऐन्द्रँ सांनाय्यम् ।
17.22.301.m: At midday, they assign an eleven-pot-sherd cake for Indra Marutvat and curd-and-milk oblation for Indra.

17.22.301.s: sā dvihavir iṣṭiḥ saṃtiṣṭhate | atraitad aindram̐ sāṃnāyyam̐ samupahūya bhakṣayanti |
17.22.301.d: सा द्विहविर् इष्टिः संतिष्ठते । अत्रैतद् ऐन्द्रँ सांनाय्यँ समुपहूय भक्षयन्ति ।
17.22.301.m: That sacrifice of two oblations is completed. Here, having invited one another, they consume this curd-and-milk oblation for Indra.

17.22.301.s: athāparāhṇe vaiśvadevaṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapanti vaiśvadevaṃ carum |
17.22.301.d: अथापराह्णे वैश्वदेवं द्वादशकपालं निर्वपन्ति वैश्वदेवं चरुम् ।
17.22.301.m: Then, in the afternoon, they assign a twelve-pot-sherd cake for the All-gods and a mess of boiled rice for the All-gods.
They perform with both of them, beginning with the deities and ending with the iḍā.

17.22.302.s: atha paśunā carati manotāprabhṛtineḍāntena | athānūyājaiś caritvā pradakṣiṇam āvṛtya pratyaṅṅ ādrutya patnīḥ saṃyājya prāṅ etya dhruvām āpyāyya vasatīvarīḥ parihṛtya payām̐si viśiṣyopavasanti |
17.22.302.d: अथ पशुना चरति मनोताप्रभृतिनेडान्तेन । अथानूयाजैश् चरित्वा प्रदक्षिणम् आवृत्य प्रत्यङ्ङ् आद्रुत्य पत्नीः संयाज्य प्राङ् एत्य ध्रुवाम् आप्याय्य वसतीवरीः परिहृत्य पयाँसि विशिष्योपवसन्ति ।
17.22.302.m: Then he performs with the animal [victim], beginning with the manotā hymn and ending with the iḍā. Then, having performed with the after-offerings, turning clockwise, running to the west, having performed the offerings to the wives [of the gods], having gone eastward, having swelled the dhruvā ladle, having carried round the vasatīvarī waters, having left a remainder of the milk, they fast.
Then, on the next day, they enter upon [the rite] with the Go day.

17.22.302.s: ta evam evaitena yanto māsimāsy utsṛjantaḥ pañca jyotīm̐ṣy utsṛjanti |
17.22.302.d: त एवम् एवैतेन यन्तो मासिमास्य् उत्सृजन्तः पञ्च ज्योतीँष्य् उत्सृजन्ति ।
17.22.302.m: Proceeding thus in this manner, omitting month after month, they omit five Jyotis days.

17.22.302.s: athāmuta āvṛttām̐ś caturaś ca trayastrim̐śastomān utsṛjanty ekaṃ ca jyotis |
17.22.302.d: अथामुत आवृत्ताँश् चतुरश् च त्रयस्त्रिँशस्तोमान् उत्सृजन्त्य् एकं च ज्योतिस् ।
17.22.302.m: Then, turned back from yonder, they omit four thirty-three-fold stomas and one Jyotis day.
Then, on the next day, they enter upon [the rite] with the Āyus day itself.

17.23.302.s: tapaścitām ayanenaiṣyanto dīkṣante teṣām iyam eva prajñātāgnidīkṣā
17.23.302.d: तपश्चिताम् अयनेनैष्यन्तो दीक्षन्ते तेषाम् इयम् एव प्रज्ञाताग्निदीक्षा
17.23.302.m: Those who intend to proceed by the course of the Tapaścits undergo consecration. Their consecration with the fire is this very known one.

17.23.302.s: samānaṃ karmā saṃnivāpāt prasiddhaḥ saṃnivāpas | atha prāyaṇīyena carati
17.23.302.d: समानं कर्मा संनिवापात् प्रसिद्धः संनिवापस् । अथ प्रायणीयेन चरति
17.23.302.m: The ritual procedure is the same up to the commingling [of the oblations]. The commingling is well known. Then he performs with the opening offering.

17.23.302.s: prāyaṇīyena caritvā padena carati padena caritvā rājānaṃ krītvohyātithyaṃ nirvapati |
17.23.302.d: प्रायणीयेन चरित्वा पदेन चरति पदेन चरित्वा राजानं क्रीत्वोह्यातिथ्यं निर्वपति ।
17.23.302.m: Having performed with the opening offering, he performs with the footprint [of the cow]. Having performed with the footprint and bought the King [Soma], he brings [him] and assigns the guest-offering.

17.23.302.s: ātithyena pracaryāthaitāṃ pañcahaviṣam iṣṭiṃ nirvapaty āgneyam aṣṭākapālam aindram ekādaśakapālaṃ vaiśvadevaṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ bārhaspatyaṃ caruṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ trikapālam iti
17.23.302.d: आतिथ्येन प्रचर्याथैतां पञ्चहविषम् इष्टिं निर्वपत्य् आग्नेयम् अष्टाकपालम् ऐन्द्रम् एकादशकपालं वैश्वदेवं द्वादशकपालं बार्हस्पत्यं चरुं वैष्णवं त्रिकपालम् इति
17.23.302.m: Having performed the hospitality offering, he then offers this five-oblation sacrifice: a cake on eight potsherds for Agni, a cake on eleven potsherds for Indra, a cake on twelve potsherds for the Viśvedevas, a cooked grain offering for Bṛhaspati, and a cake on three potsherds for Viṣṇu.

17.23.302.s: tayā sakṛd eveṣṭvā nādriyerann ity eka āhus | etayaivāharahaḥ saṃvatsaraṃ yajerann ity eke
17.23.302.d: तया सकृद् एवेष्ट्वा नाद्रियेरन्न् इत्य् एक आहुस् । एतयैवाहरहः संवत्सरं यजेरन्न् इत्य् एके
17.23.302.m: Some say that having offered with this once only, they should pay no further regard to it; others say that with this very [offering] they should sacrifice day after day for a year.

17.23.302.s: prathame 'han sarvair anvaham ekaikayā ṣaṣṭhe 'han sarvair anvaham ekaikayā
17.23.302.d: प्रथमे ऽहन् सर्वैर् अन्वहम् एकैकया षष्ठे ऽहन् सर्वैर् अन्वहम् एकैकया
17.23.302.m: On the first day [they offer] with all [oblations], and each day thereafter with one [at a time]; on the sixth day [they offer] with all, and each day thereafter with one [at a time].

17.23.302.s: prathame dvādaśāhe 'gniṃ cinvītety eka āhus tad u vā āhus | rudro vā eṣa yad agniḥ
17.23.302.d: प्रथमे द्वादशाहे ऽग्निं चिन्वीतेत्य् एक आहुस् तद् उ वा आहुस् । रुद्रो वा एष यद् अग्निः
17.23.302.m: Some say: "He should pile the fire altar in the first twelve-day period." But concerning that, they also say: "Agni is Rudra indeed."

17.23.303.s: sa etarhi jāto yarhi sarvaś citaḥ
17.23.303.d: स एतर्हि जातो यर्हि सर्वश् चितः
17.23.303.m: "He is born at this moment, when he is completely piled."

17.23.303.s: sa yathā vatso jāta stanaṃ prepsaty evaṃ vā eṣa etarhi bhāgadheyaṃ prepsati
17.23.303.d: स यथा वत्सो जात स्तनं प्रेप्सत्य् एवं वा एष एतर्हि भागधेयं प्रेप्सति
17.23.303.m: "Just as a newborn calf desires to reach the teat, so indeed he desires to reach his share at this moment."

17.23.303.s: saṃvatsara evevāsyāto bhāgadheyam | naitasyāśāṃ caneyāt | iti |
17.23.303.d: संवत्सर एवेवास्यातो भागधेयम् । नैतस्याशां चनेयात् । इति ।
17.23.303.m: "A whole year is indeed his share from that point onward; one should not run counter even to his expectation."

17.23.303.d: उत्तमे द्वादशाहे ऽग्निं चिन्वीतेत्य् एतद् अपरम् ॥
17.23.303.m: This is another view: "He should pile the fire altar during the final twelve-day period."

17.24.303.d: अथातो ऽहरहश् चयनस्यैव मीमाँसा सद्यश्चितिं निस्तिष्ठन्ति ।
17.24.303.m: Now follows the critical consideration of piling day after day. They complete a layer in a single day.

17.24.303.s: atha lokaṃpṛṇā iṣṭakā upadadhan māsam eti māsi tayādevataṃ kurute
17.24.303.d: अथ लोकंपृणा इष्टका उपदधन् मासम् एति मासि तयादेवतं कुरुते
17.24.303.m: Then, laying space-filling bricks, he continues for a month. At the end of the month, he consecrates it with the formula: "By that deity..."

17.24.303.s: dvitīye māse purīṣacitiḥ sadyaścitiṃ nistiṣṭhanti | atha muṣṭhino 'nuprakāraṃ māsam eti
17.24.303.d: द्वितीये मासे पुरीषचितिः सद्यश्चितिं निस्तिष्ठन्ति । अथ मुष्ठिनो ऽनुप्रकारं मासम् एति
17.24.303.m: In the second month is the layer of loose soil. They complete a layer in a single day. Then, following the arrangement of handfuls, he continues for a month.

17.24.303.s: māsi tayādevataṃ kurute tṛtīye māse vaṇḍacitis |
17.24.303.d: मासि तयादेवतं कुरुते तृतीये मासे वण्डचितिस् ।
17.24.303.m: At the end of the month, he consecrates it with the formula: "By that deity..." In the third month is the vaṇḍaciti layer.

17.24.303.s: caturthe māse purīḍacitiḥ pañcame māse madhyamā citiḥ
17.24.303.d: चतुर्थे मासे पुरीडचितिः पञ्चमे मासे मध्यमा चितिः
17.24.303.m: In the fourth month is the layer of loose soil. In the fifth month is the middle layer.

17.24.303.s: ṣaṣṭhe māse purīṣacitiḥ saptame māse vaṇḍacitis |
17.24.303.d: षष्ठे मासे पुरीषचितिः सप्तमे मासे वण्डचितिस् ।
17.24.303.m: In the sixth month is the layer of loose soil. In the seventh month is the vaṇḍaciti layer.

17.24.303.s: aṣṭame māse purīṣacitis | navame māse sapta skandhyā upadadhāty ā nakṣatreṣṭakābhyas |
17.24.303.d: अष्टमे मासे पुरीषचितिस् । नवमे मासे सप्त स्कन्ध्या उपदधात्य् आ नक्षत्रेष्टकाभ्यस् ।
17.24.303.m: In the eighth month is the layer of loose soil. In the ninth month, he places seven shoulder-bricks up to the constellation-bricks.

17.24.303.s: daśame māse purīṣacitis | ekādaśe māse saṃyac ca pracetāś cety etā upadadhāty ā vikarṇes |
17.24.303.d: दशमे मासे पुरीषचितिस् । एकादशे मासे संयच् च प्रचेताश् चेत्य् एता उपदधात्य् आ विकर्णेस् ।
17.24.303.m: In the tenth month is the layer of loose soil. In the eleventh month, he places the bricks [with the formulas] 'Restraining' and 'Attentive', up to the vikarṇī brick.
For twenty-eight days of the twelfth month, [he spreads] loose soil.

17.24.304.m: On the twenty-ninth [day, he performs] the Śatarudrīya offering.

17.25.304.s: athopariṣṭān māsam ity ācakṣate māsasya prathame 'han sadyaścitiṃ nistiṣṭhanti satayādevatam̐ sasūdadohasam |
17.25.304.d: अथोपरिष्टान् मासम् इत्य् आचक्षते मासस्य प्रथमे ऽहन् सद्यश्चितिं निस्तिष्ठन्ति सतयादेवतँ ससूददोहसम् ।
17.25.304.m: Now, they describe [the procedure of] a month afterwards: on the first day of the month they complete a layer in a single day, accompanied by the Tayādevatā formula and accompanied by the Sūdadohas verse.
They proceed through the month with the pravargya and the upasads.
On the first day of the second month is the layer of loose soil.
They complete a layer in a single day, accompanied by the Tayādevatā formula and accompanied by the Sūdadohas verse.

17.25.304.s: dvitīyaṃ māsaṃ pravargyopasadbhyāṃ yanti tṛtīyasya māsasya prathame 'han vaṇḍacitis |
17.25.304.d: द्वितीयं मासं प्रवर्ग्योपसद्भ्यां यन्ति तृतीयस्य मासस्य प्रथमे ऽहन् वण्डचितिस् ।
17.25.304.m: They proceed through the second month with the pravargya and the upasads. On the first day of the third month is the vaṇḍaciti layer.

17.25.304.s: caturthasya māsasya prathame 'han purīṣacitiḥ pañcamasya māsasya prathame 'han madhyamā citiḥ
17.25.304.d: चतुर्थस्य मासस्य प्रथमे ऽहन् पुरीषचितिः पञ्चमस्य मासस्य प्रथमे ऽहन् मध्यमा चितिः
17.25.304.m: On the first day of the fourth month is the layer of loose soil. On the first day of the fifth month is the middle layer.
On the first day of the sixth month is the layer of loose soil.
On the first day of the seventh month [takes place] the vaṇḍa layer.

17.25.304.s: aṣṭamasya māsasya prathame 'han purīṣacitis | navamasya māsasya prathame 'han sapta skandhyā upadadhāty ā nakṣatreṣṭakābhyas |
17.25.304.d: अष्टमस्य मासस्य प्रथमे ऽहन् पुरीषचितिस् । नवमस्य मासस्य प्रथमे ऽहन् सप्त स्कन्ध्या उपदधात्य् आ नक्षत्रेष्टकाभ्यस् ।
17.25.304.m: On the first day of the eighth month [takes place] the soil layer. / On the first day of the ninth month he lays down the seven skandhyā bricks up to the nakṣatra bricks.
On the first day of the tenth month [takes place] the soil layer.

17.25.304.s: ekādaśasya māsasya prathame 'han saṃyac ca pracetāś cety etā upadadhāty ā vikarṇes |
17.25.304.d: एकादशस्य मासस्य प्रथमे ऽहन् संयच् च प्रचेताश् चेत्य् एता उपदधात्य् आ विकर्णेस् ।
17.25.304.m: On the first day of the eleventh month he lays down these [bricks]—'saṃyac ca pracetāś ca'—up to the vikarṇī bricks.
On the first day of the twelfth month [takes place] the soil layer.
On the twenty-ninth [day takes place] the Śatarudrīya [offering]. / On the next day, the Vasordhārā.

17.26.304.s: atha purastān māsam ity ācakṣate māsaṃ pravargyopasadbhyāṃ yanti
17.26.304.d: अथ पुरस्तान् मासम् इत्य् आचक्षते मासं प्रवर्ग्योपसद्भ्यां यन्ति
17.26.304.m: Now they speak of the 'month at the beginning': / they proceed for a month with the Pravargya and the Upasads.

17.26.305.d: मासस्योत्तमे ऽहन् सद्यश्चितिं निस्तिष्ठन्ति सतयादेवतँ ससूददोहसम् ।
17.26.305.m: On the last day of the month they complete the single-day layer with the Tayādevatam and Sūdadohas [mantras].

17.26.305.s: dvitīyaṃ māsaṃ pravargyopasadbhyāṃ yanti dvitīyasya māsasyottame 'han purīṣacitiḥ
17.26.305.d: द्वितीयं मासं प्रवर्ग्योपसद्भ्यां यन्ति द्वितीयस्य मासस्योत्तमे ऽहन् पुरीषचितिः
17.26.305.m: For the second month they proceed with the Pravargya and Upasads. / On the last day of the second month [takes place] the soil layer.
They complete the single-day layer with the Tayādevatam and Sūdadohas [mantras].
On the last day of the third month [takes place] the vaṇḍa layer.

17.26.305.s: caturthasya māsasyottame 'han purīṣacitiḥ pañcamasya māsasyottame 'han madhyamā citiḥ
17.26.305.d: चतुर्थस्य मासस्योत्तमे ऽहन् पुरीषचितिः पञ्चमस्य मासस्योत्तमे ऽहन् मध्यमा चितिः
17.26.305.m: On the last day of the fourth month [takes place] the soil layer. / On the last day of the fifth month [takes place] the middle layer.
On the last day of the sixth month [takes place] the soil layer.

17.26.305.s: saptamasya māsasyottame 'han vaṇḍacitis | aṣṭamasya māsasyottame 'han purīṣacitis |
17.26.305.d: सप्तमस्य मासस्योत्तमे ऽहन् वण्डचितिस् । अष्टमस्य मासस्योत्तमे ऽहन् पुरीषचितिस् ।
17.26.305.m: On the last day of the seventh month [takes place] the vaṇḍa layer. / On the last day of the eighth month [takes place] the soil layer.

17.26.305.s: navamasya māsasyottame 'han sapta skandhyā upadadhāty ā nakṣatreṣṭakābhas |
17.26.305.d: नवमस्य मासस्योत्तमे ऽहन् सप्त स्कन्ध्या उपदधात्य् आ नक्षत्रेष्टकाभस् ।
17.26.305.m: On the last day of the ninth month he lays down the seven skandhyā bricks up to the nakṣatra bricks.
On the last day of the tenth month [takes place] the soil layer.

17.26.305.s: ekādaśasya māsasyottame 'han saṃyac ca pracetāś cety etā upadadhāty ā vikarṇes |
17.26.305.d: एकादशस्य मासस्योत्तमे ऽहन् संयच् च प्रचेताश् चेत्य् एता उपदधात्य् आ विकर्णेस् ।
17.26.305.m: On the last day of the eleventh month he lays down these [bricks]—'saṃyac ca pracetāś ca'—up to the vikarṇī bricks.
On the twenty-eighth day of the twelfth month [takes place] the soil [layer].
On the twenty-ninth [day takes place] the Śatarudrīya [offering]. / On the next day, the Vasordhārā.

17.27.305.s: athāta utthānānām eva mīmām̐sā | abhijiteṣṭvottiṣṭheyus | ity etad brāhmaṇasaṃpannam
17.27.305.d: अथात उत्थानानाम् एव मीमाँसा । अभिजितेष्ट्वोत्तिष्ठेयुस् । इत्य् एतद् ब्राह्मणसंपन्नम्
17.27.305.m: Now follows the consideration of the departures [from the rite]: / 'Having sacrificed with the Abhijit, they should depart'—this is in accordance with the brāhmaṇa passage.

17.27.305.s: api vābhijiteṣṭvāthaitām̐ savaneṣṭiṃ nirvapanty āgneyam aṣṭākapālam aindram ekādaśakapālaṃ vaiśvadevaṃ dvādaśakapālam iti
17.27.305.d: अपि वाभिजितेष्ट्वाथैताँ सवनेष्टिं निर्वपन्त्य् आग्नेयम् अष्टाकपालम् ऐन्द्रम् एकादशकपालं वैश्वदेवं द्वादशकपालम् इति
17.27.305.m: Or else, having sacrificed with the Abhijit, they then offer this Savaneṣṭi: [a cake] on eight potsherds for Agni, [a cake] on eleven potsherds for Indra, and [a cake] on twelve potsherds for the Viśve Devas.

17.27.306.s: tayā samastayā vā vihṛtayā vā pratipadyante vasatīvarīṣu mṛtpiṇḍam anvavadhāyāharahar vasatīvarīḥ pariharamāṇā yanti |
17.27.306.d: तया समस्तया वा विहृतया वा प्रतिपद्यन्ते वसतीवरीषु मृत्पिण्डम् अन्ववधायाहरहर् वसतीवरीः परिहरमाणा यन्ति ।
17.27.306.m: They undertake [the rite] with it either combined or separated. / Having placed a lump of clay into the vasatīvarī waters, they proceed carrying the vasatīvarī waters around day after day.

17.27.306.s: atha saṃvatsarasaṃpannaṃ brahmaṇo 'yanam ity ācakṣate caturo māso dīkṣābhir yanti catura upasadbhiś caturo māsaḥ prasutās
17.27.306.d: अथ संवत्सरसंपन्नं ब्रह्मणो ऽयनम् इत्य् आचक्षते चतुरो मासो दीक्षाभिर् यन्ति चतुर उपसद्भिश् चतुरो मासः प्रसुतास्
17.27.306.m: Now they speak of the 'course of Brahman' that is completed in a year: / they proceed for four months with the consecrations, for four with the Upasads, and for four months they are pressing [soma].

17.27.306.s: tad āhus | ka etāvat tapas taptvānyasādhāraṇaṃ kurvīta |
17.27.306.d: तद् आहुस् । क एतावत् तपस् तप्त्वान्यसाधारणं कुर्वीत ।
17.27.306.m: Regarding this they say: 'Who, having undergone so much austerity, would make it common to others?'

17.27.306.s: antevāsiṣu vopahavam iccheta dakṣiṇāvatā vainaṃ yājayeyus | iti
17.27.306.d: अन्तेवासिषु वोपहवम् इच्छेत दक्षिणावता वैनं याजयेयुस् । इति
17.27.306.m: 'Or he should seek permission among resident pupils, or they should have him sacrifice with a ritual with dakṣiṇās.'

17.27.306.s: so 'ntevāsiṣu vaivopahavam icchate dakṣiṇāvatā vainaṃ yājayanti ||
17.27.306.d: सो ऽन्तेवासिषु वैवोपहवम् इच्छते दक्षिणावता वैनं याजयन्ति ॥
17.27.306.m: He indeed seeks permission among resident pupils, or they have him sacrifice with a ritual with dakṣiṇās.

17.28.306.s: atha vai bhavati chandaścitaṃ cinvīta paśukāmas | iti sa chandaścit |
17.28.306.d: अथ वै भवति छन्दश्चितं चिन्वीत पशुकामस् । इति स छन्दश्चित् ।
17.28.306.m: Now indeed it says: / 'One who desires cattle should pile [the fire-altar] in the metres' form.' / That is the chandaścit.

17.28.306.s: yatra kva cāhutir āgacchati juhoty eva tatra | atha yad anyad āhutibhyaḥ śarīravad yajur eva tatra japati yajur eva raśanayor yajur aśvagardabhayor yajur ukhāyai pravṛñjane
17.28.306.d: यत्र क्व चाहुतिर् आगच्छति जुहोत्य् एव तत्र । अथ यद् अन्यद् आहुतिभ्यः शरीरवद् यजुर् एव तत्र जपति यजुर् एव रशनयोर् यजुर् अश्वगर्दभयोर् यजुर् उखायै प्रवृञ्जने
17.28.306.m: Wherever an oblation occurs, he indeed offers there. / Then, whatever besides the oblations has a bodily action, he merely murmurs the yajus formula there: a yajus formula over the two halters, a yajus formula over the horse and the donkey, a yajus formula at the boiling of the ukhā pot.
He sacrifices with an animal for Vāyu.

17.28.306.s: dīkṣate vimāyāgniṃ parikhāyāpasyāyatane yajur eva tatra japati yajuḥ sarvāsām iṣṭakānām upadhāne
17.28.306.d: दीक्षते विमायाग्निं परिखायापस्यायतने यजुर् एव तत्र जपति यजुः सर्वासाम् इष्टकानाम् उपधाने
17.28.306.m: He undergoes consecration. / Having measured out the fire, having dug around, on the ground of the Apasya [bricks] he murmurs the yajus formula; a yajus formula at the laying down of all the bricks.

17.28.306.s: kurute vasordhārām | śyenacitaṃ cinvīta suvargakāmas | iti | ayam evaiṣa śyenacit
17.28.306.d: कुरुते वसोर्धाराम् । श्येनचितं चिन्वीत सुवर्गकामस् । इति । अयम् एवैष श्येनचित्
17.28.306.m: He performs the Vasordhārā. / 'One who desires heaven should pile [the fire-altar] in the form of an eagle.' / This very one is the śyenacit.

17.28.307.s: kaṅkacitaṃ cinvīta yaḥ kāmayeta śīrṣaṇvān amuṣmin loke syām iti |
17.28.307.d: कङ्कचितं चिन्वीत यः कामयेत शीर्षण्वान् अमुष्मिन् लोके स्याम् इति ।
17.28.307.m: 'One who desires, "May I have a head in that world," should pile [the fire-altar] in the form of a heron.'

17.28.307.s: etasyaiva sato 'ratnimātreṇa prāk śira iva nirūhati
17.28.307.d: एतस्यैव सतो ऽरत्निमात्रेण प्राक् शिर इव निरूहति
17.28.307.m: Of this very one being [so], he extends forward a kind of head by the measure of a cubit.

17.28.307.s: sa tathā vimito bhavati yathā na bahirvedi yūpaḥ syāt |
17.28.307.d: स तथा विमितो भवति यथा न बहिर्वेदि यूपः स्यात् ।
17.28.307.m: It is measured out in such a way that the sacrificial post is not outside the vedi.

17.28.307.s: alajacitaṃ cinvīta catuḥsītaṃ pratiṣṭhākāmas | iti | etasyaiva sato 'ratnimātreṇa pakṣāgrāvaṇīyām̐sau bhavatas
17.28.307.d: अलजचितं चिन्वीत चतुःसीतं प्रतिष्ठाकामस् । इति । एतस्यैव सतो ऽरत्निमात्रेण पक्षाग्रावणीयाँसौ भवतस्
17.28.307.m: 'One who desires firm support should pile [the fire-altar] in the form of an alaja bird with four furrows.' / Of this very one being [so], the tips of the wings are narrower by the measure of a cubit.
By the same measure the armpits of the wings are broader.
They are slightly curved away and become narrower towards the end.

17.28.307.s: ekaikām ṛcā sītāṃ kṛṣati praugacitaṃ cinvīta bhrātṛvyavān iti |
17.28.307.d: एकैकाम् ऋचा सीतां कृषति प्रौगचितं चिन्वीत भ्रातृव्यवान् इति ।
17.28.307.m: He plows each furrow with a verse. / 'One who has a rival should pile [the fire-altar] in the form of a triangle.'

17.28.307.s: etasyaiva sataḥ samudgṛhyām̐sau prāgāyātayati sa tathā vimito bhavati yathā na bahirvedi yūpaḥ syāt |
17.28.307.d: एतस्यैव सतः समुद्गृह्याँसौ प्रागायातयति स तथा विमितो भवति यथा न बहिर्वेदि यूपः स्यात् ।
17.28.307.m: Of this very one being [so], having raised the two shoulders, he extends them forward. / It is measured out in such a way that the sacrificial post is not outside the vedi.

17.28.307.s: ubhayataḥpraugaṃ cinvīta yaḥ kāmayeta prajātān bhrātṛvyān nudeya pratijaniṣyamāṇān iti |
17.28.307.d: उभयतःप्रौगं चिन्वीत यः कामयेत प्रजातान् भ्रातृव्यान् नुदेय प्रतिजनिष्यमाणान् इति ।
17.28.307.m: 'One who desires, "May I repel the rivals who are born and those who are yet to be born," should pile [the fire-altar] triangular at both ends.'

17.28.307.s: etasyaiva sataḥ samudgṛhyaiva śroṇī pratyagāyātayati sa tathā vimito bhavati yathā na bahirvedi yūpaḥ syāt ||
17.28.307.d: एतस्यैव सतः समुद्गृह्यैव श्रोणी प्रत्यगायातयति स तथा विमितो भवति यथा न बहिर्वेदि यूपः स्यात् ॥
17.28.307.m: Of this very one being [so], having raised the two hips, he extends them backward. / It is measured out in such a way that the sacrificial post is not outside the vedi.

17.29.307.m: 'One who has a rival should pile [the fire-altar] in the form of a chariot wheel,' so it is known.

17.29.307.s: ākṛtivikāraḥ śabdasaṃyogāt | yāvān agniḥ sāratniprādeśas tāvatīṃ bhūmiṃ parimaṇḍalāṃ kṛtvānuśarkaram antaḥśarkaram iṣṭakāḥ paricinoti |
17.29.307.d: आकृतिविकारः शब्दसंयोगात् । यावान् अग्निः सारत्निप्रादेशस् तावतीं भूमिं परिमण्डलां कृत्वानुशर्करम् अन्तःशर्करम् इष्टकाः परिचिनोति ।
17.29.307.m: The modification of the shape is due to the connection with the word. / Having made the ground circular, as large as the fire with the cubit and the span, he piles the bricks around along with gravel and within gravel.

17.29.307.s: athāntato 'thāntaratas | evam evā svayamātṛṇṇāyai | athābhitaḥ svayamātṛṇṇām |
17.29.307.d: अथान्ततो ऽथान्तरतस् । एवम् एवा स्वयमातृण्णायै । अथाभितः स्वयमातृण्णाम् ।
17.29.307.m: Then at the edge, then inside; / in this very manner up to the svayamātṛṇṇā brick; / then on both sides of the svayamātṛṇṇā brick.

17.29.308.s: madhye nābhim iva karoti tasyā anudiśam avāntaradiśam arān iva nemim iveṣṭakā āyātayati
17.29.308.d: मध्ये नाभिम् इव करोति तस्या अनुदिशम् अवान्तरदिशम् अरान् इव नेमिम् इवेष्टका आयातयति
17.29.308.m: In the middle he makes as it were a navel. / Following the cardinal points and intermediate points from it, he arranges the bricks like spokes, like a felly.
This is the rathacakracit to be marked out for one who has a rival.
'One who desires food should pile [the fire-altar] in the form of a trough.'

17.29.308.s: etasyaiva sato 'ratnimātreṇa prāgoṣṭham iva nirūhati | atha madhye nimnam iva karoti
17.29.308.d: एतस्यैव सतो ऽरत्निमात्रेण प्रागोष्ठम् इव निरूहति । अथ मध्ये निम्नम् इव करोति
17.29.308.m: Of this very one being [so], he extends forward a kind of lip by the measure of a cubit; / then in the middle he makes as it were a depression.
This is the droṇacit to be marked out for one who desires food.

17.29.308.s: samūhyaṃ cinvīta paśukāmas | iti vijñāyate puṣkaraparṇam̐ rukmam̐ hiraṇmayaṃ puruṣam̐ srucāv ity etallakṣaṇyam ity ācakṣate
17.29.308.d: समूह्यं चिन्वीत पशुकामस् । इति विज्ञायते पुष्करपर्णँ रुक्मँ हिरण्मयं पुरुषँ स्रुचाव् इत्य् एतल्लक्षण्यम् इत्य् आचक्षते
17.29.308.m: 'One who desires cattle should pile [the fire-altar] gathered together,' so it is known. / They say that this is characteristic: a lotus leaf, a golden plate, a golden man, and two dipping spoons.

17.29.308.s: kuruta eva tat | atho purīṣasyaiveṣṭakā āyātayati
17.29.308.d: कुरुत एव तत् । अथो पुरीषस्यैवेष्टका आयातयति
17.29.308.m: He indeed does that. / And then he arranges the bricks of soil alone.

17.29.308.s: sa eṣa samūhyaḥ paśukāmasya parikṛṣyaḥ paricāyyaṃ cinvīta grāmakāmas | iti |
17.29.308.d: स एष समूह्यः पशुकामस्य परिकृष्यः परिचाय्यं चिन्वीत ग्रामकामस् । इति ।
17.29.308.m: This is the samūhya to be marked out for one who desires cattle. / 'One who desires a village should pile [the fire-altar] in a circular shape.'

17.29.308.d: अनुशर्करम् अन्तःशर्करम् इष्टकाः परिचिनोति । अथान्ततो ऽथान्तरतस् ।
17.29.308.m: He piles the bricks along with gravel and within gravel; / then at the edge, then inside;

17.29.308.s: evam evā svayamātṛṇṇāyai | athābhitaḥ svayamātṛṇṇām iṣṭakāḥ paricinoti
17.29.308.d: एवम् एवा स्वयमातृण्णायै । अथाभितः स्वयमातृण्णाम् इष्टकाः परिचिनोति
17.29.308.m: in this very manner up to the svayamātṛṇṇā brick; / then he piles the bricks on both sides of the svayamātṛṇṇā brick.
This is the paricāyya to be marked out for one who desires a village.

17.30.309.s: śmaśānacitaṃ cinvīta yaḥ kāmayeta pitṛloka ṛdhnuyām iti
17.30.309.d: श्मशानचितं चिन्वीत यः कामयेत पितृलोक ऋध्नुयाम् इति
17.30.309.m: 'One who desires, "May I prosper in the world of the ancestors," should pile [the fire-altar] in the form of a funeral monument.'

17.30.309.s: ṣaṭ prāñcaḥ puruṣās trayaḥ purastāttiryañcau dvau paścāttiryañcau sa ātmā
17.30.309.d: षट् प्राञ्चः पुरुषास् त्रयः पुरस्तात्तिर्यञ्चौ द्वौ पश्चात्तिर्यञ्चौ स आत्मा
17.30.309.m: Six puruṣas long towards the east, three across in the front, and two across at the back—that is the trunk.

17.30.309.s: tasya mātrās | yadi grīvadaghnaṃ purastān nābhidaghnaṃ paścāt |
17.30.309.d: तस्य मात्रास् । यदि ग्रीवदघ्नं पुरस्तान् नाभिदघ्नं पश्चात् ।
17.30.309.m: Its measurements: / If it is neck-deep in front, it is navel-deep behind;

17.30.309.s: yadi nābhidaghnam purastāj jānudaghnaṃ paścāt | yadi jānudaghnaṃ purastād gulphadaghnaṃ paścāt |
17.30.309.d: यदि नाभिदघ्नम् पुरस्ताज् जानुदघ्नं पश्चात् । यदि जानुदघ्नं पुरस्ताद् गुल्फदघ्नं पश्चात् ।
17.30.309.m: if navel-deep in front, knee-deep behind; / if knee-deep in front, ankle-deep behind.

17.30.309.s: yadi gulphadaghnaṃ purastāt samaṃ bhūmeḥ paścāt
17.30.309.d: यदि गुल्फदघ्नं पुरस्तात् समं भूमेः पश्चात्
17.30.309.m: if ankle-deep in the east, level with the ground in the west.

17.30.309.s: sa eṣa śmaśānacit pitṛlokakāmasya | atha haiṣa kūrmacid abrāhmaṇas |
17.30.309.d: स एष श्मशानचित् पितृलोककामस्य । अथ हैष कूर्मचिद् अब्राह्मणस् ।
17.30.309.m: That is the fire-altar in the form of a cemetery for one who desires the world of the fathers. / Now, this fire-altar is in the form of a tortoise, not of the brāhmaṇa [type]:

17.30.309.s: madhya utpṛṣṭhaḥ parikṛṣyas | etasyaiva sato 'ratnimātreṇa prāk śira iva nirūhati
17.30.309.d: मध्य उत्पृष्ठः परिकृष्यस् । एतस्यैव सतो ऽरत्निमात्रेण प्राक् शिर इव निरूहति
17.30.309.m: humpbacked in the middle, rounded off all around. / Of it as it is, he shapes out what resembles a head pointing east to the measure of a cubit.
He arranges bricks toward the intermediate directions, like legs.

17.30.309.s: sa eṣa kūrmacid abrāhmaṇo madhya utpṛṣṭhaḥ parikṛṣyaḥ ||
17.30.309.d: स एष कूर्मचिद् अब्राह्मणो मध्य उत्पृष्ठः परिकृष्यः ॥
17.30.309.m: That is the fire-altar in the form of a tortoise, not of the brāhmaṇa [type], humpbacked in the middle, rounded off all around.

17.31.309.s: sautrāmaṇyā yakṣyamāṇo bhavati sa upakalpayate rohitaṃ carmānaḍuham̐ sīsaṃ ca klībaṃ ca śaṣpāṇi ca tokmāṇi ca vrīhīn nagnahuṃ cūrṇakṛtaṃ trīṇi nānāvṛkṣyāṇi pātrāṇi trayān saktūm̐s trayāṇi lomāni yūpaṃ ca śyenapattraṃ ca garbhiṇīṃ vaḍabām āsandīm iṇḍvaṃ kumbhaṃ kārotaraṃ viśākhyau dīrghavam̐śam̐ śikyam̐ śatātṛṇṇām̐ śatamānam̐ hiraṇyam̐ sataṃ ca vālaṃ ca brāhmaṇam āhutyā uccheṣaṇasya pātāraṃ yadi brāhmaṇaṃ na vindati valmīkavapām
17.31.309.d: सौत्रामण्या यक्ष्यमाणो भवति स उपकल्पयते रोहितं चर्मानडुहँ सीसं च क्लीबं च शष्पाणि च तोक्माणि च व्रीहीन् नग्नहुं चूर्णकृतं त्रीणि नानावृक्ष्याणि पात्राणि त्रयान् सक्तूँस् त्रयाणि लोमानि यूपं च श्येनपत्त्रं च गर्भिणीं वडबाम् आसन्दीम् इण्ड्वं कुम्भं कारोतरं विशाख्यौ दीर्घवँशँ शिक्यँ शतातृण्णाँ शतमानँ हिरण्यँ सतं च वालं च ब्राह्मणम् आहुत्या उच्छेषणस्य पातारं यदि ब्राह्मणं न विन्दति वल्मीकवपाम्
17.31.309.m: One is going to sacrifice with the Sautrāmaṇī. He procures a red bull's hide, lead, a eunuch, young sprouted grains, malted barley, rice, powdered ferment, three vessels of different woods, three kinds of groats, three kinds of hairs, a sacrificial post, a hawk's feather, a pregnant mare, a low stool, a pad, a jar, a filter-pot, two forked sticks, a long bamboo pole, a hanging basket, a vessel perforated with a hundred holes, a gold plate weighing a hundred mānas, a flat bowl, a hair-sieve, and a brāhmaṇa to drink the residue of the oblation; if he cannot find a brāhmaṇa, [he procures] the fat-like earth of an ant-hill.

17.31.310.s: athāmāvāsyena vā haviṣeṣṭvā nakṣatre vāgreṇa śālām̐ rohite carmaṇi surāsomaḥ sam̐sannaḥ śete
17.31.310.d: अथामावास्येन वा हविषेष्ट्वा नक्षत्रे वाग्रेण शालाँ रोहिते चर्मणि सुरासोमः सँसन्नः शेते
17.31.310.m: Then, having sacrificed with the new moon oblation or under an auspicious lunar mansion, the soma-liquor lies settled on the red hide in front of the hall.
To the south of it, the eunuch sits by.

17.31.310.s: sīsena klībāc chaṣpāṇi krīṇāti | idaṃ tava | idaṃ mama | iti
17.31.310.d: सीसेन क्लीबाच् छष्पाणि क्रीणाति । इदं तव । इदं मम । इति
17.31.310.m: He buys the young sprouted grains from the eunuch with lead, reciting: "This is yours; this is mine."

17.31.310.s: krītaḥ surāsomas | iti | athainam ādāya pūrvayā dvārā śālāṃ prapādya jaghanena gārhapatyam upasādayati |
17.31.310.d: क्रीतः सुरासोमस् । इति । अथैनम् आदाय पूर्वया द्वारा शालां प्रपाद्य जघनेन गार्हपत्यम् उपसादयति ।
17.31.310.m: "The soma-liquor is bought." Then, taking it and bringing it into the hall through the eastern door, he sets it down behind the gārhapatya fire.

17.31.310.s: athaiteṣāṃ vrīhīṇām ardhān avaghnanti | athetarān gārhapatya ekakapālam adhiśritya bharjanti
17.31.310.d: अथैतेषां व्रीहीणाम् अर्धान् अवघ्नन्ति । अथेतरान् गार्हपत्य एककपालम् अधिश्रित्य भर्जन्ति
17.31.310.m: Then they pound half of this rice. Then, having placed a single potsherd on the gārhapatya fire, they parch the other [half].

17.31.310.s: teṣāṃ ye phalanti lājās te bhavanti |
17.31.310.d: तेषां ये फलन्ति लाजास् ते भवन्ति ।
17.31.310.m: Those among them that burst become fried grains.

17.31.310.s: atha ya u na phalanti tās taryas |
17.31.310.d: अथ य उ न फलन्ति तास् तर्यस् ।
17.31.310.m: And those that do not burst are unburst grains.

17.31.310.s: gārhapatye navāṃ kumbhīm adhiśritya prodakam ivaudanam̐ śrapayanti |
17.31.310.d: गार्हपत्ये नवां कुम्भीम् अधिश्रित्य प्रोदकम् इवौदनँ श्रपयन्ति ।
17.31.310.m: Having placed a new pot on the gārhapatya fire, they boil a boiled-rice dish with plenty of water.
Then they pound those parched grains.

17.31.310.s: teṣāṃ yāni ca kṣudrāṇi yāś ca taryas tā utseke saṃprakiranti
17.31.310.d: तेषां यानि च क्षुद्राणि याश् च तर्यस् ता उत्सेके संप्रकिरन्ति
17.31.310.m: Whatever small fragments there are of them and whatever unburst grains there are, they scatter into the liquid drained off.

17.31.310.s: taṃ māsara ity ācakṣate | atha mānam ādāya vimimīta ekam̐ śaṣpāṇāṃ dve tokmāṇāṃ trīṇi lājānāṃ catvāri nagnahos |
17.31.310.d: तं मासर इत्य् आचक्षते । अथ मानम् आदाय विमिमीत एकँ शष्पाणां द्वे तोक्माणां त्रीणि लाजानां चत्वारि नग्नहोस् ।
17.31.310.m: That they call māsara. Then, taking a measure, he measures out: one of young sprouted grains, two of malted barley, three of fried grains, four of ferment.

17.31.311.s: athaitam odanaṃ cūrṇair anuprakiran māsareṇāvokṣan saṃpādayati ||
17.31.311.d: अथैतम् ओदनं चूर्णैर् अनुप्रकिरन् मासरेणावोक्षन् संपादयति ॥
17.31.311.m: Then, sprinkling this boiled-rice dish with the powders and moistening it with the māsara, he prepares it,

17.32.311.s: svādvīṃ tvā svādunā tīvrāṃ tīvreṇāmṛtām amṛtena sṛjāmi sam̐ somena | iti |
17.32.311.d: स्वाद्वीं त्वा स्वादुना तीव्रां तीव्रेणामृताम् अमृतेन सृजामि सँ सोमेन । इति ।
17.32.311.m: reciting: "Sweet with sweet, pungent with pungent, immortal with immortal, I mix you together with soma."

17.32.311.s: athaitām āsandīm agreṇāhavanīyaṃ paryāhṛtya dakṣiṇato nidadhāti |
17.32.311.d: अथैताम् आसन्दीम् अग्रेणाहवनीयं पर्याहृत्य दक्षिणतो निदधाति ।
17.32.311.m: Then, having carried this low stool around in front of the āhavanīya fire, he sets it down to the south.

17.32.311.s: āsandyām iṇḍvam iṇḍve kumbhaṃ kumbhe kārotaram avadadhāti | athaitam odanam abhitaḥ kārotaraṃ paricinoti |
17.32.311.d: आसन्द्याम् इण्ड्वम् इण्ड्वे कुम्भं कुम्भे कारोतरम् अवदधाति । अथैतम् ओदनम् अभितः कारोतरं परिचिनोति ।
17.32.311.m: On the low stool he places the pad, on the pad the jar, in the jar the filter-pot. Then he heaps this boiled-rice dish around the filter-pot.

17.32.311.s: athainam apidhāyābhimṛśati somo 'sy aśvibhyāṃ pacyasva sarasvatyai pacyasvendrāya sutrāmṇe pacyasva | iti
17.32.311.d: अथैनम् अपिधायाभिमृशति सोमो ऽस्य् अश्विभ्यां पच्यस्व सरस्वत्यै पच्यस्वेन्द्राय सुत्राम्णे पच्यस्व । इति
17.32.311.m: Then, having covered it, he touches it, reciting: "You are soma; ripen for the two Aśvins; ripen for Sarasvatī; ripen for Indra the good protector."

17.32.311.s: tisraḥ sam̐sṛṣṭā vasati tisro rātrīḥ krītaḥ somo vasati | iti brāhmaṇam
17.32.311.d: तिस्रः सँसृष्टा वसति तिस्रो रात्रीः क्रीतः सोमो वसति । इति ब्राह्मणम्
17.32.311.m: It remains mixed for three nights. "Bought, soma remains for three nights," says the brāhmaṇa passage.

17.32.311.s: atha tisṛṣu vyuṣṭāsu tāyate tripaśur vā catuṣpaśur vā paśubandhas |
17.32.311.d: अथ तिसृषु व्युष्टासु तायते त्रिपशुर् वा चतुष्पशुर् वा पशुबन्धस् ।
17.32.311.m: Then, when three [nights] have dawned, an animal sacrifice with three animals or with four animals is performed.

17.32.311.s: athāsyaiṣā pūrvedyur eva sautrāmaṇikī vedir vimitā bhavati
17.32.311.d: अथास्यैषा पूर्वेद्युर् एव सौत्रामणिकी वेदिर् विमिता भवति
17.32.311.m: Now, for this, the Sautrāmaṇī altar has already been measured out on the previous day.
Having strewn grass around it, he takes away the clump of grass with the formula.

17.33.311.s: idam eva prasiddhaṃ pauroḍāśikam | trir yajuṣā tūṣṇīṃ caturtham |
17.33.311.d: इदम् एव प्रसिद्धं पौरोडाशिकम् । त्रिर् यजुषा तूष्णीं चतुर्थम् ।
17.33.311.m: This is the well-known procedure of the cake-offering: thrice with a formula, silently the fourth time.

17.33.311.s: pūrvaṃ parigrāhaṃ parigṛhṇāti karaṇaṃ japati | uddhanti | uddhatād āgnīdhras trir harati
17.33.311.d: पूर्वं परिग्राहं परिगृह्णाति करणं जपति । उद्धन्ति । उद्धताद् आग्नीध्रस् त्रिर् हरति
17.33.311.m: He marks out the first boundary; he mutters the karaṇa formula; he digs up [the ground]; from what is dug up, the āgnīdhra priest takes away [the earth] three times.

17.33.311.s: yad āgnīdhras trir haraty atha cātvālasyāvṛtā cātvālaṃ parilikhati |
17.33.311.d: यद् आग्नीध्रस् त्रिर् हरत्य् अथ चात्वालस्यावृता चात्वालं परिलिखति ।
17.33.311.m: When the āgnīdhra priest has taken [it] away three times, he then marks out the pit according to the rite of the pit.

17.33.311.s: uttaraveder āvṛtottaravediṃ nivapati | uttaranābhim utsādya yūpāvaṭaṃ khātvāgner āvṛtā dvāv agnī praṇayata āhavanīyād evādhvaryur anvāhāryapacanāt pratiprasthātā |
17.33.311.d: उत्तरवेदेर् आवृतोत्तरवेदिं निवपति । उत्तरनाभिम् उत्साद्य यूपावटं खात्वाग्नेर् आवृता द्वाव् अग्नी प्रणयत आहवनीयाद् एवाध्वर्युर् अन्वाहार्यपचनात् प्रतिप्रस्थाता ।
17.33.311.m: He heaps up the high altar according to the rite of the high altar. Having raised the upper navel and dug the post-hole, they two carry forward the two fires according to the rite of the fire: the adhvaryu priest indeed from the āhavanīya fire, the pratiprasthātṛ priest from the anvāhāryapacana fire.

17.33.311.s: agnivaty uttaraṃ parigrāhaṃ parigṛhya yoyupitvā tiryañcam̐ sphyam̐ stabdhvā saṃpraiṣam āha prokṣaṇīr āsādaya | idhmābarhir upasādaya sruvam̐ svadhitim̐ srucaś ca saṃmṛḍḍhi tūṣṇīṃ pṛṣadājyagrahaṇīm | patnīm̐ saṃnahya | ājyena ca dadhnā codehi pratiprasthātaḥ surāsomasya viddhi | iti |
17.33.311.d: अग्निवत्य् उत्तरं परिग्राहं परिगृह्य योयुपित्वा तिर्यञ्चँ स्फ्यँ स्तब्ध्वा संप्रैषम् आह प्रोक्षणीर् आसादय । इध्माबर्हिर् उपसादय स्रुवँ स्वधितिँ स्रुचश् च संमृड्ढि तूष्णीं पृषदाज्यग्रहणीम् । पत्नीँ संनह्य । आज्येन च दध्ना चोदेहि प्रतिप्रस्थातः सुरासोमस्य विद्धि । इति ।
17.33.311.m: Having marked out the second boundary around the fire, smoothed it, and placed the wooden sword across, he gives the direction: "Set down the sprinkling waters; set down the kindling wood and sacrificial grass; cleanse the ladle, the knife, and the ladles, silently the vessel for speckled butter; having girded the sacrificer's wife, come up with the butter and with the curd; pratiprasthātṛ priest, attend to the soma-liquor."

17.33.312.s: adhvaryur eva prasiddhaṃ pāśubandhikaṃ karma ceṣṭati |
17.33.312.d: अध्वर्युर् एव प्रसिद्धं पाशुबन्धिकं कर्म चेष्टति ।
17.33.312.m: The adhvaryu priest performs the well-known work of the animal sacrifice.

17.33.312.s: atha pratiprasthātā surām̐ saṃpavayya saśastrām ādāya pūrvayā dvāropanirhṛtyāntarvedy āsādayati ||
17.33.312.d: अथ प्रतिप्रस्थाता सुराँ संपवय्य सशस्त्राम् आदाय पूर्वया द्वारोपनिर्हृत्यान्तर्वेद्य् आसादयति ॥
17.33.312.m: Then the pratiprasthātṛ priest, having caused the liquor to be strained, taking it with its recited formula, having brought it out through the eastern door, sets it down within the altar.

17.34.312.s: yāvad evātrādhvaryuś ceṣṭati tāvad eṣa pratiprasthātā sata udīcīnadaśena vālena surāṃ punāti punātu te parisrutam | somam̐ sūryasya duhitā | vāreṇa śaśvatā tanā | iti
17.34.312.d: यावद् एवात्राध्वर्युश् चेष्टति तावद् एष प्रतिप्रस्थाता सत उदीचीनदशेन वालेन सुरां पुनाति पुनातु ते परिस्रुतम् । सोमँ सूर्यस्य दुहिता । वारेण शश्वता तना । इति
17.34.312.m: As long as the adhvaryu priest acts here, so long does this pratiprasthātṛ priest strain the liquor into the flat bowl through the hair-sieve whose fringe points north, reciting: "May the daughter of the sun purify your over-flowing soma with the eternal perpetual hair-strainer."

17.34.312.s: vāyuḥ pūtaḥ pavitreṇa | iti yadi somātipavito bhavati |
17.34.312.d: वायुः पूतः पवित्रेण । इति यदि सोमातिपवितो भवति ।
17.34.312.m: [He recites:] "Vāyu purified by the strainer," if the sacrificer is one whose soma has flowed over excessively.
Then he takes up the vessel made of palāśa wood.

17.34.312.s: tena gṛhṇāti kuvid aṅga yavamantas | ity anudrutya | upayāmagṛhīto 'sy aśvibhyāṃ tvā juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmi | iti
17.34.312.d: तेन गृह्णाति कुविद् अङ्ग यवमन्तस् । इत्य् अनुद्रुत्य । उपयामगृहीतो ऽस्य् अश्विभ्यां त्वा जुष्टं गृह्णामि । इति
17.34.312.m: With it he draws [the cup], reciting: "Perhaps indeed those possessing barley..." and continuing: "You are taken with a support; I draw you agreeable to the two Aśvins."

17.34.312.s: barhiṣī antardhāya kvalasaktubhiś ca sim̐halomabhiś ca śrīṇāti |
17.34.312.d: बर्हिषी अन्तर्धाय क्वलसक्तुभिश् च सिँहलोमभिश् च श्रीणाति ।
17.34.312.m: Interposing two stalks of sacrificial grass, he mixes it with jujube groats and with lion's hairs.

17.34.312.s: apoddhṛtya barhiṣī śyenapattreṇa parimṛjya sādayati | eṣa te yonir aśvibhyāṃ tvā | iti |
17.34.312.d: अपोद्धृत्य बर्हिषी श्येनपत्त्रेण परिमृज्य सादयति । एष ते योनिर् अश्विभ्यां त्वा । इति ।
17.34.312.m: Having removed the two stalks of sacrificial grass and wiped [the cup] with the hawk's feather, he sets it down, reciting: "This is your seat; for the two Aśvins thee!"
Then he takes up the vessel made of nyagrodha wood.

17.34.312.s: tena gṛhṇāti kuvid aṅga yavamantas | ity anudrutya | upayāmagṛhīto 'si sarasvatyai tvā juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmi | iti
17.34.312.d: तेन गृह्णाति कुविद् अङ्ग यवमन्तस् । इत्य् अनुद्रुत्य । उपयामगृहीतो ऽसि सरस्वत्यै त्वा जुष्टं गृह्णामि । इति
17.34.312.m: With it he draws [the cup], reciting: "Perhaps indeed those possessing barley..." and continuing: "You are taken with a support; I draw you agreeable to Sarasvatī."

17.34.312.s: barhiṣī antardhāya badarasaktubhiś ca vyāghralomabhiś ca śrīṇāti |
17.34.312.d: बर्हिषी अन्तर्धाय बदरसक्तुभिश् च व्याघ्रलोमभिश् च श्रीणाति ।
17.34.312.m: Interposing two stalks of sacrificial grass, he mixes it with badara groats and with tiger's hairs.

17.34.312.s: apoddhṛtya barhiṣī śyenapattreṇa parimṛjya sādayati | eṣa te yoniḥ sarasvatyai tvā | iti |
17.34.312.d: अपोद्धृत्य बर्हिषी श्येनपत्त्रेण परिमृज्य सादयति । एष ते योनिः सरस्वत्यै त्वा । इति ।
17.34.312.m: Having removed the two stalks of sacrificial grass and wiped [the cup] with the hawk's feather, he sets it down, reciting: "This is your seat; for Sarasvatī thee!"
Then he takes up the vessel made of aśvattha wood.

17.34.312.s: tena gṛhṇāti kuvid aṅga yavamantas | ity anudrutya | upayāmagṛhīto 'sīndrāya tvā sutrāmṇe juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmi | iti
17.34.312.d: तेन गृह्णाति कुविद् अङ्ग यवमन्तस् । इत्य् अनुद्रुत्य । उपयामगृहीतो ऽसीन्द्राय त्वा सुत्राम्णे जुष्टं गृह्णामि । इति
17.34.312.m: With it he draws [the cup], reciting: "Perhaps indeed those possessing barley..." and continuing: "You are taken with a support; I draw you agreeable to Indra the good protector."

17.34.313.s: barhiṣī antardhāya karkandhusaktubhiś ca vṛkalomabhiś ca śrīṇāti | apoddhṛtya barhiṣī śyenapattreṇa parimṛjya sādayati | eṣa te yonir indrāya tvā sutrāmṇe | iti ||
17.34.313.d: बर्हिषी अन्तर्धाय कर्कन्धुसक्तुभिश् च वृकलोमभिश् च श्रीणाति । अपोद्धृत्य बर्हिषी श्येनपत्त्रेण परिमृज्य सादयति । एष ते योनिर् इन्द्राय त्वा सुत्राम्णे । इति ॥
17.34.313.m: Interposing two stalks of sacrificial grass, he mixes it with karkandhu groats and with wolf's hairs. Having removed the two stalks of sacrificial grass and wiped [the cup] with the hawk's feather, he sets it down, reciting: "This is your seat; for Indra the good protector thee!"
